title.zh: 卷10 本紀十 高宗本紀一
title.raw: 卷10 本紀十 高宗本紀一

sentences.zh: 高宗法天隆運至誠先覺體元立極敷文奮武欽明孝慈神聖純皇帝，諱弘曆，世宗第四子，母孝聖憲皇后，康熙五十年八月十三日生於雍親王府邸。

translations.literal: The Gaozong Emperor, styled Fatian Longyun Zhicheng Xianjue Tiyuan Liji Fuwen Fenwu Qinming Xiaoci Shensheng Chun, personal name Hongli, was the fourth son of Emperor Shizong; his mother was Empress Xiaoshengxian; he was born on the thirteenth day of the eighth month in the fiftieth year of Kangxi at the residence of Prince Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong (Qianlong), temple name Hongli, was Yongzheng's fourth son, born at Prince Yong's mansion in Kangxi 50.

sentences.zh: 隆準頎身，聖祖見而鍾愛，令讀書宮中，受學於庶吉士福敏，過目成誦。

translations.literal: His nose was high and his frame tall; when the Sage Ancestor saw him he took special delight in him, had him read in the palace, and placed him under the Metropolitan Graduate Fu Min—what he read once he could recite from memory.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi favored the tall, imposing boy and had him study in the palace under Fu Min, who found him memorized lessons at a glance.

sentences.zh: 復學射於貝勒允禧，學火器於莊親王允祿。

translations.literal: He also learned archery from Prince Beile Yunxi and firearms from Prince Zhuang Yunlu.
translations.idiomatic: He trained in archery with Yunxi and in firearms with Prince Zhuang Yunlu.

sentences.zh: 木蘭從獮，命侍衛引射熊。

translations.literal: On a mulan hunt he was ordered to have guards lead him to shoot a bear.
translations.idiomatic: During a mulan hunt, guards were told to guide him to shoot a bear.

sentences.zh: 甫上馬，熊突起。

translations.literal: He had just mounted when the bear suddenly reared up.
translations.idiomatic: He had barely mounted when the bear charged.

sentences.zh: 上控轡自若。

translations.literal: The Emperor held the reins with perfect composure.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli kept his seat and did not flinch.

sentences.zh: 聖祖御槍殪熊。

translations.literal: The Sage Ancestor took up his musket and killed the bear.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi fired and brought the bear down.

sentences.zh: 入武帳，顧語溫惠皇太妃曰：「是命貴重，福將過予。

translations.literal: Entering the military tent, he turned and said to Imperial Noble Consort Wen Hui: "This child's fate is precious; fortune will surpass mine.
translations.idiomatic: In the tent Kangxi told Imperial Noble Consort Wen Hui that the boy's destiny was august and his blessings would exceed his own.

translations.literal: "" (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The remark ended there.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年八月，世宗御乾清宮，密書上名，緘藏世祖所書正大光明扁額上。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Yongzheng, Emperor Shizong went to the Palace of Heavenly Purity, secretly wrote the heir's name, sealed it, and hid it above the plaque "Upright and Illuminating" inscribed by Emperor Shizu.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1, month 8, Yongzheng sealed Hongli's name in the casket behind the "Upright and Illuminating" plaque.

sentences.zh: 五年，娶孝賢皇后富察氏。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he married Empress Xiaoxian of the Fu clan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he wed Empress Xiaoxian (Fu).

sentences.zh: 十一年，封和碩寶親王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was enfeoffed as Prince Bao of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he became Prince Bao.

sentences.zh: 時準噶爾役未竟，又有黔苗兵事，命上綜理軍機，諮決大計。

translations.literal: The Dzungar campaign was not yet finished, and there was also the Miao war in Guizhou; the Emperor ordered him to oversee military affairs at the Grand Council and to decide major strategy.
translations.idiomatic: With Dzungar and Guizhou Miao wars still raging, Yongzheng put him in charge of Grand Council strategy.

sentences.zh: 十三年八月丁亥，世宗不豫。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the thirteenth year, on day dinghai, Emperor Shizong fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 of Yongzheng 13, on dinghai day, Yongzheng took ill.

sentences.zh: 時駐蹕圓明園，上與和親王弘晝朝夕謹侍。

translations.literal: At the time the court was staying at the Old Summer Palace; the Emperor and Prince He Hongzhou attended him day and night with care.
translations.idiomatic: At Yuanmingyuan, Hongli and Prince He Hongzhou kept constant vigil at his bedside.

sentences.zh: 戊子，世宗疾大漸，召莊親王允祿，果親王允禮，大學士鄂爾泰、張廷玉，領侍衛內大臣豐盛額、訥親，內大臣戶部侍郎海望入受顧命。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, as Shizong's illness grew critical, Prince Zhuang Yunlu, Prince Guo Yunli, Grand Secretaries Ortai and Zhang Tingyu, chief chamberlain Fengsheng'e, Neqin, and inner chamberlain Haiwang of the Board of Revenue were summoned to receive his deathbed charge.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, dying Yongzheng summoned Yunlu, Yunli, Ortai, Zhang Tingyu, Fengsheng'e, Neqin, and Haiwang for his final instructions.

sentences.zh: 己丑，崩。

translations.literal: On day jichou he died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Yongzheng died.

sentences.zh: 王大臣請奉大行皇帝還宮。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers asked that the late Emperor's coffin be escorted back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers asked to bring the late emperor's coffin back to the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 莊親王允祿等啟雍正元年立皇太子密封，宣詔即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Prince Zhuang Yunlu and the others opened the sealed document establishing the heir from the first year of Yongzheng, proclaimed the edict, and Hongli at once took the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Yunlu opened Yongzheng's sealed heir choice; Hongli was proclaimed and ascended.

sentences.zh: 尋諭奉大行皇帝遺命，莊親王允祿、果親王允禮、鄂爾泰、張廷玉輔政，並令鄂爾泰復任，以鄂爾泰因病請假也。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered obedience to the late Emperor's testament: Prince Zhuang Yunlu, Prince Guo Yunli, Ortai, and Zhang Tingyu were to assist in government; Ortai was also ordered to resume duty, as he had asked leave on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli followed Yongzheng's will: Yunlu, Yunli, Ortai, and Zhang Tingyu would rule jointly; Ortai returned from sick leave.

sentences.zh: 以遺命尊奉妃母為皇太后，復奉懿旨以上元妃為皇后。

translations.literal: By the testament his birth mother was honored as Empress Dowager; by a further edict Consort Yuan was made Empress.
translations.idiomatic: His mother became Empress Dowager; Consort Yuan was raised to Empress.

sentences.zh: 召大學士朱軾回京。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Zhu Shi was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shi was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 命大學士嵇曾筠總理浙江海塘工，趙弘恩署江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Ji Zengyun was ordered to oversee Zhejiang seawall works; Zhao Hong'en was made acting Jiangnan canal governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Zengyun took charge of Zhejiang seawalls; Zhao Hong'en acted as Jiangnan canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 大行皇帝大殮，命以乾清宮南廡為倚廬。

translations.literal: When the late Emperor was placed in the coffin, the south wing of the Palace of Heavenly Purity was ordered to serve as the mourning lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng's coffin was prepared; the south wing of Qianqing became the mourning lodge.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命總理事務王大臣議行三年喪。

translations.literal: On day gengyin the regent princes were ordered to deliberate the three-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, regents were told to plan the three-year mourning.

sentences.zh: 命履郡王允祹暫管禮部事務。

translations.literal: Prince of the Commandery Yunxiang was ordered temporarily to manage the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Yunxiang was put in temporary charge of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 召張照回京，以張廣泗總理苗疆事務，大學士邁柱署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhao was summoned to the capital; Zhang Guangsi was ordered to manage Miao frontier affairs; Grand Secretary Mai Zhu acted as Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhao was recalled; Zhang Guangsi took the Miao command; Mai Zhu acted at Huguang.

sentences.zh: 諭大將軍查郎阿駐肅州，與劉於義同掌軍務，北路大將軍平郡王福彭堅守。

translations.literal: An edict ordered General Cha Lang'a to garrison at Jiuquan and share military affairs with Liu Yuyi; the Northern Route Grand General, Prince of the Commandery Fu Peng, was to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Cha Lang'a was posted to Jiuquan with Liu Yuyi; Fu Peng was told to hold the northern line.

sentences.zh: 飭揚威將軍哈元生等剿撫苗疆。

translations.literal: Generals Ha Yuansheng and others were ordered to suppress and pacify the Miao frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Yuansheng and others were ordered to fight and pacify the Miao.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，頒大行皇帝遺詔。

translations.literal: On day guisi the late Emperor's testament edict was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Yongzheng's death edict was issued.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉朔，日食。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingyou, new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the ninth month, dingyou day, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 高起、憲德俱罷，仍帶尚書銜。

translations.literal: Gao Qi and Xiande were both dismissed but retained ministerial rank.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qi and Xiande left office but kept minister titles.

sentences.zh: 以鄂爾泰總理兵部事，果親王允禮總理刑部事，莊親王允祿總理工部事，甘汝來為漢兵部尚書，傅鼐署滿兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Ortai was ordered to manage the Board of War; Prince Guo Yunli the Board of Punishments; Prince Zhuang Yunlu the Board of Works; Gan Rulai was made Han Chinese Minister of War; Fu Nai acted as Manchu Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai took War; Yunli Punishments; Yunlu Works; Gan Rulai and Fu Nai headed the two War ministries.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上即位於太和殿，以明年為乾隆元年。

translations.literal: On day jihai the Emperor acceded at the Hall of Supreme Harmony; the following year was taken as the first year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Hongli ascended at Taihedian; the next year began Qianlong.

sentences.zh: 庚子，定三年喪制，卻群臣以日易月之請。

translations.literal: On day gengzi the three-year mourning was fixed, and the ministers' request to shorten mourning from years to days was refused.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day he upheld full three-year mourning and rejected shortening it to twenty-seven days.

sentences.zh: 命大學士朱軾協同總理事務王大臣辦事。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Zhu Shi was ordered to assist the regent princes in managing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shi was ordered to assist the regent council.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，召史貽直來京。

translations.literal: On day xinyou Shi Yizhi was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Shi Yizhi was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，止進獻方物。

translations.literal: On day renyin the presentation of tribute goods was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day provincial tribute offerings were stopped.

sentences.zh: 禁內廷行走僧人招搖。

translations.literal: Monks who strolled the Inner Court soliciting alms were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Soliciting monks in the Inner Court were banned.

sentences.zh: 頒乾隆元年時憲書。

translations.literal: The calendar for the first year of Qianlong was issued.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianlong 1 calendar was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 鑄乾隆通寶。

translations.literal: Qianlong tongbao cash was cast.
translations.idiomatic: New Qianlong coinage was minted.

sentences.zh: 遣官頒詔朝鮮。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to proclaim the accession in Korea.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys announced the new reign in Korea.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，賑甘肅蘭州、平涼等處旱災。

translations.literal: On day bingchen relief was given for drought in Lanzhou, Pingliang, and other places in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day drought relief was ordered for Gansu.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命慶復往北路軍營，代回福彭。

translations.literal: On day bingwu Qing Fu was ordered to the Northern Route army to relieve Fu Peng on his return.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Qing Fu went north to replace the returning Fu Peng.

sentences.zh: 手敕額駙策凌勿離軍營。

translations.literal: By the Emperor's own brush an edict told the imperial son-in-law Tsewang not to leave the camp.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli personally ordered Tsewang to remain with the army.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大行皇帝梓宮安奉雍和宮。

translations.literal: On day dingwei the late Emperor's coffin was installed at the Yonghe Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Yongzheng's coffin was placed at Yonghe gong.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上詣雍和宮行禮。

translations.literal: On day wushen the Emperor went to the Yonghe Palace to perform rites.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Hongli paid rites at Yonghe.

sentences.zh: 自是日至乙卯以為常。

translations.literal: From this day until day yimao it was made the regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: He did the same each day through yimao.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賞莊親王允祿、果親王允禮雙俸，鄂爾泰、張廷玉世襲一等輕車都尉，朱軾世襲騎都尉。

translations.literal: On day jiyou Prince Zhuang Yunlu and Prince Guo Yunli were granted double salary; Ortai and Zhang Tingyu hereditary first-rank Colonel of the Chariots; Zhu Shi hereditary Captain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Yunlu and Yunli received double stipends; Ortai and Zhang Tingyu, hereditary colonels; Zhu Shi, hereditary captain.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，召楊名時來京。

translations.literal: On day gengxu Yang Mingshi was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Yang Mingshi was recalled.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命海望署戶部尚書，傅鼐署刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinhai Haiwang was ordered to act as Minister of Revenue; Fu Nai to act as Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Haiwang acted at Revenue; Fu Nai at Punishments.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上詣雍和宮行大祭禮。

translations.literal: On day yimao the Emperor went to the Yonghe Palace to perform the great mourning sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day he offered the great mourning rite at Yonghe.

sentences.zh: 奉皇太后居永仁宮。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager was installed at the Palace of Eternal Benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager moved to Yongren Palace.

sentences.zh: 是日，上移居養心殿。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor moved his residence to the Hall of Mental Cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: The same day Hongli took up residence in the Hall of Mental Cultivation.

sentences.zh: 命廷臣輪班條奏，各舉所知。

translations.literal: Court ministers were ordered to submit memorials in rotation, each recommending persons he knew.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were told to report in turn and recommend talent.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賞李紱侍郎銜，命管戶部三庫事。

translations.literal: On day wuwu Li Fu was granted vice-ministerial rank and ordered to manage the three treasuries of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Li Fu received vice-minister rank and the Revenue treasuries.

sentences.zh: 己未，上詣雍和宮梓宮前行月祭禮。

translations.literal: On day jiwei the Emperor went before the late Emperor's coffin at the Yonghe Palace to perform the monthly sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day he offered the monthly rite before the coffin at Yonghe.

sentences.zh: 自是迄奉移，每月如之。

translations.literal: From then until the coffin was moved, the same was done each month.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly rites continued until the coffin was transferred.

sentences.zh: 再免民欠丁賦，並諭官吏侵蝕者亦免之。

translations.literal: The people's overdue poll and land taxes were again remitted, and an edict also remitted amounts officials had embezzled.
translations.idiomatic: Arrears in poll and land tax were forgiven again, including sums officials had skimmed.

sentences.zh: 逮傅爾丹下獄。

translations.literal: When Fu Erdan was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan was sent to prison.

sentences.zh: 庚申，開鄉會試恩科。

translations.literal: On day gengshen the special provincial and metropolitan examinations of grace were opened.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the enke provincial and metropolitan exams began.

sentences.zh: 免貴州被擾州縣之額賦，未擾者停徵。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for Guizhou prefectures and counties that had been disturbed; where undisturbed, collection was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: War-ravaged Guizhou counties were exempted from quota tax; peaceful ones had levies halted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上詣田村孝敬皇后梓宮前致祭。

translations.literal: On day xinyou the Emperor went to Tiancun to offer sacrifice before the coffin of Empress Xiaojing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day he sacrificed before Empress Xiaojing's coffin at Tiancun.

sentences.zh: 以本年鄉試弊多，逮治考官顧祖鎮、戴瀚。

translations.literal: Because there was much cheating in this year's provincial examination, examiners Gu Zuzhen and Dai Han were arrested and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Exam fraud led to the arrest of provincial examiners Gu Zuzhen and Dai Han.

sentences.zh: 大學士馬齊乞休，允之。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Ma Qi asked to retire; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi retired with approval.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，召署河東鹽政孫家淦來京，以侍郎用。

translations.literal: On day guihai acting Hedong salt intendant Sun Jiagan was summoned to the capital to be used as a vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Sun Jiagan was recalled from salt duty for a vice-minister post.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅朔，饗太廟，遣裕親王廣保代行。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingyin, new moon: sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; Prince Yu Guangbao was ordered to perform it in the Emperor's stead.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the tenth month, the ancestral offering was delegated to Prince Yu Guangbao.

sentences.zh: 命副將軍常德赴北路軍營。

translations.literal: Vice general Changde was ordered to proceed to the Northern Route army.
translations.idiomatic: Changde was sent to the northern front.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，申禁各省貢獻。

translations.literal: On day dingmao tribute from the provinces was again forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day provincial tribute was banned again.

sentences.zh: 以張廣泗為征苗經略，揚威將軍哈元生、副將軍董芳以下俱聽節制。

translations.literal: Zhang Guangsi was made coordinator of the Miao campaign; Generals Ha Yuansheng and Dong Fang and those below were all placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangsi became Miao campaign coordinator over Ha Yuansheng, Dong Fang, and subordinates.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命履郡王允祹管禮部，召原任尚書涂天相來京。

translations.literal: On day gengwu Prince of the Commandery Yunxiang was ordered to manage the Board of Rites; former Minister Tu Tianxiang was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Yunxiang took Rites; Tu Tianxiang was recalled.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以任蘭枝為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinwei Ren Lanzhi was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Ren Lanzhi became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 壬申，免江南等省漕糧蘆課及學租雜稅。

translations.literal: On day renshen canal grain reed levies and school rents and miscellaneous taxes in Jiangnan and other provinces were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Jiangnan canal surcharges and school levies were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 命治曾靜、張熙罪。

translations.literal: An order was issued to try Zeng Jing and Zhang Xi for their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Jing and Zhang Xi were ordered brought to trial.

sentences.zh: 加左都御史福敏太子太保。

translations.literal: Left Censor-in-Chief Fu Min was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Min was raised to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 以王大臣辦事遲延疏縱，申諭嚴明振作，毋與用寬之意相左。

translations.literal: Because the prince-ministers were dilatory and lax in conducting affairs, an edict admonished them to be strict and vigorous and not to run counter to the intent to use leniency.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli rebuked slow, slack regents: be firm and alert, not lax in the name of mercy.

sentences.zh: 調徐本為刑部尚書，涂天相為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Xu Ben was transferred to Minister of Punishments; Tu Tianxiang to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Ben took Punishments; Tu Tianxiang, Works.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以劉勷為直隸河道總督。

translations.literal: On day bingzi Liu Le was made Zhili canal governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Liu Le became Zhili canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，起彭維新為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day dingchou Peng Weixin was recalled as Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Peng Weixin returned as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 命徐本軍機處行走。

translations.literal: Xu Ben was ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Ben was assigned to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 癸未，停諸王兼管部院事。

translations.literal: On day guimao princes' concurrent management of boards and ministries was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day princes ceased concurrently heading ministries.

sentences.zh: 甲申，授海望戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiashen Haiwang was appointed Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Haiwang became Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命來保署工部尚書，兼管內務府。

translations.literal: On day jichou Laibao was ordered to act as Minister of Works and concurrently to manage the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Laibao acted at Works and the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，傅爾丹、岳鍾琪、石雲倬、馬蘭泰論斬。

translations.literal: On day guisi Fu Erdan, Yue Zhongqi, Shi Yuncong, and Ma Lantai were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Fu Erdan, Yue Zhongqi, Shi Yuncong, and Ma Lantai received death sentences.

sentences.zh: 甲午，改訥親、海望、徐本為協辦總理事務，納延泰行走，如班第等例。

translations.literal: On day jiawu Neqin, Haiwang, and Xu Ben were changed to assistants in managing grand affairs; Nayantai was ordered to attend, following the precedent of Bandi and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Neqin, Haiwang, and Xu Ben became assistant regents; Nayantai joined council duty like Bandi.

sentences.zh: 豐盛額、莽鵠立罷。

translations.literal: Fengsheng'e and Manghuli were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Fengsheng'e and Manghuli left office.

sentences.zh: 庚子，張照下獄鞫治。

translations.literal: On day gengzi Zhang Zhao was imprisoned for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Zhang Zhao was jailed for investigation.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，湖北忠峒等十五土司改土歸流，分置一府五縣，於恩施縣建府治，名曰施南府，分設縣治，名曰宣恩、來鳳、咸豐、利川。

translations.literal: On day renyin fifteen tusi of Zhongdong and other districts in Hubei were converted to direct rule; one prefecture and five counties were established, with the prefectural seat at Enshi named Shinan Prefecture, and counties named Xuan'en, Laifeng, Xianfeng, and Lichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day fifteen Hubei tusi were abolished for counties under the new Shinan prefecture at Enshi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，申諭薦舉博學鴻詞。

translations.literal: On day yisi an edict admonished those who recommended candidates for the Erudite Literati examination.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Hongli cautioned scholars recommending Erudite Literati candidates.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上大行皇帝尊諡曰敬天昌運建中表正文武英明寬仁信毅大孝至誠憲皇帝，廟號世宗，次日頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day dingwei the late Emperor was given the posthumous title Respecter of Heaven, Prosperous Fortune, Establishing the Mean, Manifesting Correctness, Civil and Martial Brilliance, Broad Benevolence, Faith and Resolution, Great Filiality, Utmost Sincerity, and Sagely, with temple name Shizong; the next day an edict of general grace was issued with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Yongzheng received his posthumous title and temple name Shizong; amnesty followed next day.

sentences.zh: 免四川巴縣等旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for Baxian and other drought-stricken districts in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan drought counties including Baxian were exempted from quota tax.

sentences.zh: 戊申，召邁柱來京，以史貽直署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day wushen Mai Zhu was summoned to the capital; Shi Yizhi acted as Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Mai Zhu was recalled; Shi Yizhi acted at Huguang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以孫嘉淦為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day gengxu Sun Jiagan was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Sun Jiagan became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命慶復為定邊大將軍，赴北路軍營。

translations.literal: On day guichou Qing Fu was ordered to be Pacification General on the Border and to proceed to the Northern Route army.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Qing Fu became border pacification general and went north.

sentences.zh: 命孫嘉淦仍兼管吏部。

translations.literal: Sun Jiagan was ordered still to manage the Board of Personnel concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jiagan kept concurrent charge of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 諭赦降苗罪。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned crimes of Miao who had surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Surrendered Miao were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 免貴州三年內耗羨。

translations.literal: Surcharges within three years in Guizhou were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou surcharges for three years were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上詣田村上孝敬憲皇后尊諡曰孝敬恭和懿順昭惠佑天翊聖憲皇后，次日頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day bingchen at Tiancun the late Empress was given the honorific title Respectful, Filial, Congenial, Gracious, Compliant, Bright, Favoring, Assisting Heaven, and Supporting Sagely; the next day an edict of general grace was issued with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Empress Xiaojing received her full posthumous title at Tiancun; amnesty followed next day.

sentences.zh: 改河東總督仍為河南巡撫，以傅德為之。

translations.literal: The Hedong governor-generalship was changed back to the Henan governorship; Fu De was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong was downgraded to Henan governorship under Fu De.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，授鍾保湖南巡撫，俞兆岳江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingsi Zhong Bao was appointed Hunan governor; Yu Zhaoyue Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Zhong Bao took Hunan and Yu Zhaoyue Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 命岱林布為右衛將軍。

translations.literal: Dai Linbu was ordered appointed general of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Linbu was made general of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 己未，以平郡王福彭協辦總理事務。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Prince of the Commandery of Ping Fu Peng was ordered to assist jointly in managing general affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Prince of Ping Fu Peng was appointed to help manage state affairs.

sentences.zh: 董芳、元展成、德希壽褫職逮問，奪哈元生揚威將軍，命經略張廣泗兼貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Dong Fang, Yuan Zhancheng, and De Xishou were stripped of office and arrested for interrogation; Ha Yuansheng was deprived of the rank Valiant and Majestic General; Commissioner Zhang Guangsi was ordered concurrently as Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Fang, Yuan Zhancheng, and De Xishou were dismissed and imprisoned; Ha Yuansheng lost his general's rank; Zhang Guangsi became Guizhou governor as well as frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賞阿其那、塞思黑子孫紅帶，收入玉牒。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the descendants of Aqina and Seshe were granted red girdles and enrolled in the jade genealogy.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Yinsi and Yintang's descendants received red girdles and were restored to the clan register.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以王大臣會刑部夾訊李禧、耿韜，命審訊大臣宜存大體。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Wang Dachen joined the Board of Punishments in rigorous examination of Li Xi and Geng Tao; the examining ministers were ordered to observe due propriety.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Wang Dachen joined the Ministry of Justice in investigating Li Xi and Geng Tao; examiners were told to uphold proper standards.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅朔，以博第為吉林將軍，吳禮布為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day of the month on day bingyin: Bodai was made Jilin general and Wu Libu Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the twelfth month, Bodai became Jilin general and Wu Libu Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 復設川陝總督，裁四川總督。

translations.literal: The Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-generalship was re-established; the Sichuan governor-generalship was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general post was restored and the Sichuan-only post abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，賑安徽泗州、湖北潛江水災。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, flood victims in Suzhou, Anhui, and Qianjiang, Hubei, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, flood relief was sent to Suzhou in Anhui and Qianjiang in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，免浙江、山東、福建、廣東鹽場欠課。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, arrears in salt-field levies of Zhejiang, Shandong, Fujian, and Guangdong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, unpaid salt taxes in Zhejiang, Shandong, Fujian, and Guangdong were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上皇太后徽號曰崇慶皇太后，次日頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Empress Dowager's honorable title was raised to Chongqing Empress Dowager; the next day an edict proclaiming grace of varying degrees was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Empress Dowager received the title Chongqing; the next day a grace edict was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以準噶爾遣使請和，命喀爾喀扎薩克等詳議定界事宜。

translations.literal: On day jimao, because Dzungar envoys came to sue for peace, Khalkha jasaks and others were ordered to deliberate in detail on border demarcation.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, with Dzungar envoys seeking peace, Khalkha princes were told to negotiate the frontier.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，調傅鼐為刑部尚書，仍兼管兵部。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Fu Tai was transferred to Minister of Punishments, still concurrently managing the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Fu Tai became Minister of Justice while retaining charge of the War Board.

sentences.zh: 甲申，磔曾靜、張熙於巿。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Zeng Jing and Zhang Xi were dismembered at the execution ground.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Zeng Jing and Zhang Xi were executed by lingchi.

sentences.zh: 都統李禧以贓，尚書高起以欺罔，俱論斬。

translations.literal: Commandant Li Xi was sentenced to decapitation for corruption; Minister Gao Qi for deception—both condemned to death.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xi was condemned to death for embezzlement; Gao Qi for fraud.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命嵇曾筠兼管浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Ji Zengyun was ordered concurrently to manage Zhejiang governor affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Ji Zengyun was made acting Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 以高斌為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Gao Bin was made Jiangnan canal governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin became Jiangnan canal commissioner.

sentences.zh: 設歸化城將軍及副都統。

translations.literal: A general and deputy lieutenant-general were established at Guihua City.
translations.idiomatic: Posts of general and deputy commander were created at Guihua City.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，晉封訥親一等公，世襲。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Neqin was promoted to first-rank duke, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Neqin was raised to hereditary first-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年春正月丙申朔，上詣堂子行禮。

translations.literal: First year of Qianlong, spring, first month, first day of the month on day bingchen: the Emperor went to the tangzi to perform ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's day of Qianlong 1, the Emperor worshipped at the tangzi.

sentences.zh: 至觀德殿更素服，詣雍和門行禮畢，率諸王大臣詣慈寧宮行禮。

translations.literal: He went to the Hall of Contemplating Virtue to change into plain mourning dress; when ritual at Yonghe Gate was completed, he led princes and ministers to the Palace of Compassionate Nurturing to perform ritual.
translations.idiomatic: After changing into mourning garb at Guande Hall and rites at Yonghe Gate, he led princes and ministers to Cining Palace.

sentences.zh: 御太和殿受朝，不作樂，不宣表。

translations.literal: He held court at the Hall of Supreme Harmony to receive homage; no music, no proclamation read.
translations.idiomatic: He received court at the Hall of Supreme Harmony without music or edict proclamation.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命北路參贊大臣薩木哈回京。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Northern Route Commissioner Samuha was ordered back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Northern Route commissioner Samuha was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祈穀於上帝，親詣行禮。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, grain was prayed for to the Supreme Lord; the Emperor went in person to perform ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor personally prayed for grain at Heaven.

sentences.zh: 自是每年如之。

translations.literal: From this year onward, every year was the same.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth this was done every year.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，建京師先蠶壇。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the capital Sericulture Altar was built.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Beijing's Sericulture Altar was erected.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: Dzungar taiji Galdan Tseren sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: The Dzungar leader Galdan Tseren sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁未，準噶爾貢使吹納木喀入覲。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Dzungar tribute envoy Choinimka was received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Dzungar envoy Choinimka had audience.

sentences.zh: 召大將軍慶復回京。

translations.literal: Grand General Qingfu was summoned back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: General Qingfu was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 命伊勒慎、阿成阿、哈岱為參贊大臣，協同額駙策凌辦事，駐鄂爾坤。

translations.literal: Yilejen, Acheng'a, and Hadai were made commissioners; together with the imperial son-in-law Tsering they managed affairs, stationed at Orkhon.
translations.idiomatic: Yilejen, Acheng'a, and Hadai were made frontier commissioners to assist Tsering at Orkhon.

sentences.zh: 命都統王常、侍郎柏修往鄂爾坤勘屯田。

translations.literal: Commandant Wang Chang and Vice Minister Bai Xiu were sent to Orkhon to survey colony fields.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chang and Bai Xiu were sent to Orkhon to survey military farms.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以顧琮署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Gu Cong was made acting Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Gu Cong became acting Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 己未，署湖南永州鎮總兵崔起潛妄劾鄂爾泰、張廣泗，褫職逮治。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Acting Yongzhou garrison commander Cui Qiqian falsely impeached Ortai and Zhang Guangsi; he was stripped of office and arrested.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Cui Qiqian was dismissed and arrested for falsely accusing Ortai and Zhang Guangsi.

sentences.zh: 南掌入貢。

translations.literal: Nanzhang paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Xang sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上啟蹕謁陵。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor set out on pilgrimage to visit the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor departed to visit the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor visited Zhaoxi Mausoleum, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, and Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, he worshipped at the imperial mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 賑臺灣諸羅縣地震災民。

translations.literal: Earthquake victims in Zhuluo County, Taiwan, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan's Zhuluo earthquake victims received relief.

sentences.zh: 賑甘肅固原、四川忠州等州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Drought victims in Guyuan, Gansu, Zhongzhou, Sichuan, and other districts were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Drought relief went to Guyuan in Gansu, Zhongzhou in Sichuan, and other districts.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，上還京師。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingyin: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，祭大社、大稷，上親詣行禮。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the great earth and grain were sacrificed to; the Emperor went in person to perform ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor personally offered to the gods of earth and grain.

sentences.zh: 自是每年如之。

translations.literal: From this year onward, every year was the same.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth this was done every year.

sentences.zh: 以補熙署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Bu Xi was made acting grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Xi became acting grain-transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣準噶爾來使歸，詔以遵皇考諭旨，酌定疆界，齎示噶爾丹策零。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Dzungar envoy was sent home; an edict ordered that, following the late Emperor's instruction, the frontier be fixed by consultation and shown to Galdan Tseren.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Dzungar envoy returned with an edict on border demarcation for Galdan Tseren per Yongzheng's instructions.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零敕書，斥所請以哲爾格西喇呼魯蘇為界，及專令喀爾喀內徙。

translations.literal: On day yimao, an imperial letter was bestowed on Dzungar taiji Galdan Tseren, rejecting his request to take Jerge Jerkh Churkhos as border and to order Khalkha migration inward alone.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, an imperial letter rebuked Galdan Tseren's border demands and unilateral Khalkha resettlement proposal.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命邁柱兼管工部。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Mai Zhu was ordered concurrently to manage the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Mai Zhu was given charge of the Works Board.

sentences.zh: 申飭陳奏謬妄之謝濟世、李徽、陳世倌等。

translations.literal: Xie Jishi, Li Hui, Chen Shiguang, and others were admonished for memorializing with absurd errors.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Jishi, Li Hui, and Chen Shiguang were rebuked for reckless memorials.

sentences.zh: 加楊名時禮部尚書銜，管國子監祭酒事。

translations.literal: Yang Mingshi was given the nominal rank of Minister of Rites and managed the Directorate of Education chancellor's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Mingshi received Rites Minister rank and headed the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，朝鮮國王李昑遣使進香，賞賚如例。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the King of Korea Yi Geun sent envoys to offer incense; rewards were given as usual.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Korea's King Yi Geun sent incense bearers and received customary gifts.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命改嵇曾筠為浙江總督，兼管兩浙鹽政。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Ji Zengyun was changed to Zhejiang governor-general, concurrently managing both Zhejiang salt administration.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Ji Zengyun became Zhejiang governor-general with control of salt revenue.

sentences.zh: 郝玉麟以閩浙總督專管福建事。

translations.literal: Hao Yulin as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general managed Fujian affairs exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yulin, as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general, took charge of Fujian alone.

sentences.zh: 戊子，定世宗山陵名曰泰陵。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the late Shizong's mausoleum was named Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Yongzheng's tomb was named Tailing.

sentences.zh: 己丑，達賴喇嘛及貝勒頗羅鼐遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Dalai Lama and beile Pholhanas sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Dalai Lama and Pholhanas sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以程元章為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Cheng Yuanzhang was made grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Cheng Yuanzhang became grain-transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，尹繼善奏克空稗、台雄等寨。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Yin Jishan memorialized capture of Kongbai, Taixiong, and other stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Yin Jishan reported capture of Kongbai and Taixiong stockades.

sentences.zh: 張廣泗奏克大小丹江等處。

translations.literal: Zhang Guangsi memorialized capture of Greater and Lesser Danjiang and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangsi reported victory at Greater and Lesser Danjiang.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，釋汪景琪、查嗣庭親族回籍。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi: kinsmen of Wang Jingqi and Zha Sitin were released to return to native places.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengzi day, families of Wang Jingqi and Zha Sitin were freed to return home.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，加上太祖尊諡曰太祖承天廣運聖德神功肇紀立極仁孝睿武端毅欽安弘文定業高皇帝，孝慈皇后尊諡曰孝慈昭憲敬順仁徽懿德慶顯承天輔聖高皇后；

translations.literal: On day yisi, augmented posthumous titles were conferred on Taizu as Taizu Chengtian Guangyun Shengde Shengong Zhaoji Liji Renxiao Ruiwu Duanyi Qin'an Hongwen Dingye Gaohuangdi, and on Empress Xiaoci as Xiaoci Zhaoxian Jingshun Renhui Yide Qingxian Chengtian Fusheng Gaohou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, augmented posthumous titles were conferred on Nurhaci and Empress Xiaocigao.

sentences.zh: 太宗尊諡曰太宗應天興國弘德彰武寬溫仁聖睿孝敬敏昭定隆道顯功文皇帝，孝端皇后尊諡曰孝端正敬仁懿哲順慈僖莊敏輔天協聖文皇后，孝莊皇后尊諡曰孝莊仁宣誠憲恭懿至德純徽翊天啟聖文皇后；

translations.literal: Taizong's posthumous title was Taizong Yingtian Xingguo Hongde Zhangwu Kuanwen Rensheng Ruixiao Jingmin Zhaoding Longdao Xiangong Wenhuangdi; Empress Xiaoduan as Xiaoduan Zhengjing Renyi Zheshun Cixi Zhuangmin Futian Xiesheng Wenhou; Empress Xiaozhuang as Xiaozhuang Renxuan Chengxian Gongyi Zhide Chunhui Yitian Qisheng Wenhou.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous titles were augmented for Hong Taiji, Empress Xiaoduan, and Empress Xiaozhuang.

sentences.zh: 世祖尊諡曰世祖體天隆運定統建極英睿欽文顯武大德弘功至仁純孝章皇帝，孝惠皇后尊諡曰孝惠仁憲端懿慈淑恭安純德順天翼聖章皇后，孝康皇后尊諡曰孝康慈和莊懿恭惠溫穆端靖崇天育聖章皇后；

translations.literal: Shizu's posthumous title was Shizu Titian Longyun Dingtong Jianji Yingrui Qinwen Xianwu Dade Honggong Zhiren Chunxiao Zhanghuangdi; Empress Xiaohui as Xiaohui Renxian Duanyi Cishu Gong'an Chunde Shuntian Yisheng Zhanghou; Empress Xiaokang as Xiaokang Cihe Zhuangyi Gonghui Wenmu Duanjing Chongtian Yusheng Zhanghou.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous titles were augmented for Shunzhi, Empress Xiaohui, and Empress Xiaokang.

sentences.zh: 聖祖尊諡曰聖祖合天弘運文武睿哲恭儉寬裕孝敬誠信中和功德大成仁皇帝，孝誠皇后尊諡曰孝誠恭肅正惠安和淑懿儷天襄聖仁皇后，孝昭皇后尊諡曰孝昭靜淑明惠正和安裕欽天順聖仁皇后，孝恭皇后尊諡曰孝恭宣惠溫肅定裕慈純贊天承聖仁皇后。

translations.literal: Shengzu's posthumous title was Shengzu Hetian Hongyun Wenwu Ruizhe Gongjian Kuanyu Xiaojing Chengxin Zhonghe Gongde Dacheng Renhuangdi; Empress Xiaocheng as Xiaocheng Gongsu Zhenghui Anhe Shuyi Litian Xiangsheng Renhou; Empress Xiaozhao as Xiaozhao Jingshu Minghui Zhenghe Anyu Qintian Shunsheng Renhou; Empress Xiaogong as Xiaogong Xuanhui Wensu Dingyu Cichun Zantian Chengsheng Renhou.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous titles were augmented for Kangxi and Empresses Xiaocheng, Xiaozhao, and Xiaogong.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免四川涼山等處番民額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, assessed levies on tribal peoples of Liangshan, Sichuan, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, tribal taxes in Sichuan's Liangshan were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免肅州威魯堡回民舊欠。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, old arrears of the Muslim community at Weilu Fort, Suzhou, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, old debts of Suzhou's Weilu Muslim community were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以固原提督樊廷為駐哈密總督。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Guyuan regional commander Fan Ting was made governor-general stationed at Hami.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Fan Ting became governor-general at Hami.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免廣東歸善等四縣加增漁稅及通省逋賦。

translations.literal: On day yimao, added fishing levies and provincial arrears in four counties of Gui Shan, Guangdong, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, extra fishing taxes and provincial arrears in Guangdong were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，免江南阜寧等州縣緩徵漕糧。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingyin: deferred grain transport levies for Funing and other districts in Jiangnan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, deferred canal grain taxes in Jiangnan were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命王常、海瀾為參贊大臣，協同額駙策凌辦事。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Wang Chang and Hailan were made commissioners to manage affairs jointly with the imperial son-in-law Tsering.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Wang Chang and Hailan were made frontier commissioners to assist Tsering.

sentences.zh: 以高其倬為湖北巡撫，暫署湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Gao Qizhuo was made Hubei governor and temporarily acted as Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qizhuo became Hubei governor and acting Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以王士俊為四川巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Wang Shijun was made Sichuan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Wang Shijun became Sichuan governor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，貴州提督哈元生褫職逮問。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Guizhou regional commander Ha Yuansheng was stripped of office and arrested for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Ha Yuansheng was dismissed and arrested.

sentences.zh: 裁直隸副總河，以總督兼管河務。

translations.literal: The Zhili deputy canal director was abolished; the governor-general was ordered to manage river affairs concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhili deputy canal post was abolished; the governor-general took charge of river works.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜金德瑛等三百三十四名進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Jin Deying and three hundred thirty-three others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Jin Deying and 333 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，布魯克巴部諾顏林沁齊壘喇布濟至西藏請上安，並貢方物。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Bhutanese chief Lhazin Cholop Gyalpo came to Tibet to request imperial blessings and presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, a Bhutanese ruler sought imperial blessing in Tibet and sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，賑河南永城縣水災。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingwei: flood victims in Yongcheng County, Henan, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei day, flood relief went to Yongcheng in Henan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命江南副總河移駐徐州。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Jiangnan deputy canal director was ordered to move his station to Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the Jiangnan deputy canal commissioner was posted to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免四川南溪等州縣被風雹額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, assessed levies on Nanxi and other districts in Sichuan struck by wind and hail were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, storm-damaged districts in Sichuan received tax relief.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，朝鮮國王李昑表賀登極及尊崇皇太后，並進方物。

translations.literal: The King of Korea Yi Geun memorialized congratulations on accession and elevation of the Empress Dowager, and presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Korea's King Yi Geun congratulated the new reign and the Empress Dowager and sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，暹羅國王參立拍照廣拍馬噓六坤司尤提雅菩挨表謝賜扁，並貢方物。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the King of Siam memorialized thanks for the bestowed plaque and presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the King of Siam thanked the court for an imperial plaque and sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，免甘肅伏羌等州縣地震傷亡缺額丁銀。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, shortfalls in poll-tax silver from earthquake casualties in Fuxiang and other districts, Gansu, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, poll-tax shortfalls from Gansu earthquake victims were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，賑江蘇蕭縣等州縣水災。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuchen: flood victims in Xiao County and other districts, Jiangsu, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen day, flood relief went to Jiangsu districts including Xiao County.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以慶復署吏部尚書，仍兼署戶部事。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Qingfu was made acting Minister of Personnel, still concurrently acting Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Qingfu became acting Personnel Minister while still acting Revenue Minister.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，授張廣泗貴州總督，兼管巡撫事。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Zhang Guangsi was appointed Guizhou governor-general, concurrently managing governor affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Zhang Guangsi became Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以尹繼善為雲南總督。

translations.literal: Yin Jishan was made Yunnan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jishan became Yunnan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳朔，以貴州流民多就食沅州，免沅州額賦。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day of the month on day guisi: because many Guizhou refugees sought food at Yuanzhou, Yuanzhou's assessed levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the seventh month, Yuanzhou taxes were forgiven because Guizhou refugees gathered there.

sentences.zh: 甲午，召總理事務王大臣九卿等，宣諭密書建儲諭旨，收藏於乾清宮正大光明扁額上。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the princes and ministers in charge of general affairs and the Nine Ministers were summoned; the secret edict on establishing the heir was proclaimed and stored above the "Upright and Illuminating" plaque in the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the heir-selection secret edict was read to the chief ministers and placed behind the "Upright and Illuminating" plaque.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免貴州通省本年額賦。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Guizhou's assessed levies for the year were remitted throughout the province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the year's land tax was forgiven throughout Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，除古州等處苗賦。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Miao levies in Guzhou and other places were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Miao taxes in Guzhou and elsewhere were abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，免崔起潛罪。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Cui Qiqian's punishment was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Cui Qiqian was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賑江西安福水災。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, flood victims in Anfu, Jiangxi, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, flood relief went to Anfu in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，追諡明建文皇帝為恭閔惠皇帝。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Ming Jianwen Emperor was posthumously titled Gongmin Hui Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Ming emperor Jianwen received the posthumous title Gongmin Hui.

sentences.zh: 賑江南蕭、碭等州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in Xiao, Dang, and other districts and garrisons of Jiangnan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to Xiao, Dang, and other Jiangnan districts.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賑甘肅隴西等州縣水雹災。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, flood and hail victims in Longxi and other districts, Gansu, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, flood and hail relief went to Longxi and other Gansu districts.

sentences.zh: 戊午，調鍾保為湖北巡撫，高其倬為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Zhong Bao was transferred to Hubei governor and Gao Qizhuo to Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Zhong Bao became Hubei governor and Gao Qizhuo Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 賑湖北漢川等五州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in five districts and garrisons including Hanchuan, Hubei, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to Hanchuan and four other Hubei districts.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，逮問王士俊，尋論斬。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Wang Shijun was arrested for interrogation; soon sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Wang Shijun was arrested and soon condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 賑廣東南海、潮陽等縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in Nanhai, Chaoyang, and other counties of Guangdong were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to Nanhai, Chaoyang, and other Guangdong counties.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，祭大稷、大社，上親詣行禮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuchen: the great grain and earth were sacrificed to; the Emperor went in person to perform ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuchen day, the Emperor personally offered to the gods of grain and earth.

sentences.zh: 自是每歲如之。

translations.literal: From this year onward, every year was the same.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth this was done every year.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾部人孟克來降。

translations.literal: A Dzungar tribesman named Mengke came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: A Dzungar named Mengke defected.

sentences.zh: 庚午，尚書傅鼐有罪免。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Minister Fu Tai was dismissed for crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Minister Fu Tai was dismissed for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賑河南南陽等五縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yimao, flood victims in five counties including Nanyang, Henan, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, flood relief went to Nanyang and four other Henan counties.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑喀喇沁飢。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, famine in Khalkha's Kharachin was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, famine relief was sent to Kharachin in Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，兵部尚書通智免，以奉天將軍那蘇圖代之。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Minister of War Tongzhi was dismissed; Fengtian General Nasutu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Tongzhi was removed as Minister of War and Nasutu took the post.

sentences.zh: 調博第為奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Bodi was transferred to be Fengtian general.
translations.idiomatic: Bodi became Fengtian general.

sentences.zh: 以吉爾黨阿為寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: Jierdang'a was made Ningguta general.
translations.idiomatic: Jierdang'a was appointed general at Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 賑陝西神木、府谷雹災。

translations.literal: Hail disaster relief was granted for Shenmu and Fugu in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi's Shenmu and Fugu received hail relief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賑浙江蘭溪等六縣、江南溧水等二十四州縣、湖北潛江等九州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, flood relief was granted for six counties including Lanxi in Zhejiang, twenty-four prefectures and counties including Lishui in Jiangnan, and nine prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Qianjiang in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, flood relief reached Zhejiang, Jiangnan, and Hubei districts in varying numbers.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，免張照、哈元生、董芳、元展成、德希壽貽誤苗疆罪。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingshen: Zhang Zhao, Ha Yuansheng, Dong Fang, Yuan Zhancheng, and Dexishou were pardoned for errors in the Miao frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, five officials were forgiven for Miao frontier mistakes.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，禮部尚書楊名時卒。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Minister of Rites Yang Mingshi died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Yang Mingshi, Minister of Rites, died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以慶復為刑部尚書，兼管吏部。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Qingfu was made Minister of Justice and also administered the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Qingfu became Minister of Justice and acting head of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 命傅鼐暫署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Fu Nai was ordered to serve temporarily as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Nai was appointed acting Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 庚子，停本年秋決。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, autumn executions for the year were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the autumn judicial executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賑浙江安吉等四縣水災。

translations.literal: On day guimao, flood relief was granted for four counties including Anji in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Zhejiang flood districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上臨大學士朱軾第視疾。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor visited Grand Secretary Zhu Shi at his residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor called on the ailing Grand Secretary Zhu Shi.

sentences.zh: 免江西安福水災額賦。

translations.literal: Registered tax quotas were remitted for Anfu in Jiangxi after flood.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi's Anfu had flood taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大學士朱軾卒，上親臨賜奠。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Grand Secretary Zhu Shi died; the Emperor personally attended and bestowed funeral offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Zhu Shi died and the Emperor attended in person to offer mourning gifts.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賑安徽宿州等二十州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day renzi, flood relief was granted for twenty prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Suzhou in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, twenty Anhui districts received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 致仕大學士陳元龍卒。

translations.literal: Retired Grand Secretary Chen Yuanlong died.
translations.idiomatic: The retired Grand Secretary Chen Yuanlong died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賑江蘇蕭縣等三州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yimao, flood relief was granted for three prefectures and counties including Xiaoxian in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, three Jiangsu districts received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 己未，御試博學鴻詞一百七十六人於保和殿，授劉綸等官。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, one hundred seventy-six candidates in the Erudite Hongci examination were tested in the Hall of Preserving Harmony; Liu Lun and others were granted offices.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, 176 erudite-scholar candidates were examined at Baohe Hall and offices were awarded.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇無錫等十三州衛水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was granted for thirteen prefectures and garrisons including Wuxi in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen Jiangsu prefectures and garrisons received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾台吉車林等來降。

translations.literal: Zungar taiji Chelun and others came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Zungar nobles including Chelun surrendered.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，以邵基為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renxu: Shao Ji was made Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Shao Ji became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，除浙江仁和等州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yichou, registered tax quotas were remitted for flood districts including Renhe in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Zhejiang flood counties had taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚午，調岳濬為江西巡撫，以法敏為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Yue Jun was transferred to be Jiangxi governor; Fa Min was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Yue Jun went to Jiangxi and Fa Min to Shandong as governors.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上奉皇太后送世宗梓宮至泰陵。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, conveyed Shizong's coffin to Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager escorted Yongzheng's coffin to Tailing.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the imperial party returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，上始御乾清門聽政。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu: the Emperor began to hold court and hear affairs at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the Emperor resumed governance at Qianqing Gate.

sentences.zh: 加嵇曾筠太子太傅。

translations.literal: Ji Zengyun was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Zengyun received the title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 命徐本為東閣大學士，仍兼管刑部。

translations.literal: Xu Ben was appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, still concurrently administering the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Ben became an Eastern Pavilion Grand Secretary while keeping charge of Justice.

sentences.zh: 以孫家淦為刑部尚書，楊汝穀為左都御史。

translations.literal: Sun Jiahan was made Minister of Justice; Yang Rugu was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jiahan became Minister of Justice and Yang Rugu Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 以額爾圖為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: E'ertu was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: E'ertu was appointed general at Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，免雲南楚雄等四府州縣額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, registered tax quotas were remitted for four prefectures and counties including Chuxiong in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Yunnan tax quotas were forgiven in four districts.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賑安徽霍丘等三縣衛、湖北漢川等十三縣一水災。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, flood relief was granted for three counties and garrisons including Huoqiu in Anhui and thirteen counties in Hubei including Hankou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, flood relief reached Anhui and Hubei districts.

sentences.zh: 己酉，冬至，祀天於圜丘，上親詣行禮。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the winter solstice, Heaven was sacrificed at the Round Mound; the Emperor went in person to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the winter solstice sacrifice at the Round Mound was performed by the Emperor in person.

sentences.zh: 自是每年如之。

translations.literal: Henceforth this was done every year.
translations.idiomatic: The practice continued annually thereafter.

sentences.zh: 己未，賑陝西定邊雹災，江南長洲等十二州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, hail relief was granted for Dingbian in Shaanxi and flood relief for twelve prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Changzhou in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, hail and flood relief reached Shaanxi and Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，賑巴林郡王等四旗旱災。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinyou: drought relief was granted for four banners including the Prince of Balin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, four banners including Balin received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賑江蘇婁、溧水等十三州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, flood relief was granted for thirteen prefectures and counties including Lou and Lishui in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, thirteen Jiangsu districts received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改江南壽春協為鎮，設總兵。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Jiangnan's Shouchun brigade was upgraded to a garrison and a commander-in-chief was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Shouchun brigade became a garrison with its own commander.

sentences.zh: 己巳，免陝西府谷、神木本年雹災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jisi, this year's hail-disaster tax quotas were remitted for Fugu and Shenmu in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Shaanxi hail taxes for Fugu and Shenmu were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 移南河副總河駐徐州。

translations.literal: The deputy director-general of the Southern Rivers was moved to station at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Rivers deputy was relocated to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免安徽泗州衛屯田、長蘆、廣雲灶地水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, flood tax quotas were remitted for Sizhou garrison fields in Anhui and saltworks at Changlu and Guangyun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, flood taxes were forgiven for Anhui garrison land and saltworks.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，岱林布改江寧將軍。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Dai Linbu was transferred to be Jiangning general.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Dai Linbu became Jiangning general.

sentences.zh: 以王常為建威將軍，雅爾圖為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Wang Chang was made General Who Establishes Might; Ya'ertu was made assisting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chang received the rank General Who Establishes Might; Ya'ertu became assisting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 免兩淮莞瀆等三場水災額賦。

translations.literal: Flood tax quotas were remitted for three salt fields including Guandu in the Two Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: Two Huai salt fields had flood taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、南掌、暹羅、安南來貢。

translations.literal: This year Korea, Lan Xang, Siam, and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Lan Xang, Siam, and Annam presented tribute this year.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚寅朔，免朝賀。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, new moon on day gengyin: court congratulations were waived.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year's first month, the new-year audience was omitted.

sentences.zh: 庚子，召趙弘恩來京。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Zhao Hongen was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Zhao Hongen was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以慶復為兩江總督。

translations.literal: Qingfu was made governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: Qingfu became governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 調那蘇圖為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Nasutu was transferred to be Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Nasutu became Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 以訥親為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Neqin was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Neqin became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以楊超曾為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Yang Chaozeng was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Yang Chaozeng became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 丙午，釋王士俊。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Wang Shijun was released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Wang Shijun was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 戊子，李衛劾治誠親王府護衛囑託。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Li Wei impeached guards of Prince Cheng's establishment for taking bribes and pulling strings.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Li Wei charged Prince Cheng's guards with corruption and favoritism.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之，賞四團龍褂。

translations.literal: The Emperor commended him and rewarded a robe with four round dragons.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised Li Wei and granted him a four-dragon court robe.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，安南國王黎維祜卒，嗣子黎維禕遣使告哀，並貢方物。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingyin: the king of Annam, Le Duy Hu, died; his heir Le Duy Y sent envoys to announce mourning and also presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Annam's king died and his heir sent mourning envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賑江蘇高郵水災。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, flood relief was granted for Gaoyou in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Gaoyou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遣翰林院侍讀嵩壽、修撰陳倓冊封黎維禕為安南國王。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Hanlin Academy reader Song Shou and compiler Chen Tan were dispatched to invest Le Duy Y as king of Annam.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Song Shou and Chen Tan were sent to enfeoff Le Duy Y as king of Annam.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，孝敬憲皇后發引，上奉皇太后送至泰陵。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the coffin of Empress Xiaojingxian was moved; the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, escorted it to Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the late empress's coffin set out and the Emperor escorted it to Tailing with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，葬世宗於泰陵，孝敬憲皇后祔。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: Shizong was buried at Tailing and Empress Xiaojingxian was enshrined beside him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Yongzheng was buried at Tailing with his empress enshrined together.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，世宗憲皇帝、孝敬憲皇后升祔太廟，頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Emperor Shizong and Empress Xiaojingxian were enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple; an edict of general grace was issued with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Yongzheng and his empress entered the ancestral temple and a graded amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命保德等頒升祔詔於朝鮮。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Baode and others were ordered to proclaim the enshrinement edict in Korea.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Baode's mission carried the enshrinement edict to Korea.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，涂天相罷。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Tu Tianxiang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Tu Tianxiang left office.

sentences.zh: 以趙弘恩為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Zhao Hongen was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hongen became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 以顧琮協辦吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Gu Cong was appointed to assist in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong was assigned to assist the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命翰林、科道輪進經史奏議。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Hanlin and censorate officials were ordered to present memorials on the classics and histories in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Hanlin and censorate scholars were told to submit rotating essays on the classics.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，移右衛將軍駐歸化新城，增副都統二。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Right Guard general was moved to station at the new city of Guihua and two deputy commanders were added.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Right Guard headquarters shifted to Guihua New City with two new deputies.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，調碩色為四川巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Shuo Se was transferred to be Sichuan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Shuo Se became Sichuan governor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，調楊永斌為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Yang Yongbin was transferred to be Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Yang Yongbin became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 四月甲子，以旱命刑部清理庶獄。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiazi: because of drought, the Ministry of Justice was ordered to review ordinary prisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, drought prompted a Ministry of Justice review of common cases.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，訓飭建言諸臣。

translations.literal: On day yimao, memorializing officials were admonished and instructed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, officials who offered advice received imperial correction.

sentences.zh: 己巳，疏濬清口並江南運河。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Qingkou outlet and the Jiangnan Grand Canal were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, dredging began at Qingkou and on the Jiangnan canal.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇江寧、常州二府旱災。

translations.literal: Drought relief was granted for Nanjing and Changzhou prefectures in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu's Nanjing and Changzhou received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，祀天於圜丘，奉世宗配饗，次日頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Heaven was sacrificed at the Round Mound with Shizong as collateral spirit; the next day an edict of general grace was issued with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Round Mound sacrifice paired Yongzheng; a graded amnesty followed next day.

sentences.zh: 是日，雨。

translations.literal: That day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell that day.

sentences.zh: 釋傅爾丹、陳泰、岳鍾琪。

translations.literal: Furdan, Chen Tai, and Yue Zhongqi were released.
translations.idiomatic: Furdan, Chen Tai, and Yue Zhongqi were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免順天直隸額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, registered tax quotas in Shuntian and Zhili were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Zhili land taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己卯，召尹繼善來京。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Yin Jishan was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Yin Jishan was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以張允隨署雲南總督。

translations.literal: Zhang Yunsui was made acting Yunnan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yunsui became acting governor-general of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，免湖北漢川等五州縣衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, flood tax quotas were remitted for five prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Hankou in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, five Hubei districts had flood taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 南掌入貢。

translations.literal: Lan Xang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Xang presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，免江蘇蕭、碭二縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, flood tax quotas were remitted for Xiao and Dang counties in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, two Jiangsu counties had flood taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，賜于敏中等三百二十四人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renchen: Yu Minzhong and three hundred twenty-four others were granted jinshi degrees and metropolitan graduate status in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, 324 candidates including Yu Minzhong received jinshi honors.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，免湖北荊州、安陸二府水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guisi, flood tax quotas were remitted for Jingzhou and Anlu prefectures in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, two Hubei prefectures had flood taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賑河南南陽等十二州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, flood relief was granted for twelve prefectures and counties including Nanyang in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, twelve Henan districts received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，御試翰林、詹事等官，擢陳大受等三員為一等，餘各升黜有差。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Hanlin, Household, and other officials were examined by the Emperor; Chen Dashou and two others were raised to first rank, the rest promoted or demoted with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the palace examination ranked Chen Dashou and two others first among the Hanlin corps.

sentences.zh: 准本年新進士條奏地方利弊。

translations.literal: This year's new jinshi were permitted to memorialize on local advantages and disadvantages.
translations.idiomatic: New degree-holders could submit memorials on provincial policy.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免山東正項錢糧一百萬兩。

translations.literal: On day wushen, one million taels of Shandong's principal grain tax were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Shandong's grain tax was cut by one million taels.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祭地於方澤，奉世宗配饗。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Earth was sacrificed at the Square Mound with Shizong as collateral spirit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Square Mound rite paired Yongzheng as collateral spirit.

sentences.zh: 除廣東開建、恩平二縣米稅。

translations.literal: Rice tax was abolished for Kaijian and Enping counties in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong abolished rice tax in two counties.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，除湖南永州等處額外稅。

translations.literal: On day yimao, extra levies were abolished in Yongzhou and other places in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Hunan's surplus levies were removed.

sentences.zh: 免安徽宿州水災額賦。

translations.literal: Flood tax quotas were remitted for Suzhou in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui's Suzhou had flood taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 免浙江仁和等四州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: Flood tax quotas were remitted for four prefectures and counties including Renhe in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Four Zhejiang districts had flood taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 賑陝西商南、膚施等縣雹災。

translations.literal: Hail relief was granted for Shangnan, Fushi, and other counties in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi hail districts including Shangnan received relief.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以御門聽政，澍雨優渥，賜執事諸臣紗疋有差。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, because the Emperor held court at the gate and timely rain fell abundantly, gauze lengths were bestowed on attending officials in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, good rain at court prompted gifts of gauze to officials.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命直隸試行區田法。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Zhili was ordered to trial the district-field farming method.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Zhili was told to test Zhao Xu's district-field system.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賑安徽石埭等六州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, flood relief was granted for six prefectures and counties including Shizhi in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, six Anhui districts received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，以永定河決，遣侍衛策楞等分赴盧溝橋、良鄉撫恤災民。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuzi: because the Yongding River breached, guards Celeng and others were sent separately to Lugou Bridge and Liangxiang to comfort disaster victims.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Yongding River floods sent Celeng and others to aid victims at Lugou and Liangxiang.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命侍衛松福等往文安、霸州等處撫恤災民。

translations.literal: On day guimao, guards Song Fu and others were sent to Wen'an, Bazhou, and other places to comfort disaster victims.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Song Fu's party relieved flood victims in Hebei towns.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命顧琮勘永定河衝決各工。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Gu Cong was ordered to inspect each breach work on the Yongding River.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Gu Cong was assigned to survey Yongding River break sites.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賑山東德平、陽穀等州縣旱雹各災。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, drought and hail relief was granted for Deping, Yanggu, and other districts of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Shandong districts including Deping and Yanggu received drought and hail relief.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賑順直宛平、清苑等八十一州縣衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day renyin, drought relief was granted for eighty-one prefectures, counties, and garrisons of Shuntian including Wanping and Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, eighty-one Shuntian districts received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 御試續到博學鴻詞於體仁閣，授萬松齡等官。

translations.literal: At the Hall of Cultivating Humanity the Emperor held the palace examination for the supplemental erudite scholars and appointed Wan Songling and others to office.
translations.idiomatic: Supplemental erudite scholars were examined at Tiren Hall; Wan Songling and others received posts.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命各省蠲免額賦，已輸者抵作次年正賦，著為令。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, provinces were ordered to remit quota land tax; amounts already paid were to count toward the next year's regular levy—established as a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, quota tax remissions were ordered; prepayments could offset next year's levy by rule.

sentences.zh: 賑安徽黟縣等十四州縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was granted for fourteen prefectures and counties of Anhui including Yixian.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Anhui districts including Yixian received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳朔，賑陝西安塞等三縣雹災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day dingsi: hail relief was granted for three counties of Shaanxi including Ansai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon of dingsi, three Shaanxi counties received hail relief.

sentences.zh: 湖南城步縣瑤匪平。

translations.literal: Yao bandits in Chengbu county, Hunan, were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's Chengbu Yao rebels were subdued.

sentences.zh: 賑撫甘肅平番等四縣旱災。

translations.literal: Drought relief was granted for four counties of Gansu including Pingfan.
translations.idiomatic: Four Gansu counties including Pingfan received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 命巡漕御史四員分駐淮安、濟寧、天津、通州。

translations.literal: Four grain-transport censors were ordered to station separately at Huai'an, Jining, Tianjin, and Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Four canal censors were posted to Huai'an, Jining, Tianjin, and Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命鄂爾泰詳勘直隸河道水利。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Ortai was ordered to investigate Zhili river and waterworks in detail.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Ortai was told to survey Zhili waterways.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以顧琮署直隸河道總督。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Gu Cong was made acting governor-general of Zhili river works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Gu Cong became acting Zhili river governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免江蘇碭山水災未完額賦十分之七。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, seven-tenths of unpaid quota tax for flood in Dangshan, Jiangsu, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Dangshan's flood tax arrears were cut by seventy percent.

sentences.zh: 壬午，復設貴州威寧鎮總兵官。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the post of commander at Weining garrison in Guizhou was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Guizhou's Weining garrison commander was reinstated.

sentences.zh: 築浙江魚鱗大石海塘。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang fish-scale stone seawall was built.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's stone seawall was constructed.

sentences.zh: 免山東歷城等二十八州縣衛本年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: This year's drought quota tax was remitted for twenty-eight prefectures, counties, and garrisons of Shandong including Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-eight Shandong districts including Licheng had drought taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賑甘肅會寧旱災，福建霞浦等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, drought relief was granted for Huining, Gansu, and flood relief for Xiapu and other districts of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Gansu drought and Fujian flood districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，調北路參贊大臣哈岱回京，以瑪尼代之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinmao: Northern Route deputy commissioner Hadai was recalled to the capital; Mani replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Hadai left the northern front and Mani took his post.

sentences.zh: 乙未，準噶爾回民米爾哈書爾來降。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Dzungar Muslim Mir Hashur submitted.
