translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Dzungar Mir Hashur surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以楊永斌為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Yang Yongbin was made governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Yang Yongbin became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賑福建閩縣等沿海風災。

translations.literal: On day jihai, coastal wind disaster relief was granted for Min county and other Fujian districts.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Fujian coastal wind victims received relief.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，訓飭科道毋挾私言事。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, censors were admonished not to memorialize out of private motive.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, censors were warned against partisan memorializing.

sentences.zh: 召史貽直入都。

translations.literal: Shi Yizhi was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yizhi was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以德沛為湖廣總督，元展成為甘肅巡撫。

translations.literal: De Pei was made governor-general of Huguang; Yuan Zhancheng was made governor of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: De Pei took Huguang; Yuan Zhancheng, Gansu.

sentences.zh: 賑山西興縣等十二州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Drought relief was granted for twelve prefectures and counties of Shanxi including Xing county.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Shanxi districts including Xing county received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賑甘肅寧夏縣水災。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, flood relief was granted for Ningxia county, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Ningxia county received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，免雲南寧州上年夏稅。

translations.literal: On day guichou, last year's summer tax for Ning prefecture, Yunnan, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Yunnan's Ningzhou had last summer's tax forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以那蘇圖署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Nasutu was made acting Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Nasutu became acting Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 閏九月癸亥，免河南西華等四縣本年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, day guihai: this year's flood quota tax was remitted for four counties of Henan including Xihua.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, four Henan counties had flood taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以尹繼善為刑部尚書，兼辦兵部事。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Yin Jishan was made Minister of Punishments, concurrently handling Ministry of War affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Yin Jishan took Punishments and war duties.

sentences.zh: 調慶復為雲南總督。

translations.literal: Qing Fu was transferred to be governor-general of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Fu became Yunnan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以那蘇圖為兩江總督。

translations.literal: Nasutu was made governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: Nasutu became Two Jiangs governor-general.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賑長蘆、蘆臺等場水災灶戶。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, flood relief was granted for salt-households at Changlu, Lutai, and other salterns.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, saltern flood victims at Changlu and Lutai received relief.

sentences.zh: 除江西袁州、饒州二府雜稅。

translations.literal: Miscellaneous taxes in Yuanzhou and Raozhou prefectures, Jiangxi, were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi abolished surtaxes in Yuanzhou and Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，馬蘭峪陵工竣。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, work at the Malanyu mausoleum was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Malanyu tomb works were finished.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賑福建霞浦等二縣風災。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, wind disaster relief was granted for Xiapu and one other Fujian county.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, two Fujian counties received wind relief.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賑奉天小清河驛水災。

translations.literal: On day renwu, flood relief was granted for Xiaoqing River post station in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Fengtian's Xiaoqing River station received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 以雲南布政使陳宏謀瀆奏本省墾務，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Yunnan provincial treasurer Chen Hongmou was referred for stern review for disrespectful memorializing on provincial land reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hongmou faced discipline for a disrespectful reclamation memorial.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇上元等二十五州縣水災，並加賑有差。

translations.literal: Flood relief was granted for twenty-five prefectures and counties of Jiangsu including Shangyuan, with supplemental relief in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-five Jiangsu districts received flood relief with extra grants by case.

sentences.zh: 賑貴州安順等府廳縣雹災。

translations.literal: Hail relief was granted for Anshun and other prefectures and districts of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou hail districts including Anshun received relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉朔，賑山西永濟等三縣霜災。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day yiyou: frost relief was granted for three counties of Shanxi including Yongji.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the new moon of yiyou, three Shanxi counties received frost relief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，修盛京三陵。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the three mausoleums at Mukden were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Mukden's three imperial tombs were restored.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上詣東陵。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor went to the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor paid respects at Zhaoxi, Xiaoling, and Xiaodong tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, he worshipped at Zhaoxi, Xiaoling, and Xiaodong.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙申，安西鎮總兵張嘉翰坐剝削軍需論斬。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Zhang Jiahan, garrison commander at Anxi, was sentenced to death for extorting military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Anxi commander Zhang Jiahan was condemned to death for squeezing the army.

sentences.zh: 以崔紀為陝西巡撫，尹會一為河南巡撫，張楷為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Cui Ji was made governor of Shaanxi; Yin Huiyi governor of Henan; Zhang Kai governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Ji took Shaanxi; Yin Huiyi, Henan; Zhang Kai, Hubei.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大學士尹泰乞休，溫諭留之。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Grand Secretary Yin Tai requested retirement; a warm edict kept him in office.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Yin Tai's retirement plea was met with a stay.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賑山東齊河等二十八州衛水災。

translations.literal: On day guimao, flood relief was granted for twenty-eight prefectures and garrisons of Shandong including Qihe.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, twenty-eight Shandong districts received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 免江南淳縣本年蟲災額賦，桃源等三縣未完銀米。

translations.literal: This year's insect-disaster quota tax was remitted for Chun county, Jiangnan; unpaid silver and grain for Taoyuan and two other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Chun county's insect tax was forgiven; Taoyuan and two counties had arrears cleared.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賑黑龍江水災。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, flood relief was granted in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Heilongjiang flood victims received relief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，修奉先殿。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Hall of Imperial Ancestors was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Fengxian Hall was restored.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免甘肅平番旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, drought quota tax was remitted for Pingfan, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Pingfan's drought tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，賑安徽壽州、霍丘旱災。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yimao: drought relief was granted for Shouzhou and Huoqiu, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Shouzhou and Huoqiu received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 免陝西靖邊等八州縣本年水災額賦。

translations.literal: This year's flood quota tax was remitted for eight prefectures and counties of Shaanxi including Jingbian.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Shaanxi districts including Jingbian had flood taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，朝鮮國王李昑請封世子李愃，禮部言年未及歲，上特允之。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Korea's king Yi Gyeong asked to invest his heir Yi Sado; the Ministry of Rites said he was under age, but the Emperor specially granted it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Korea's heir investiture was granted despite his youth.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賑貴州郎岱等三廳縣雹災。

translations.literal: On day guihai, hail relief was granted for three subprefectures and counties of Guizhou including Langdai.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, three Guizhou districts received hail relief.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，除山西河津被水額賦。

translations.literal: On day yichou, flooded quota tax at Hejin, Shanxi, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Hejin's flood tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賑安徽太平等十一州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, flood relief was granted for eleven prefectures, counties, and garrisons of Anhui including Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, eleven Anhui districts received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上詣泰陵，改總管為副都統。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor went to Tailing; the chief steward was changed to vice commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, at Tailing the chief steward became a vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 免江南銅山、碭山二縣逋賦。

translations.literal: Arrears were remitted for Tongshan and Dangshan, Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan's Tongshan and Dangshan tax arrears were cleared.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，祭告泰陵，上釋服。

translations.literal: On day renyin, sacrifice was reported at Tailing; the Emperor ended mourning dress.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Tailing rites were reported and mourning dress ended.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賑甘肅環縣、蘭州，廣東三水等十縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day yihai, drought relief was granted for Huan county and Lanzhou, Gansu, and ten counties of Guangdong including Sanshui.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Gansu and Guangdong drought districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 上還京師。

translations.literal: The Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，皇太后聖壽節，御慈寧宮，上率諸王大臣行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, on the Empress Dowager's birthday she took the seat at Cining Palace; the Emperor led princes and ministers in congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the court congratulated the Empress Dowager at Cining Palace.

sentences.zh: 自是每年如之。

translations.literal: Henceforth this was done every year.
translations.idiomatic: The birthday rite became annual.

sentences.zh: 己卯，免山西興縣等四州縣旱災丁銀。

translations.literal: On day jimao, drought poll-tax silver was remitted for four prefectures and counties of Shanxi including Xing county.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, four Shanxi districts had drought poll tax forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命仍設軍機處，以大學士鄂爾泰、張廷玉，尚書訥親、海望，侍郎納延泰、班第為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Grand Council was ordered re-established; Grand Secretaries Ortai and Zhang Tingyu, Ministers Neqin and Haiwang, and Vice Ministers Nayantai and Bandi were made grand councillors.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Grand Council returned with Ortai, Zhang Tingyu, Neqin, Haiwang, Nayantai, and Bandi.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申朔，漕運總督補熙免，以查克丹代之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day jiashen: grain transport director Bu Xi was dismissed; Zhakedan replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Bu Xi left the grain transport post and Zhakedan succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 以來保為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Laibao was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Laibao became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 免江南阜寧上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Last year's flood quota tax was remitted for Funing, Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Funing's prior flood tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上御太和殿，冊立嫡妃富察氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor took the throne at the Hall of Supreme Harmony and invested his principal consort of the Fuca clan as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Fuca consort was invested empress at Taihe Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊子，奉皇太后御慈寧宮，上率諸王大臣行慶賀禮畢，上御太和殿，群臣慶賀，頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Empress Dowager was escorted to Cining Palace; after princes and ministers congratulated, the Emperor took the Hall of Supreme Harmony, officials congratulated, and an amnesty edict was issued with graduated grace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, empress rites brought court congratulations and a graded amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，免江蘇溧水等十二州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, flood quota tax was remitted for twelve prefectures and counties of Jiangsu including Lishui.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, twelve Jiangsu districts had flood taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賑陝西府谷等三縣雹災。

translations.literal: On day renchen, hail relief was granted for three counties of Shaanxi including Fugu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, three Shaanxi counties received hail relief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以冊立皇后禮成，加上皇太后徽號曰崇慶慈宣皇太后。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, because the empress investiture was complete, the Empress Dowager received the honorific Chongqing Cixuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the empress rite brought the honorific Chongqing Cixuan.

sentences.zh: 奉皇太后御慈寧宮，上率諸王大臣行慶賀禮，次日頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager was escorted to Cining Palace; the Emperor led congratulations; next day an amnesty edict with graduated grace was issued.
translations.idiomatic: Cining congratulations were followed next day by a graded amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免直隸本年旱災灶課。

translations.literal: On day jihai, this year's drought saltern levy was remitted in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Zhili's drought saltern tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 免甘肅寧夏水災額賦。

translations.literal: Flood quota tax was remitted for Ningxia, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia's flood tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，鄂爾泰封三等伯。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Ortai was enfeoffed as third-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Ortai became a third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 賑福建閩縣等六縣、廣東海康等七縣風潮災。

translations.literal: Wind and tide disaster relief was granted for six counties of Fujian including Min and seven counties of Guangdong including Haikang.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian and Guangdong wind-tide districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 大學士邁柱乞病，許之。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Mai Zhu requested leave for illness; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Mai Zhu retired sick with approval.

sentences.zh: 琉球貢方物。

translations.literal: Ryukyu sent tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，張廷玉封三等伯。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Zhang Tingyu was enfeoffed as third-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Zhang Tingyu became a third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賑涿州水災。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, flood relief was granted for Zhuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Zhuozhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲寅朔，上初舉元正朝賀，率王以下文武大臣詣壽康宮慶賀皇太后，禮成，御太和殿受賀。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, new moon on day jiayin: the Emperor for the first time held New Year's court; he led princes and civil and military officials to congratulate the Empress Dowager at Shoukang Palace, then took the Hall of Supreme Harmony to receive congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3, on the New Year new moon, Hongli first held court and congratulated the empress dowager at Shoukang.

sentences.zh: 自是每年元正如之。

translations.literal: Henceforth this was done every New Year.
translations.idiomatic: The New Year court rite became annual.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以福敏為武英殿大學士，馬爾泰為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Fu Min was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory; Maertai was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Fu Min joined the Grand Secretariat and Maertai became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祈穀於上帝，奉世宗配享。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, prayer for grain was offered to Heaven with Shizong associated in the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the grain prayer paired Yongzheng as collateral spirit.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命舉行經筵。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Classics lecture was ordered held.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Classics lecture was restored.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上初幸圓明園，奉皇太后居申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor for the first time visited the Old Summer Palace; the Empress Dowager was lodged at Shenyiyang Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Hongli first went to Yuanmingyuan and lodged the empress dowager at Shenyiyang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，御正大光明殿，賜朝正外籓及內大臣、大學士宴。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, at the Hall of Rectitude and Bright Light he gave a banquet to foreign tributaries at New Year court and to inner ministers and grand secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, he feasted tributary envoys and inner ministers at Zhengda Guangming.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以朱藻為直隸河道總督，顧琮協理河道事。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Zhu Zao was made Zhili river governor-general; Gu Cong assisted river affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Zhu Zao took Zhili rivers and Gu Cong assisted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，準噶爾噶爾丹策零遣使奉表至京，並進貂皮。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Dzungar Galdan Tseren sent envoys bearing a memorial to the capital with sable furs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Galdan Tseren's envoys arrived with tribute sables.

sentences.zh: 遣侍郎阿克敦充正使，御前侍衛旺扎爾、乾清門台吉額默根充副使，齎敕往準噶爾議定界。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Agedun was sent as chief envoy; bodyguard Wangzhar and Qianqingmen taiji Emergen as deputies, bearing an imperial letter to fix borders with the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: Agedun led envoys Wangzhar and Emergen to the Dzungars to settle the frontier.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上自圓明園還宮。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor returned from the Old Summer Palace to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor left Yuanmingyuan for the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以謁泰陵，命鄂爾泰在京總理事務。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, because the Emperor was visiting Tailing, Ortai was ordered to manage affairs in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Ortai ran Beijing while the emperor went to Tailing.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，釋奠先師孔子。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: sacrifice was offered to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dinghai day, Confucius was honored.

sentences.zh: 戊子，幸圓明園。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, he visited the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, he went to Yuanmingyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，準噶爾使入覲，賞銀幣有差。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Dzungar envoy had audience; silver and coins were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Dzungar envoy was received and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor paid respects at Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Emperor worshipped at Tailing.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上祭泰陵。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor sacrificed at Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor offered sacrifice at Tailing.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor visited the Southern Park for the hunt enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for a hunting round.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，舉行經筵。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Classics lecture was held.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Classics lecture was held.

sentences.zh: 自是每季仲月舉行一次，歲以為常。

translations.literal: From this it was held once each middle month of the season, and this became the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter it was held once in each season's middle month as a fixed yearly practice.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免山東齊河等三十二州縣衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, assessed tax quotas for thirty-two prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Shandong including Qihe were remitted on account of flood.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, flood-assessed tax quotas were remitted for thirty-two Shandong districts including Qihe.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上親耕耤田，加一推。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor personally ploughed the sacred field, adding one furrow.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor personally ploughed the sacred field with one extra push of the plough.

sentences.zh: 自是每年如之。

translations.literal: From this it was so every year.
translations.idiomatic: This became the annual practice thereafter.

sentences.zh: 壬子，趙弘恩以納賄奪職，以高其倬為工部尚書，張渠為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Zhao Hong'en was stripped of office for taking bribes; Gao Qizhuo was made Minister of Works and Zhang Qu Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Zhao Hong'en lost his post for bribery; Gao Qizhuo became Works Minister and Zhang Qu Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑朔，賑福建閩縣等八縣颶風災。

translations.literal: Third month, first day guichou: relief was given for typhoon damage in eight counties of Fujian including Min county.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the first guichou day, eight Fujian counties including Min were relieved after a typhoon.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上詣太學釋奠，御彝倫堂，命講中庸、尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor went to the Imperial Academy for the sacrifice, ascended the Hall of Constant Norms, and ordered lectures on the Doctrine of the Mean and the Documents.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor offered sacrifice at the Academy, took the Hall of Constant Norms, and ordered lectures on the Mean and the Documents.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，調崔紀為湖北巡撫，張楷為西安巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Cui Ji was transferred to be Hubei governor and Zhang Kai Xi'an governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Cui Ji became Hubei governor and Zhang Kai Xi'an governor.

sentences.zh: 己未，免江蘇六合等十二州縣水災額賦，廣東三水等十州縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, flood-assessed quotas were remitted for twelve Jiangsu districts including Liuhe, and drought-assessed quotas for ten Guangdong districts including Sanshui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, water and drought tax quotas were remitted for Jiangsu and Guangdong districts.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賑江蘇上元等二十五州縣衛水災，並免額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, twenty-five Jiangsu districts including Shangyuan were relieved for flood, and assessed quotas were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, twenty-five Jiangsu districts were relieved and their tax quotas remitted after floods.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 辛未，免甘肅蘭州等處旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, drought-assessed tax quotas for Gansu places including Lanzhou were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, drought tax quotas were remitted for Gansu districts including Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以旱命刑部清理庶獄。

translations.literal: On day renshen, because of drought the Ministry of Punishments was ordered to clear common criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, drought prompted orders to review ordinary prisons at the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，免安徽太平等十一州縣衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, flood-assessed quotas for eleven Anhui districts including Taiping were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, flood tax quotas were remitted for eleven Anhui districts including Taiping.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免湖北沔陽州逋賦。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, tax arrears for Hubei's Mianyang prefecture were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Mianyang's tax arrears in Hubei were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，以旱申命求言。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: because of drought an edict again ordered memorials with counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, drought led to renewed orders for candid memorials.

sentences.zh: 停督撫貢獻。

translations.literal: Governors' and governors-general's tribute offerings were halted.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial tribute from governors was suspended.

sentences.zh: 理籓院尚書僧格休致，以納延泰代之。

translations.literal: Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs Sengge retired; Nayantai replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Colonial Affairs Minister Sengge retired and Nayantai took his place.

sentences.zh: 己丑，調孫嘉淦為吏部尚書，以趙國麟為刑部尚書，孫國璽為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Sun Jia'gan was transferred to Minister of Personnel; Zhao Guolin was made Minister of Punishments and Sun Guoxi Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Sun Jia'gan became Personnel Minister; Zhao Guolin became Punishments Minister and Sun Guoxi Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命顧琮往直隸會同朱藻辦理河工。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Gu Zong was ordered to Zhili to join Zhu Zao in managing river works.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Gu Zong was sent to Zhili to manage rivers with Zhu Zao.

sentences.zh: 免長蘆蘆臺等場、衡水等州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: Flood-assessed quotas were remitted for Changlu saltworks including Lutai and districts including Hengshui.
translations.idiomatic: Flood tax quotas were remitted for Changlu salt fields and Hengshui districts.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，賑陝西蒲城等十州縣雹災。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guichou: ten Shaanxi districts including Pucheng were relieved for hail damage.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, ten Shaanxi districts including Pucheng were relieved after hail.

sentences.zh: 己未，賑山東章丘等州縣衛雹災。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Shandong districts including Zhangqiu were relieved for hail.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Shandong hail-struck districts including Zhangqiu were relieved.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賑陝西雒南等八州縣雹災。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, eight Shaanxi districts including Luonan were relieved for hail.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, eight Shaanxi districts including Luonan were relieved after hail.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，貴州定番州苗阿沙等作亂，張廣泗討平之。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Miao Asha and others of Guizhou's Dingfan prefecture rebelled; Zhang Guangsi suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Dingfan Miao rebels led by Asha were suppressed by Zhang Guangsi.

sentences.zh: 辛未，調額爾圖為奉天將軍，博第為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, E'ertu was transferred to Fengtian general and Bodi Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, E'ertu became Fengtian general and Bodi Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免江南松江府額賦。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Jiangnan's Songjiang prefecture's assessed quota was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Songjiang's assessed tax quota in Jiangnan was remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賑陝西靖邊等八州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, eight Shaanxi districts including Jingbian were relieved for drought.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, eight drought-struck Shaanxi districts including Jingbian were relieved.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，賑山東東平等四州縣雹災。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengyin: four Shandong districts including Dongping were relieved for hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, four Shandong districts including Dongping were relieved after hail.

sentences.zh: 丙午，左都御史楊汝穀乞休，允之。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Left Censor-in-chief Yang Rugu asked to retire; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Left Censor-in-chief Yang Rugu's retirement request was approved.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，起前左都御史彭維新為原官。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renzi: former Left Censor-in-chief Peng Weixin was recalled to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, former Left Censor Peng Weixin was reappointed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免福建詔安縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, drought-assessed quota for Fujian's Zhao'an county was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Zhao'an's drought tax quota in Fujian was remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，免浙江溫州等衛漕欠。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, grain-transport arrears for Zhejiang garrisons including Wenzhou were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Wenzhou garrison grain-transport arrears in Zhejiang were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，調史貽直為工部尚書，高其倬為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Shi Yizhi was transferred to Minister of Works and Gao Qizhuo Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Shi Yizhi became Works Minister and Gao Qizhuo Revenue Minister.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命查郎阿入閣辦事。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Zhalang'a was ordered to enter the Grand Secretariat to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Zhalang'a was ordered into the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 調鄂彌達為川陝總督。

translations.literal: E'mida was transferred to be governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: E'mida became Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以馬爾泰為兩廣總督，查克丹為左都御史，託時為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Ma'ertai was made governor-general of the Two Guangs, Chakedan Left Censor-in-chief, and Tuo Shi grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Ma'ertai took the Two Guangs, Chakedan the left censorate, and Tuo Shi the grain transport post.

sentences.zh: 大學士尹泰乞休，允之。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Yintai asked to retire; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Yintai's retirement was approved.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，江蘇海州、山東郯城等州縣蝗。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: locusts in Jiangsu's Haizhou and Shandong's Tancheng and other districts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, locusts struck Haizhou in Jiangsu and Tancheng in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 賑湖南石門縣、甘肅武威等三縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for floods in Hunan's Shimen county and three Gansu counties including Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: Shimen in Hunan and three Gansu counties including Wuwei were relieved after floods.

sentences.zh: 己丑，海望丁憂，以訥親暫署戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Haiwang entered mourning; Neqin was made acting Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Haiwang went into mourning and Neqin acted as Revenue Minister.

sentences.zh: 己亥，奉皇太后謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor led the Empress Dowager to visit Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor led the Empress Dowager to Tailing.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上詣泰陵行三周年祭禮。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor went to Tailing to perform the third-anniversary sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor performed the third-anniversary rites at Tailing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上奉皇太后駐蹕南苑，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor lodged the Empress Dowager at the Southern Park and went on a hunting round.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Empress Dowager lodged at the Southern Park while the Emperor hunted.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賑安徽望江等四十八州衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day wushen, forty-eight Anhui districts and garrisons including Wangjiang were relieved for drought.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, forty-eight drought-struck Anhui districts including Wangjiang were relieved.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌朔，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day gengxu: the Emperor led the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the first gengxu of the ninth month, the Emperor and Empress Dowager returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 免陝西長安等十五州縣雹災額賦。

translations.literal: Hail-assessed tax quotas for fifteen Shaanxi districts including Chang'an were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Hail tax quotas were remitted for fifteen Shaanxi districts including Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 賑山東招遠縣雹災。

translations.literal: Shandong's Zhaoyuan county was relieved for hail damage.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoyuan in Shandong was relieved after hail.

sentences.zh: 戊午，免福建漳浦上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, last year's drought-assessed quota for Fujian's Zhangpu was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Zhangpu's prior-year drought tax quota in Fujian was remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命嵇曾筠入閣辦事，兼理永定河務。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Ji Zengyun was ordered to enter the Grand Secretariat to handle affairs and concurrently to manage Yongding River works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Ji Zengyun entered the Grand Secretariat and took charge of Yongding River works.

sentences.zh: 裁浙江總督，復設巡撫，以郝玉麟仍為閩浙總督，盧焯為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang governor-generalship was abolished and the governorship restored; Hao Yulin remained Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Lu Chao Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's governor-general post was cut and a governor restored; Hao Yulin stayed Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Lu Chao became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，朱藻解任，遣訥親、孫嘉淦往鞫之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Zhu Zao was relieved; Neqin and Sun Jia'gan were dispatched to try him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Zhu Zao left office and Neqin and Sun Jia'gan were sent to investigate him.

sentences.zh: 以顧琮管總河印務。

translations.literal: Gu Zong was put in charge of the seal of the director-general of waterways.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Zong took charge of the Grand Canal director-general's seal.

sentences.zh: 安南入貢。

translations.literal: Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Annam presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大學士尹泰卒。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Grand Secretary Yintai died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Grand Secretary Yintai died.

sentences.zh: 編修彭樹葵進十思箴，上嘉賚之。

translations.literal: Compiler Peng Shukui presented the Ten Reflections Admonition; the Emperor praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Compiler Peng Shukui offered the Ten Reflections Admonition and received imperial praise and gifts.

sentences.zh: 賑甘肅碾伯等處旱災。

translations.literal: Gansu places including Minzhou were relieved for drought.
translations.idiomatic: Drought relief was given for Gansu districts including Minzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免江蘇江寧等五十二州縣衛水災額賦，並賑之。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, flood-assessed quotas for fifty-two Jiangsu districts and garrisons including Jiangning were remitted, and relief was also given.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, fifty-two Jiangsu districts including Jiangning had flood quotas remitted and received relief.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賑臺灣旱災。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Taiwan was relieved for drought.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Taiwan received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰朔，賑陝西安定等六州縣雹災。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day gengchen: six Shaanxi districts including Anding were relieved for hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the first gengchen of the tenth month, six Shaanxi districts including Anding were relieved after hail.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，免山東鄒平等八州縣本年雹災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, this year's hail-assessed quotas for eight Shandong districts including Zouping were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, current-year hail tax quotas were remitted for eight Shandong districts including Zouping.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免直隸被水州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day renwu, tax arrears for flood-struck Zhili districts were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, flood districts in Zhili had tax arrears forgiven.

sentences.zh: 免江蘇、安徽被災各州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: Tax arrears for all disaster-struck districts in Jiangsu and Anhui were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster districts in Jiangsu and Anhui had tax arrears forgiven.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，皇次子永璉薨，輟朝五日，以御極後，親書永璉為皇太子密旨，一切典禮如皇太子儀。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the second imperial son Yonglian died; court was suspended five days; since taking the throne the Emperor had personally written a secret edict naming Yonglian crown prince, and all rites followed crown prince protocol.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the second son Yonglian died and court halted five days; he had been named crown prince in a secret edict at accession, and rites followed crown prince usage.

sentences.zh: 賑安徽懷寧等五十州縣衛旱災。

translations.literal: Fifty Anhui districts and garrisons including Huaining were relieved for drought.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty drought-struck Anhui districts including Huaining were relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，戶部尚書高其倬卒。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Minister of Revenue Gao Qizhuo died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Revenue Minister Gao Qizhuo died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，調任蘭枝為戶部尚書，趙國麟為禮部尚書，史貽直為刑部尚書，以趙殿最為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Ren Lanzhi was transferred to Minister of Revenue, Zhao Guolin Minister of Rites, Shi Yizhi Minister of Punishments, and Zhao Dianzui Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Ren Lanzhi became Revenue Minister, Zhao Guolin Rites Minister, Shi Yizhi Punishments Minister, and Zhao Dianzui Works Minister.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，諡皇太子永璉為端慧皇太子。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Crown Prince Yonglian was given the posthumous title Duanhui Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Crown Prince Yonglian was posthumously titled Duanhui Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 直隸總督李衛以病免，命孫嘉淦署之。

translations.literal: Zhili Governor-General Li Wei was excused on account of illness; Sun Jia'gan was ordered to act in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wei left the Zhili governor-generalship for illness and Sun Jia'gan was ordered to act.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賑浙江吉安等州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Zhejiang districts including Ji'an were relieved for drought.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, drought relief was given for Zhejiang districts including Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 庚子，朝鮮國王李昑表賀上皇太后徽號並冊封皇后，又表謝恩封世子，附進方物。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Korea's King Yeongjo memorialized congratulating the Empress Dowager's honorific title and the empress's investiture, and again memorialized thanks for enfeoffing the heir apparent, presenting tribute goods with the memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, King Yeongjo of Korea sent memorials on the empress dowager's title and empress's investiture, thanked the heir's enfeoffment, and presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上幸田村，奠端慧皇太子。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor visited Tiancun to offer sacrifice to Duanhui Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Emperor went to Tiancun to mourn Duanhui Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，免江南、江西、河南漕欠。

translations.literal: On day guimao, grain-transport arrears for Jiangnan, Jiangxi, and Henan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, grain-transport arrears in Jiangnan, Jiangxi, and Henan were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，授孫嘉淦直隸總督，以甘汝來為吏部尚書兼兵部，楊超曾為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Sun Jia'gan was appointed Zhili governor-general; Gan Rulai was made Minister of Personnel with concurrent charge of War, and Yang Chaozeng Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Sun Jia'gan became Zhili governor-general; Gan Rulai took Personnel with War, and Yang Chaozeng the War Ministry.

sentences.zh: 丙午，授顧琮直隸河道總督。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Gu Zong was appointed Zhili river-course governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Gu Zong became Zhili river-course governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉朔，復廣東海南道為雷瓊道，改高雷道為高廉道。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day jiyou: Guangdong's Hainan circuit was restored as the Lei-Qiong circuit, and the Gao-Lei circuit was renamed the Gao-Lian circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the first jiyou of the eleventh month, Hainan circuit became Lei-Qiong again and Gao-Lei was renamed Gao-Lian.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以孫嘉淦劾貝勒允祜，上嘉之，予議敘。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, because Sun Jia'gan impeached Prince Yunhu, the Emperor praised him and granted merit evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor praised Sun Jia'gan for impeaching Prince Yunhu and ordered him rewarded.

sentences.zh: 允祜下宗人府嚴議。

translations.literal: Yunhu was sent down to the Imperial Clan Court for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yunhu was referred to the Imperial Clan Court for strict judgment.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賑江蘇華亭等六縣衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day renzi, six Jiangsu districts and garrisons including Huating were relieved for drought.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, six drought-struck Jiangsu districts including Huating were relieved.

sentences.zh: 賑湖南石門縣旱災。

translations.literal: Hunan's Shimen county was relieved for drought.
translations.idiomatic: Shimen in Hunan received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，免奉天寧遠等四州縣蟲災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guichou, insect-assessed quotas for four Fengtian districts including Ningyuan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, insect tax quotas were remitted for four Fengtian districts including Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 賑浙江歸安、烏程，陝西綏德等四州縣雹災，湖北孝感等六州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Gui'an and Wucheng in Zhejiang and four Shaanxi districts including Suide were relieved for hail, and six Hubei districts including Xiaogan for drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's Gui'an and Wucheng, four Shaanxi hail districts including Suide, and six Hubei drought districts including Xiaogan were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，免河南信陽等八州縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guichou, drought-assessed quotas for eight Henan districts including Xinyang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, drought tax quotas were remitted for eight Henan districts including Xinyang.

sentences.zh: 賑湖北應山、四川忠州等三州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Hubei's Yingshan, Sichuan's Zhongzhou, and one other district were relieved for drought.
translations.idiomatic: Yingshan in Hubei, Zhongzhou in Sichuan, and one other district received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，免江南淮安、徐州二府湖灘額租。

translations.literal: On day yichou, assessed rent for lake shoals in Jiangnan's Huai'an and Xuzhou prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, lake-shoal rent quotas in Huai'an and Xuzhou in Jiangnan were remitted.

sentences.zh: 免山東招遠縣雹災額賦。

translations.literal: Hail-assessed quota for Shandong's Zhaoyuan county was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoyuan's hail tax quota in Shandong was remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚午，大學士嵇曾筠以病乞休，允之。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Grand Secretary Ji Zengyun asked to retire on account of illness; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Grand Secretary Ji Zengyun's sick-leave retirement was approved.

sentences.zh: 壬申，甘肅寧夏地震，水涌新渠，寶豐縣治沈沒，發蘭州庫銀二十萬兩，命兵部侍郎班第往賑之。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Ningxia in Gansu was shaken by earthquake; water surged into the new canal, Baofeng county seat was submerged, two hundred thousand taels were issued from the Lanzhou treasury, and Vice Minister of War Bandi was ordered to give relief.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, a Ningxia earthquake flooded the new canal and submerged Baofeng; 200,000 taels were sent and Bandi ordered to relieve the disaster.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，吏部尚書性桂乞休，允之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Minister of Personnel Xinggui asked to retire; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Personnel Minister Xinggui's retirement was approved.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免直隸宣化各府州逋賦。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, tax arrears for Zhili prefectures and departments including Xuanhua were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Xuanhua and other Zhili districts had tax arrears forgiven.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯朔，調訥親為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day yimao: Neqin was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the first yimao of the twelfth month, Neqin became Personnel Minister.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賑四川射洪等六縣水災。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, six Sichuan counties including Shehong were relieved for flood.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, six flood-struck Sichuan counties including Shehong were relieved.

sentences.zh: 賑兩淮鹽場本年旱災。

translations.literal: The Two Huai saltworks were relieved for this year's drought.
translations.idiomatic: This year's drought relief was given to the Two Huai salt fields.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，彭維新褫職，以魏廷珍為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Peng Weixin was stripped of office; Wei Tingzhen was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Peng Weixin was dismissed and Wei Tingzhen became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，甘肅寧夏地震。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Ningxia in Gansu was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Ningxia in Gansu suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賑甘肅平番蟲災。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Pingfan in Gansu was relieved for insect damage.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Pingfan in Gansu received relief from insect damage.

sentences.zh: 命大理寺卿汪漋往江南總辦河工。

translations.literal: Wang Huan, Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, was ordered to Jiangnan to take overall charge of river works.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huan was sent to Jiangnan to supervise river works.

sentences.zh: 琉球國王尚敬遣使表賀登極，入貢。

translations.literal: The King of Ryukyu, Shang Jing, sent envoys with a memorial congratulating the enthronement and presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu congratulated the enthronement and presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零遣哈柳等從侍郎阿克敦等至京師，進表。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Dzungar taiji Galdan Tseren sent Khalyu and others with Vice Minister A Kedun and others to the capital to present a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Galdan Tseren sent envoys with A Kedun to present a memorial at court.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，準噶爾使哈柳等入覲，諭曰：「所奏游牧不越阿爾台，朕甚嘉之。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Dzungar envoys Khalyu and others were received in audience; the Emperor instructed: "Your report that your pastoral lands will not cross the Altai—I greatly commend it.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Dzungar envoys were received and the Emperor commended their pledge not to pasture beyond the Altai.

sentences.zh: 托爾和、布延圖卡倫內移，不可行。

translations.literal: Moving the Tuo'erhe and Buyantu cardan posts inland cannot be permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Inward relocation of the Tuo'erhe and Buyantu cardan posts was rejected.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己酉，上御乾清宮西暖閣，召王、大臣、翰林、科道及督、撫、學政在京者九十九人賜宴，賦柏梁體詩。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day jiyou: the Emperor took his seat in the west warm pavilion of the Hall of Heavenly Purity, summoned ninety-nine princes, grand ministers, Hanlin academicians, censors, and governors, governors-general, and education commissioners present in the capital, granted them a banquet, and composed poetry in the Bo Liang form.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year's first month, on jiyou day, the Emperor banqueted ninety-nine officials at the Hall of Heavenly Purity and composed Bo Liang verse.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，免甘肅寧夏等五縣地震被災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, land tax for five counties including Ningxia in Gansu stricken by earthquake was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, earthquake tax relief was granted in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大學士嵇曾筠卒。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Grand Secretary Ji Zengyun died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Grand Secretary Ji Zengyun died.

sentences.zh: 趙國麟為大學士，調任蘭枝為禮部尚書，以陳德華為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Zhao Guolin was made Grand Secretary; Ren Lanzhi was moved to Minister of Rites, and Chen Dehua made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Guolin became Grand Secretary; Ren Lanzhi and Chen Dehua received ministry posts.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，調張渠為江蘇巡撫，以馮光裕為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Second month, day jimao: Zhang Qu was moved to Jiangsu governor, and Feng Guangyu made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Zhang Qu and Feng Guangyu were appointed provincial governors.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，免直隸滄州等四州縣、興國等四場水災灶地額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, land tax on saltern lands in four prefectures and counties including Cangzhou in Zhili and four saltern fields including Xingguo stricken by flood was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, saltern land tax was remitted for flood areas in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 免貴州郎岱等四廳州縣雹災額賦。

translations.literal: Land tax for four subprefectures, prefectures, and counties including Langdai in Guizhou stricken by hail was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Hail disaster tax relief was granted in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，免甘肅靖遠風災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, land tax for Jingyuan in Gansu stricken by wind disaster was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Jingyuan received wind-disaster tax relief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，準噶爾部人孟克特穆爾等來降。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Dzungar tribesmen including Mengke Temur came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Mengke Temur and other Dzungars submitted.

sentences.zh: 免陝西咸寧、鎮安水災，甘肅柳溝衛蟲災額賦。

translations.literal: Land tax for Xianning and Zhen'an in Shaanxi stricken by flood and for Liugou Guard in Gansu stricken by insects was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Flood and insect disaster taxes were remitted in Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，免湖南永順、永綏新辟苗疆鹽課。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the salt levy in newly opened Miao territories of Yongshun and Yongshuo in Hunan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, salt levies were remitted in Hunan's new Miao districts.

sentences.zh: 免浙江上虞等縣逋賦。

translations.literal: Arrears in land tax for counties including Shangyu in Zhejiang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Arrears were forgiven in Zhejiang counties including Shangyu.

sentences.zh: 庚子，準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零請以阿爾泰山為界，許之。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Dzungar taiji Galdan Tseren requested the Altai Mountains as border; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Altai border requested by Galdan Tseren was approved.

sentences.zh: 免湖北鍾祥等五縣衛旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Land tax for five counties and guards including Zhongxiang in Hubei stricken by drought was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Drought tax relief was granted in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未朔，己酉，召雅爾圖來京，以阿蘭泰為北路參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on dingwei; on day jiyou, Yartu was summoned to the capital and Alan Tai made Northern Route Assistant Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Yartu was called to Beijing and Alan Tai became Northern Route assistant commander.

sentences.zh: 免安徽宿州等四州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: Arrears in land tax for four prefectures and counties including Suzhou in Anhui were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tax arrears were remitted in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 吏部奏行取屆期，上命尚書、都御史、侍郎保舉如陸隴其、彭鵬者。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel reported that the period for singled promotion had arrived; the Emperor ordered ministers, censors-in-chief, and vice ministers to recommend men like Lu Longqi and Peng Peng.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered high officials to recommend men of Lu Longqi and Peng Peng's caliber for singled promotion.

sentences.zh: 免湖北應山上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Land tax for Yingshan in Hubei for the previous year stricken by drought was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Prior-year drought tax was remitted in Hubei Yingshan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，設熱河兵備道，駐承德州。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Rehe defense circuit was established, headquartered at Chengde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Rehe defense circuit was set up at Chengde.

sentences.zh: 命訥親協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Neqin was ordered to assist as Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Neqin was assigned to assist the Grand Secretaries.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以旱災特免直隸、江蘇、安徽三省額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, because of drought disaster, land tax for the three provinces of Zhili, Jiangsu, and Anhui was specially remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, drought brought special tax remissions in Zhili, Jiangsu, and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以魏廷珍為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Wei Tingzhen was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Wei Tingzhen became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 賑直隸文安等六縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed to six counties including Wen'an in Zhili stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief was granted in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，免安徽壽州上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingmao: land tax for Shouzhou in Anhui for the previous year stricken by drought was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, prior-year drought tax for Shouzhou was remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，免江蘇丹陽等七縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, land tax for seven counties including Danyang in Jiangsu stricken by drought was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, drought tax relief was granted in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賜莊有恭等三百二十八人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Zhuang Yougong and three hundred twenty-eight others were granted jinshi and other degrees with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Zhuang Yougong and 328 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免長蘆上年旱災逋賦。

translations.literal: On day renwu, arrears in land tax for Changlu for the previous year stricken by drought were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Changlu drought arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以旱申命求言。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, because of drought an order was issued calling for memorialized advice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the drought prompted an appeal for memorialized advice.

sentences.zh: 命刑部清理庶獄，減徒以下罪。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Punishments was ordered to clear routine cases and reduce punishments below exile.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Punishments was ordered to review routine prisons and reduce lesser sentences.

sentences.zh: 甲午，免四川忠州等三州縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, land tax for three prefectures and counties including Zhongzhou in Sichuan stricken by drought was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Sichuan drought taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以陳世倌為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Chen Shiguai was made Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Chen Shiguai became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，西藏巴勒布部庫庫木、顏布、葉楞三汗入貢。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the three khans of the Balipu department of Tibet—Kukum, Yanbu, and Yeling—presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, three Tibetan khans of Balipu presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，朝鮮國王李昑謝賜本國列傳，進方物。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiazi: King Yi Zhen of Korea thanked the grant of his state's biography in the histories and presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Korea's king thanked the dynasty for his state's historical biography and sent gifts.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，改築浙江海寧石塘。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the stone embankment at Haining in Zhejiang was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Haining's stone seawall was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 辛未，致仕大學士馬齊卒。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, retired Grand Secretary Ma Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, retired Grand Secretary Ma Qi died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，加鄂爾泰、張廷玉、福敏太保，徐本、訥親太子太保，甘汝來、海望、鄂善、尹繼昌、徐元夢、孫嘉淦、慶復太子少保。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, E'ertai, Zhang Tingyu, and Fu Min were advanced to Grand Tutor; Xu Ben and Neqin to Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Gan Rulai, Haiwang, E Shan, Yin Jichang, Xu Yuanmeng, Sun Jiagan, and Qing Fu to Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, E'ertai, Zhang Tingyu, Fu Min, Xu Ben, Neqin, and others received honorific tutor titles.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，調碩色為山東巡撫，方顯為四川巡撫。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen: Shuo Se was moved to Shandong governor and Fang Xian to Sichuan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Shuo Se and Fang Xian were reassigned as governors.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，免甘肅赤金所上年被災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, land tax for Chijin Depot in Gansu for the previous year stricken by disaster was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, prior-year disaster tax for Chijin was remitted.

sentences.zh: 山東濟南等七府蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts in seven prefectures of Shandong including Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck seven Jinan-area prefectures in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 曹縣河決，仍賑被水六州縣災民。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Cao County; relief was again distributed to disaster victims in six prefectures and counties stricken by water.
translations.idiomatic: Cao County's river breach brought renewed relief to six flooded prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 甘肅秦安等六州縣雹災。

translations.literal: Hail disaster in six prefectures and counties including Qin'an in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Hail struck six prefectures and counties in Gansu including Qin'an.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，額駙策凌奏率兵駐鄂爾海西拉烏蘇，並分兵駐鄂爾坤河、齊齊爾里克、額爾德尼招、塔密爾、烏里雅蘇台附近，防範準噶爾。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wushen: Imperial son-in-law Celeng memorialized that he had led troops to garrison E'erhai Xilawusu in the west of the Ergune, and detached forces to garrison the Ergune River, Qiqierlik, E'erdennizhao, Tamir, and near Wulia Sutai to guard against the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Celeng reported troop deployments along the Ergune and nearby posts to guard against Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以甘肅秦安等十五州縣雹災，命無論已未成災，悉免本年額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, because fifteen prefectures and counties including Qin'an in Gansu were stricken by hail, an order was issued that whether disaster had already formed or not, this year's land tax was entirely to be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, all current-year tax was remitted for fifteen Gansu hail-hit prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賑河南祥符等四十七州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, relief was distributed to forty-seven prefectures and counties including Xiangfu in Henan stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, flood relief was granted across Henan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賑山東海豐等縣場灶戶。

translations.literal: On day renxu, relief was distributed to saltern households in counties and saltern fields including Haifeng in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Shandong saltern households received relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賑江蘇睢寧等十三州縣衛水雹各災，湖北房縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, relief was distributed with distinctions to thirteen prefectures, counties, and guards including Suining in Jiangsu for flood, hail, and other disasters, and to Fang County in Hubei for drought.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, disaster relief was granted in Jiangsu and drought relief in Hubei Fang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吏部尚書甘汝來卒。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Minister of Personnel Gan Rulai died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Gan Rulai died.

sentences.zh: 以郝玉麟為吏部尚書，宗室德沛為閩浙總督，以班第為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Hao Yulin was made Minister of Personnel, Imperial clansman Depei made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general, and Ban Di made Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yulin, Depei, and Ban Di received high appointments.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賑安徽宿州雹災。

translations.literal: On day jisi, relief was distributed to Suzhou in Anhui stricken by hail.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, hail relief was granted in Anhui Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，安南馬郎叛人矣長等來降。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, An Lechang and other rebel subjects from Ma Lang in Annam came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Annam rebels including Yi Chang submitted.

sentences.zh: 賑山東利津等二縣雹災。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed to two counties including Lijin in Shandong stricken by hail.
translations.idiomatic: Hail relief was granted in Shandong Lijin and another county.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賑直隸開州等州縣、江蘇海州等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day renshen, relief was distributed to prefectures and counties including Kaizhou in Zhili and Haizhou in Jiangsu stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, flood relief was granted in Zhili and Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 江蘇淮安、安徽鳳陽等府州蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts in prefectures and departments including Huai'an in Jiangsu and Fengyang in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts appeared in Jiangsu Huai'an and Anhui Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，御史張湄劾諸大臣阻塞言路。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingzi: Censor Zhang Mei memorialized charging grand ministers with obstructing the avenue of memorialized speech.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Zhang Mei accused senior ministers of blocking memorialized criticism.

sentences.zh: 上斥為漸染方苞惡習，召見滿、漢奏事大臣諭之。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked this as infection by Fang Bao's bad habits and summoned Manchu and Han ministers who reported affairs to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor denounced Zhang Mei's charge as Fang Bao's influence and lectured reporting ministers.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賑河南商丘等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, relief was distributed to prefectures and counties including Shangqiu in Henan stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Henan flood victims received relief.

sentences.zh: 壬午，敘張廣泗經理苗疆功，授三等輕車都尉，黃廷桂等加銜、加級有差。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Zhang Guangsi's achievements in managing the Miao frontier were recorded: he was granted third-rank Light Chariot Commandant, and Huang Tinggui and others received additional titles and grade increases with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Zhang Guangsi was rewarded for Miao frontier service and Huang Tinggui and others were honored.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賑山東歷城等六十六州縣衛所水災，停徵新舊額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, relief was distributed to sixty-six prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Licheng in Shandong stricken by flood, and collection of new and old land tax was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Shandong flood relief was granted and tax collection suspended in sixty-six jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，江蘇金壇縣貢生蔣振生進手鈔十三經，賜國子監學正銜。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Jin Tan county tribute student Jiang Zhensheng presented a handwritten copy of the Thirteen Classics and was granted National University rectory supervisor rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Jiang Zhensheng was rewarded for presenting a manuscript of the Thirteen Classics.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳朔，署廣西提督譚行義以安南鄭氏專柄，清化鎮邵郡公及黎鷟起兵與鄭氏內閧，奏聞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on yisi; Acting Guangxi Provincial Commander Tan Xingyi memorialized that because the Zheng clan of Annam monopolized power, Duke Shao of Qinghua Town and Li Zhuo raised troops in internal strife with the Zheng clan, and reported this.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Tan Xingyi reported civil war in Annam between the Zheng clan and rival forces.

sentences.zh: 丙午，免江蘇海州、贛榆二州被水漕糧。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, grain transport for Haizhou and Ganyu in Jiangsu stricken by flood was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, transport grain was remitted for flooded Haizhou and Ganyu.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賑河南祥符等三十七州縣水災有差。

translations.literal: On day wushen, relief was distributed with distinctions to thirty-seven prefectures and counties including Xiangfu in Henan stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, differentiated flood relief went to thirty-seven Henan jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上奉皇太后謁陵。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to visit the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to the tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor visited Zhaoxi Mausoleum, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, and Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor visited several imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 賑山東臨邑等縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed to counties including Linyi in Shandong stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief was granted in Shandong Linyi and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賑甘肅張掖東樂堡水災。

translations.literal: On day guihai, relief was distributed to Zhangye Dongyue Fort stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Zhangye's Dongyue Fort received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 賑河南鄧州等四州縣水災，山西榆次等三縣旱災。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed to four prefectures and counties including Dengzhou in Henan stricken by flood, and to three counties including Yuci in Shanxi stricken by drought.
translations.idiomatic: Flood and drought relief went to Henan and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 命停徵江蘇、安徽漕糧。

translations.literal: Collection of grain transport for Jiangsu and Anhui was ordered halted.
translations.idiomatic: Transport grain collection was suspended in Jiangsu and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: The Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial party returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上以疾命和親王弘晝代行孟冬時饗禮。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, because of illness the Emperor ordered Prince of Harmony Hong Zhou to perform the mid-winter seasonal sacrifice in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, illness led the Emperor to delegate mid-winter sacrifices to Hong Zhou.

sentences.zh: 免甘肅秦安等十五州縣糧草三分之一，及靈州、碾伯等州縣本年水雹各災額賦。

translations.literal: One-third of grain and fodder levies for fifteen prefectures and counties including Qin'an in Gansu was remitted, and this year's land tax for prefectures and counties including Lingzhou and Nianbo stricken by flood and hail was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tax and fodder relief was granted across Gansu disaster areas.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，準噶爾回人伊斯拉木定來降。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingchou: Dzungar Muslim Yisilamu Ding came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Yisilamu Ding of the Dzungars submitted.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以江蘇海州等四州縣水災，免逋賦。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, because Haizhou and three other prefectures and counties in Jiangsu were stricken by flood, arrears in land tax were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Jiangsu flood areas received arrears relief.

sentences.zh: 甲申，端慧皇太子周年，上幸田村奠酒。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, on the anniversary of the Crown Prince Duanhui, the Emperor visited Tiancun to pour libations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor marked Crown Prince Duanhui's anniversary at Tiancun.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑山東歷城等六十六州縣水災，給葺屋銀。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, relief was distributed to sixty-six prefectures and counties in Shandong stricken by flood, and silver for roof repairs was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Shandong flood victims received relief and repair funds.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，免陝西興平等十六州縣雹災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, land tax for sixteen prefectures and counties including Xingping in Shaanxi stricken by hail was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, hail tax was remitted in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，莊親王允祿、理親王弘晰等緣事，宗人府議削爵圈禁。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Prince Zhuang Yin Lu, Prince of Principle Hong Xi, and others were implicated in a matter; the Imperial Clan Court deliberated stripping titles and confinement.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Yin Lu, Hong Xi, and others faced clan-court punishment.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「莊親王寬免。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Prince Zhuang is to be leniently excused.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor pardoned Prince Zhuang.

sentences.zh: 理親王弘晰、貝勒弘昌、貝子弘普俱削爵。

translations.literal: Prince of Principle Hong Xi, Beile Hong Chang, and Beizi Hong Pu were all stripped of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xi, Hong Chang, and Hong Pu lost their titles.

sentences.zh: 弘升永遠圈禁。

translations.literal: Hong Sheng was permanently confined.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Sheng was placed in permanent confinement.

sentences.zh: 弘晈王爵，系奉皇考特旨，從寬留王號，停俸。

translations.literal: Hong Jiao's princely rank was fixed by special decree of Our late father; from leniency his princely title was retained but stipend was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Jiao kept his princely title but lost his stipend by imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，釋馬蘭泰。

translations.literal: " On day bingshen, Ma Lantai was released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Ma Lantai was freed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，額魯特札薩克多羅郡王、和碩額駙阿寶之妻和碩格格進顧實汗所傳玉璽，諭還之。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the wife of the Eleuth zhasake prince of the first rank and Heshuo imperial son-in-law Abao, a Heshuo princess, presented the jade seal transmitted by Gush Khan; an edict ordered its return.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, a princess returned Gush Khan's jade seal to the court by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，召定邊左副將軍額駙策凌來京。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Celeng, Assistant General on the Northern Pacification Left, was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Celeng was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 封弘勩郡王，襲理親王爵。

translations.literal: Hong Yong was enfeoffed as Prince of the Commandery and inherited the Prince of Principle rank.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Yong became commandery prince and inherited the principality.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor visited the Southern Park for battue.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，上行大閱禮，連發五矢皆中的，賜在事王大臣銀幣有差。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingwu: the Emperor performed the grand review; he shot five arrows in succession and all hit the mark, and the princes and grand ministers involved were granted silver coins with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the Emperor's grand review hit five successive targets and officials were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以郝玉麟署兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Hao Yulin was made acting Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Hao Yulin became acting Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，召尹會一來京，以雅爾圖為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Yin Huiyi was summoned to the capital and Yartu made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Yin Huiyi was recalled and Yartu became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇安東等十五州縣水災有差。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed with distinctions to fifteen prefectures and counties including Andong in Jiangsu stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: Differentiated flood relief was granted in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 壬申，免寧夏次年額賦。

translations.literal: On day renshen, land tax for Ningxia in the following year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, next year's Ningxia land tax was waived.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉朔，免山東金鄉等六州衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on guiyou: land tax for six prefectures and guards including Jinxiang in Shandong stricken by flood was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Shandong flood tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免浙江安吉等州縣漕糧，河南羅山旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, transport grain for prefectures and counties including Anji in Zhejiang was remitted, and land tax for Luoshan in Henan stricken by drought was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Zhejiang transport grain and Henan drought tax were remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，弘晰坐問安泰「準噶爾能否到京，上壽算如何」，擬立絞。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Hong Xi was condemned for asking Antai whether the Dzungars could reach the capital and how the Emperor's lifespan stood; death by strangulation was proposed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Hong Xi faced proposed execution for questioning Antai about Dzungar and imperial affairs.

sentences.zh: 諭免死，永遠圈禁，安泰論絞。

translations.literal: An edict commuted the death penalty to perpetual confinement; Antai was sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: Death sentences were commuted to life imprisonment; Antai was condemned to strangulation.

sentences.zh: 免陝西榆林等十一州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: Arrears of tax were remitted for eleven prefectures and counties including Yulin in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Tax arrears were forgiven in eleven Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Yulin.

sentences.zh: 癸未，免河南祥符等四十四州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, quota taxes were remitted for forty-four prefectures and counties including Xiangfu in Henan on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Henan flood taxes were remitted in forty-four prefectures and counties including Xiangfu.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，晉封貝勒頗羅鼐為郡王。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Beile Poluonai was advanced to prince of a commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Beile Poluonai was promoted to commandery prince.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，免河南商丘等十州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, quota taxes were remitted for ten prefectures and counties including Shangqiu in Henan on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, flood taxes were remitted in ten Henan prefectures and counties including Shangqiu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，哈柳等入覲。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Haliu and others came to court for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Haliu and others presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 甲午，召車臣汗達瑪林等賜茶。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Tsetsen Khan Damalin and others were summoned and granted tea.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Tsetsen Khan Damalin and others were summoned and given tea.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁未，賑安徽宿州等八州縣，廬江等十州縣衛旱災有差。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, day dingwei: relief was distributed with distinctions to eight prefectures and counties including Suzhou in Anhui, and ten prefectures, counties, and guards including Lujiang, on account of drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year, drought relief was given in Anhui and elsewhere with distinctions.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Korea presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命烏赫圖、巴靈阿護準噶爾人赴藏熬茶。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Uhetu and Baling'a were ordered to escort Dzungars to Tibet to boil tea.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Uhetu and Baling'a were ordered to escort Dzungars to Tibet for the tea pilgrimage.

sentences.zh: 湖南綏寧苗作亂，命馮光裕等剿之。

translations.literal: Miao in Suining, Hunan, rose in revolt; Feng Guangyu and others were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Suining Miao rebels in Hunan were ordered suppressed under Feng Guangyu.

sentences.zh: 二月，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Second month: Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Ryukyu presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命額駙策凌等定各部落接準噶爾游牧邊界。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Imperial Son-in-law Celeng and others were ordered to fix the grazing boundaries of each tribe adjoining Dzungar nomads.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Celeng and others were ordered to delimit tribal borders against Dzungar pastures.

sentences.zh: 哈柳歸，召入賜茶，以和議成，嘉獎之。

translations.literal: Haliu returned; he was summoned, granted tea, and commended because the peace negotiations had succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Haliu returned, was summoned and rewarded for securing peace.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以伊勒慎為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Ilershen was made general at Suiyuan City.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Ilershen became Suiyuan City general.

sentences.zh: 癸未，工部尚書魏廷珍罷。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Minister of Works Wei Tingzhen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Wei Tingzhen was removed as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 申諭九卿，毋蹈模稜覆轍。

translations.literal: The Nine Ministers were admonished not to repeat evasive, noncommittal mistakes.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Ministers were warned against equivocating as before.

sentences.zh: 免山東章丘等六十州縣衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for sixty prefectures, counties, and guards including Zhangqiu in Shandong on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: Flood taxes were remitted in sixty Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Zhangqiu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免湖北襄陽縣衛上年額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, last year's quota taxes were remitted for Xiangyang county and guard in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, last year's Hubei taxes were remitted for Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免上年安徽宿州雹災、山東滕縣等五縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renchen, last year's quota taxes were remitted for Suzhou in Anhui on account of hail damage, and for five counties including Teng county in Shandong on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, last year's taxes were remitted for hail in Suzhou and floods in five Shandong counties.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以韓光基為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Han Guangji was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Han Guangji became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，免湖北漢陽等四縣上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, last year's quota taxes were remitted for four counties including Hanyang in Hubei on account of drought damage.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, last year's drought taxes were remitted in four Hubei counties including Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，以尹繼善為川陝總督，鄂善署刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengxu: Yin Jishan was made governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi, and Eshan acting Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Yin Jishan became Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general and Eshan acting Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 壬子，免直隸雄縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renzi, last year's quota taxes were remitted for Xiong county in Zhili on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, last year's flood taxes were remitted for Xiong county in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 甲子，免山東霑化等縣場水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, quota taxes were remitted for saltern districts including Zhanhua in Shandong on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, flood taxes were remitted at Shandong salterns including Zhanhua.

sentences.zh: 庚午，湖南栗林、鬼沖各寨苗匪平。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Miao bandits at Lilin and Guichong stockades in Hunan were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Lilin and Guichong Miao bandits in Hunan were pacified.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，賑兩淮板浦等場災。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingxu: relief was distributed for disasters at salterns including Banpu in the two Huai circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the two Huai salterns including Banpu received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，御史褚泰坐受賄論斬。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Censor Chu Tai, convicted of taking bribes, was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Censor Chu Tai was sentenced to death for bribery.

sentences.zh: 免陝西葭州、懷遠旱災額賦。
