translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for Jiazhou and Huaiyuan in Shaanxi on account of drought damage.
translations.idiomatic: Drought taxes were remitted in Shaanxi's Jiazhou and Huaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以那蘇圖為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Nasutu was made Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Nasutu became Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以旱召九卿面諭，直陳政事闕失。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, because of drought the Nine Ministers were summoned for face-to-face instruction to speak frankly on governmental shortcomings.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, drought led the Emperor to summon the Nine Ministers to report frankly on policy failures.

sentences.zh: 改山東河道為運河道，兗沂曹道為分巡兗、沂、曹三府，管河工。

translations.literal: The Shandong river circuit was renamed the Transport river circuit; the Yan-Yi-Cao circuit was made a separate intendant over Yan, Yi, and Cao prefectures to manage river works.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong river offices were reorganized: transport and Yan-Yi-Cao intendant circuits were redefined for river works.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，任蘭枝及太常寺卿陶正靖坐朋比，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Ren Lanzhi and Court of Imperial Sacrifices director Tao Zhengjing, convicted of factional collusion, were referred for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Ren Lanzhi and Tao Zhengjing were sent for severe review for factional collusion.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiayin: the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiayin day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命刑部清理庶獄。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Ministry of Justice was ordered to clear accumulated common-law prisons.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Ministry of Justice was ordered to clear backlog cases.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以楊超曾署兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Yang Chaozeng was made acting governor-general of the two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Yang Chaozeng became acting governor-general of the two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，諭馮光裕及湖廣提督杜愷剿捕城步、綏寧瑤匪。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Feng Guangyu and Huguang provincial commander Du Kai were instructed to suppress and capture Yao bandits at Chengbu and Suining.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Feng Guangyu and Du Kai were ordered to suppress Yao bandits at Chengbu and Suining.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，命阿里袞、朱必階查勘山東沂州等處水旱災。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou: Aligun and Zhu Bijie were ordered to survey flood and drought damage in places including Yizhou in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Aligun and Zhu Bijie were sent to inspect Shandong flood and drought damage.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命山東、江蘇、安徽捕除蝻子。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Shandong, Jiangsu, and Anhui were ordered to capture and destroy locust nymphs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Shandong, Jiangsu, and Anhui were ordered to eradicate locust nymphs.

sentences.zh: 召張廣泗來京。

translations.literal: Zhang Guangsi was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangsi was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賑甘肅秦州水災。

translations.literal: On day renchen, relief was distributed for flood damage at Qinzhou in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Gansu's Qinzhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，福州將軍隆升坐收餽遺，褫職鞫治。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Fuzhou general Longsheng, convicted of accepting gifts, was stripped of office and tried.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Fuzhou general Longsheng was dismissed and tried for taking gifts.

sentences.zh: 閏六月甲辰，廣西義寧苗作亂，諭馬爾泰赴桂林調度兵事。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day jiachen: Miao in Yining, Guangxi, rose in revolt; Ma'ertai was instructed to proceed to Guilin to direct military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, Yining Miao rebels led Ma'ertai to Guilin to direct troops.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以喀爾吉善為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Ka'erjishan was made governor of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Ka'erjishan became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 命杜愷統率湖南兵至軍前。

translations.literal: Du Kai was ordered to lead Hunan troops to the front.
translations.idiomatic: Du Kai was ordered to bring Hunan troops to the front.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命張廣泗赴湖南會辦軍務。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Zhang Guangsi was ordered to proceed to Hunan to manage military affairs jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Zhang Guangsi was sent to Hunan to direct the campaign jointly.

sentences.zh: 甲子，準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零遣使進表。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Dzungar taiji Galdan Tseren sent envoys to present a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Galdan Tseren of the Dzungars sent envoys with a memorial.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，調張渠為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiyou: Zhang Qu was transferred to be governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Zhang Qu became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 以徐士林為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Xu Shilin was made governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shilin became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 調方顯為廣西巡撫，碩色為四川巡撫，朱定元為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Fang Xian was transferred to be governor of Guangxi, Shuose governor of Sichuan, and Zhu Dingyuan governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Xian, Shuose, and Zhu Dingyuan were made governors of Guangxi, Sichuan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜噶爾丹策零敕書，諭準噶爾使以阿爾泰山為界，山南遊牧之人，仍居舊地。

translations.literal: On day yihai, an imperial letter was granted to Galdan Tseren, instructing the Dzungar envoy that the Altai Mountains should be the boundary and that people who grazed south of the mountains should remain on their old lands.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Galdan Tseren was told the Altai would be the border and southern grazers could stay where they were.

sentences.zh: 設甘肅安西提督，駐哈密。

translations.literal: A Gansu Anxi provincial commander-in-chief was established, stationed at Hami.
translations.idiomatic: An Anxi provincial commander was set up in Gansu, based at Hami.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以補熙為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Buxi was made general at Suiyuan City.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Buxi became Suiyuan City general.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔停今年秋決。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, an edict suspended autumn executions for this year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, autumn executions were suspended for the year.

sentences.zh: 甲申，張廣泗留辦湖南善後。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Zhang Guangsi was retained to handle Hunan aftermath.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Zhang Guangsi stayed in Hunan for post-campaign affairs.

sentences.zh: 賑安徽宣城衛飢。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed for famine at Xuancheng guard in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief was given at Anhui's Xuancheng guard.

sentences.zh: 己丑，免安徽鳳陽等十九州縣衛水災、無為等四州縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jichou, quota taxes were remitted for nineteen prefectures, counties, and guards including Fengyang in Anhui on account of flood damage, and for four prefectures and counties including Wuwei on account of drought damage.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, flood and drought taxes were remitted across Anhui including Fengyang and Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賑山西徐溝飢。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, relief was distributed for famine at Xugou in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Shanxi's Xugou received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賑甘肅武威等三縣飢。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, relief was distributed for famine in three counties including Wuwei in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, famine relief was given in three Gansu counties including Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，班第奏總兵劉策名等連克長坪各苗寨，獲首倡妖言黎阿蘭等。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Bandi memorialized that regional commander Liu Ceming and others had taken in succession the Miao stockades at Changping, capturing the chief instigator of seductive talk, Li Alan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Bandi reported Liu Ceming's capture of Changping Miao stockades and rebel leader Li Alan.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥朔，廣西宜山縣蠻匪平。

translations.literal: Eighth month, first day of the month on day jihai: the Man bandits in Yishan county, Guangxi, were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eighth month, Yishan Man bandits in Guangxi were pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚子，諭曰：「朕閱江省歲額錢糧雜辦款目，沿自前明，賦役全書亦未編定，官民交受其累，其悉予豁免。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, an edict said: "Having reviewed Jiang province's annual levy and miscellaneous surcharge items, which derive from the Ming and for which no complete register of duties has been compiled, officials and people alike suffer under them; all are hereby wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor ordered full remission of Jiangsu's Ming-era miscellaneous levies.

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，班第奏剿平鹽井口苗匪各寨。

translations.literal: " On day gengxu, Bandi memorialized that the Miao bandit stockades at Yanjingkou had all been suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Bandi reported the Yanjingkou Miao bandits pacified.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上奉皇太后駐南苑。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager in residence at the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Emperor stayed with the Empress Dowager at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 賑福建永定飢。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed for famine at Yongding in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's Yongding received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 免河南中牟等十四州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for fourteen prefectures and counties including Zhongmou in Henan on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: Flood taxes were remitted in fourteen Henan prefectures and counties including Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，譚行義奏安南人立龍彪為王，僭元景興。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Tan Xingyi memorialized that the people of Annam had enthroned Long Biao as king and usurped the reign title Jingxing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Tan Xingyi reported Annam had enthroned Long Biao under the reign title Jingxing.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，調楊超曾為吏部尚書，仍署兩江總督，史貽直為兵部尚書，韓光基為刑部尚書，陳世倌為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Yang Chaozeng was transferred to be Minister of Personnel while still acting governor-general of the two Jiangs; Shi Yizhi was made Minister of War; Han Guangji Minister of Justice; and Chen Shiguan Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Yang Chaozeng, Shi Yizhi, Han Guangji, and Chen Shiguan received new ministry posts.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，協辦大學士禮部尚書三泰乞休，慰留之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Associate Grand Secretary and Minister of Rites Santai asked to retire; he was comforted and retained.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Santai's retirement request was declined with encouragement to remain.

sentences.zh: 賑福建上杭飢。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed for famine at Shanghang in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's Shanghang received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 賑浙江餘杭等十六州縣廳衛所水災。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed for flood damage in sixteen prefectures, departments, counties, subprefectures, guards, and posts including Yuhang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief was given in sixteen Zhejiang prefectures and counties including Yuhang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，江蘇宿遷縣朱家閘河決，命築挑水壩。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Zhu Family Sluice on the Yellow River burst at Suqian county in Jiangsu; an order was issued to build a diversion dam.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, a Jiangsu Yellow River breach at Suqian was ordered dammed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，築江蘇寶山縣吳家濱海塘石壩。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, a stone seawall was built at Wujia Embankment on the coastal dike in Baoshan county, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Jiangsu's Baoshan coastal dike gained a stone seawall at Wujia Embankment.

sentences.zh: 賑陝西葭州等州縣飢。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed for famine in prefectures and counties including Jiazhou in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief was given in Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiazhou.

sentences.zh: 以王安國為左都御史。

translations.literal: Wang Anguo was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anguo became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 永定河復歸故道。

translations.literal: The Yongding River returned to its old course.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River was restored to its former channel.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌朔，以常安為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day of the month on day wuxu: Chang'an was made Grain Transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the tenth month, Chang'an became Grain Transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor visited Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Emperor visited Tailing.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 賑四川綿竹等三縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed for flood damage in three counties including Mianzhu in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief was given in three Sichuan counties including Mianzhu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免甘肅平羅本年水災額賦，仍免寧夏、寧朔半賦。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, this year's quota taxes were remitted for Pingluo in Gansu on account of flood damage, and half the levy was still remitted for Ningxia and Ningshuo.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Gansu flood taxes were remitted at Pingluo and halved at Ningxia and Ningshuo.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，僉都御史劉藻奏請停減圓明園營造，上嘉納之。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Censor-in-chief Liu Zao memorialized asking to halt and reduce construction at the Garden of Perfect Brightness; the Emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Liu Zao's plea to cut Yuanmingyuan construction was approved.

sentences.zh: 賑福建臺灣、諸羅風災。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed for wind damage in Taiwan and Zhuluo in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Wind-disaster relief was given in Fujian's Taiwan and Zhuluo.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，張廣泗奏獲苗匪栗賢宇等，及附瑤匪之戴名揚等，克平溪等寨。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Zhang Guangsi memorialized the capture of Miao bandits including Li Xianyu and Yao bandits attached to them including Dai Mingyang, and the recovery of stockades including Pingxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Zhang Guangsi reported capturing Li Xianyu and Dai Mingyang and recovering Pingxi stockades.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，以那蘇圖署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi: Nasutu was made acting governor of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Nasutu became acting Huguang governor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，調來保為刑部尚書，哈達哈為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Laibao was transferred to be Minister of Justice and Hadaha Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Laibao and Hadaha became Ministers of Justice and Works.

sentences.zh: 丙子，楊超曾劾江西巡撫岳濬，命高斌往會鞫之。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Yang Chaozeng impeached Jiangxi governor Yue Jun; Gao Bin was ordered to go and join in the investigation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Yue Jun was impeached and Gao Bin was sent to investigate jointly.

sentences.zh: 己卯，召王謩來京。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Wang Mo was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Wang Mo was summoned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 命王安國以左都御史管廣東巡撫事。

translations.literal: Wang Anguo was ordered to manage Guangdong governorship affairs as Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anguo was ordered to act as Guangdong governor in his post as Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 命阿里袞同高斌勘鞫岳濬。

translations.literal: Aligun was ordered to join Gao Bin in investigating and trying Yue Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Aligun was ordered to assist Gao Bin in trying Yue Jun.

sentences.zh: 以劉吳龍為左都御史。

translations.literal: Liu Wulong was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wulong became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命廷臣各舉所知，如湯斌、陸隴其、陳璸、彭鵬諸人。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, court ministers were ordered each to recommend men they knew, such as Tang Bin, Lu Longqi, Chen Qin, Peng Peng, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, ministers were told to recommend worthy men such as Tang Bin and Lu Longqi.

sentences.zh: 賑陝西葭州等六州縣飢。

translations.literal: Relief was distributed for famine in six prefectures and counties including Jiazhou in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief was given in six Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiazhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，張廣泗進剿湖南城步、綏寧，廣西義寧苗、瑤，悉平之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: Zhang Guangsi advanced to suppress Chengbu and Suining in Hunan; the Miao and Yao of Yining in Guangxi were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Zhang Guangsi pacified Hunan and Guangxi Miao and Yao rebels.

sentences.zh: 免安徽宣城、宣州二縣衛雹災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for Xuancheng and Xuanzhou counties and guards in Anhui on account of hail damage.
translations.idiomatic: Hail taxes were remitted in Anhui's Xuancheng and Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 免托克托城等處雹災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for hail damage in places including Tokto city.
translations.idiomatic: Hail taxes were remitted at Tokto city and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 壬子，免山東蒲臺逋賦。

translations.literal: On day renzi, arrears of tax were remitted for Putai in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Shandong tax arrears were forgiven at Putai.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月甲戌，裁安西總兵，設提督。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, day jiaxu: the Anxi regional commander was abolished and a provincial commander-in-chief was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year, Anxi's regional commander was replaced by a provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免福建閩縣等五縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, arrears of tax were remitted for five counties including Min county in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, tax arrears were forgiven in five Fujian counties including Min.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命鄂爾泰、訥親會同孫嘉淦、顧琮勘視永定河工。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, E'ertai and Neqin were ordered, together with Sun Jiagan and Gu Cong, to survey Yongding River works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, E'ertai, Neqin, Sun Jiagan, and Gu Cong were sent to inspect Yongding River works.

sentences.zh: 命參贊大臣阿岱駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: Coordinating Minister Adai was ordered to garrison at Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: Adai was posted as coordinating minister at Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 以慶泰為北路軍營參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Qingtai was made coordinating minister for the Northern Route army camp.
translations.idiomatic: Qingtai became northern-route army coordinating minister.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免霸州、雄縣額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, quota taxes for Bazhou and Xiongxian were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Bazhou and Xiongxian quota taxes were waived.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命班第仍在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Ban Di was ordered to continue serving at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Ban Di kept his post at the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 二月，御史叢洞請暫息行圍，上以飭兵懷遠之意訓之。

translations.literal: Second month: Censor Cong Dong memorialized to suspend the hunting tour temporarily; the Emperor lectured him on the meaning of drilling troops and cherishing distant peoples.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Cong Dong asked to pause the hunt; the emperor rebuked him for missing its purpose of training troops and winning the frontier.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以完顏偉為南河副總河。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Wanyan Wei was made Deputy Director-General of the South River.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Wanyan Wei became deputy South River director.

sentences.zh: 免湖北鍾祥等四縣雹水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for the four Hubei counties of Zhongxiang and others stricken by hail and flood.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei Zhongxiang and three other counties received hail-flood tax relief.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免陝西葭州等三州縣雹災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, quota taxes were remitted for the three Shaanxi prefectures and counties of Jiazhou and others stricken by hail.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Jiazhou and two other Shaanxi districts received hail tax relief.

sentences.zh: 庚申，增設山西歸化城分巡道。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, a sub-circuit intendant post was added at Guihuacheng, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Shanxi's Guihuacheng circuit intendant post was created.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，命侍郎楊嗣璟往山西會鞫山西學政喀爾欽賄賣生員之獄。

translations.literal: Third month, day renshen: Vice Minister Yang Sijing was ordered to Shanxi jointly to investigate the case of Shanxi education intendant Kaerqin selling licentiates for bribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Yang Sijing was sent to Shanxi to try Kaerqin's bribery-for-licentiate case.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以御史仲永檀劾鄂善受賄，命怡親王等鞫之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, after Censor Zhong Yongtan impeached E Shan for taking bribes, the Prince of Yi and others were ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Prince Yi and others were assigned to try E Shan after Zhong Yongtan's bribery charge.

sentences.zh: 鄂善褫職逮問。

translations.literal: E Shan was stripped of office and arrested for questioning.
translations.idiomatic: E Shan was dismissed and taken into custody.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，擢仲永檀為僉都御史。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Zhong Yongtan was promoted to Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Zhong Yongtan rose to censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未朔，大學士趙國麟乞休，不允。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day yiwei: Grand Secretary Zhao Guolin asked to retire; it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Zhao Guolin's retirement request was denied.

sentences.zh: 免江蘇豐縣等十州縣衛水災、蟲災、民屯蘆課。

translations.literal: Water-, insect-, and reed-field taxes were remitted for ten Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Fengxian.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu Fengxian and nine other districts received flood, locust, and reed-tax relief.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，免順天直隸霸州等十州縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, last year's flood quota taxes were remitted for ten Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, ten Zhili districts including Bazhou received last year's flood tax relief.

sentences.zh: 以慶復署兩廣總督，張允隨署雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Qing Fu was made acting Governor-General of Liangguang, and Zhang Yunshi acting Governor-General of Yungui.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Fu took acting charge of Liangguang; Zhang Yunshi of Yungui.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賜鄂善自盡。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, E Shan was granted suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, E Shan was allowed to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，免福建臺灣逋賦。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin: arrears taxes for Taiwan, Fujian were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Fujian Taiwan tax arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 賑江西興國等縣水災，貴州仁懷、平越水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for floods in Jiangxi Xingguo and other counties and in Guizhou Renhuai and Pingyue.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to Jiangxi Xingguo and other counties and to Guizhou Renhuai and Pingyue.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午朔，免陝西葭州等六州縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, first day jiawu: last year's flood quota taxes were remitted for six Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, six Shaanxi districts including Jiazhou received last year's flood tax relief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，江蘇巡撫徐士林給假省親，調陳大受署之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Jiangsu governor Xu Shilin was granted leave to visit his parents; Chen Dashou was ordered to act for him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Xu Shilin went on family leave; Chen Dashou acted as Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 改張楷為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhang Kai was transferred to be Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Kai became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命王安國勘廣東征糧積弊。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Wang Anguo was ordered to investigate accumulated abuses in Guangdong grain levies for the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Wang Anguo was sent to probe Guangdong campaign grain abuses.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以御史李剗劾甘肅匿災，命會同尹繼善勘之。

translations.literal: On day yisi, after Censor Li Gang impeached Gansu for concealing famine, he was ordered jointly with Yin Jishan to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Li Gang's charge of concealed Gansu famine sent him with Yin Jishan to investigate.

sentences.zh: 己酉，浙江巡撫盧焯解任，命德沛及副都統汪扎勒鞫之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Zhejiang governor Lu Chao was removed; Depu and Deputy Banner Commander Wang Zhale were ordered to try him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Lu Chao was dismissed; Depu and Wang Zhale were to investigate him.

sentences.zh: 賑安徽宿州等十二州縣水災，江蘇山陽等州縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for floods in twelve Anhui prefectures and counties including Suzhou and in Jiangsu Shanyang and other districts.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to twelve Anhui districts and to Jiangsu Shanyang and others.

sentences.zh: 趙國麟以薦舉非人，降調。

translations.literal: Zhao Guolin was demoted for recommending unworthy men.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Guolin was reduced in rank for bad nominations.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，免江蘇蘇州等府屬逋賦。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: arrears taxes for Suzhou and other Jiangsu prefectures were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Jiangsu Suzhou and other districts received arrears tax relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，喀爾欽處斬。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Kaerqin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Kaerqin was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 丙子，薩哈諒論斬。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Sahaliang was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Sahaliang received the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，甘肅巡撫元展成以御史胡定劾，解任，命副都統新柱往會尹繼善鞫之。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Gansu governor Yuan Zhancheng was removed after impeachment by Censor Hu Ding; Deputy Banner Commander Xinzhu was sent to investigate jointly with Yin Jishan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Yuan Zhancheng left office over Hu Ding's charge; Xinzhu joined Yin Jishan to try the case.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔停今年秋決。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, an edict halted autumn executions for the year.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, autumn executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上初舉秋獮。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor held his first autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the emperor opened the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 奉皇太后幸避暑山莊，免經過額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: Accompanying the Empress Dowager to the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat, he remitted three-tenths of quota taxes along the route.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling with the empress dowager to the summer retreat, he cut route taxes by thirty percent.

sentences.zh: 自是每年皆如之，減行圍所過州縣額賦。

translations.literal: Henceforth this was done annually, reducing quota taxes of counties passed during the hunting tour.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter counties on the hunt route received annual tax reductions.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賑江西武寧等二縣水災。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, relief was given for floods in two Jiangxi counties, Wuning and another.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Jiangxi Wuning and another county received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上至古北口閱兵。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor reached Gubeikou to review troops.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the emperor inspected troops at Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 賑廣東永安、歸善二縣飢。

translations.literal: Famine relief was given for Yong'an and Guishan, Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong Yong'an and Guishan received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，賑安徽宿州等十九州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guisi: relief was given for floods in nineteen Anhui prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, nineteen Anhui districts including Suzhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上駐蹕張三營。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor halted at Zhangsanying.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the court halted at Zhangsanying.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor conducted a hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the emperor held a battue hunt.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇山陽等十八州縣、莞瀆等場水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for floods in eighteen Jiangsu prefectures and counties and salt pans including Shanyang and Guandu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu Shanyang and seventeen other districts and the Guandu pans received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 己酉，召楊超曾回京。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Yang Chaoeng was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Yang Chaoeng was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 調那蘇圖為兩江總督，孫嘉淦為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Nasutu was transferred to be Governor-General of Liangjiang, and Sun Jiagan Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Nasutu became Liangjiang governor-general; Sun Jiagan Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以高斌為直隸總督，完顏偉為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Gao Bin was made Governor-General of Zhili and Wanyan Wei Director-General of the Jiangnan waterways.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin took Zhili; Wanyan Wei took Jiangnan waterways.

sentences.zh: 裁直隸河道總督，命高斌兼理直隸河務。

translations.literal: The Zhili waterways governor-general post was cut; Gao Bin was ordered also to oversee Zhili river works.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili's waterworks governor-general was abolished; Gao Bin added Zhili river duties.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，召寧古塔將軍吉黨阿來京，以鄂爾達代之。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Ningguta general Jidang'a was recalled to the capital; E'erda replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Jidang'a left Ningguta; E'erda succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥朔，以陳宏謀為甘肅巡撫。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day guihai: Chen Hongmou was made Gansu governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Chen Hongmou became Gansu governor.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上奉皇太后回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the emperor returned with the empress dowager to the summer retreat.

sentences.zh: 賑廣東南海等二十六州縣廳飢。

translations.literal: Famine relief was given for twenty-six Guangdong prefectures, counties, and subprefectures including Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong Nanhai and twenty-five other districts received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后回蹕。

translations.literal: The Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on the return journey to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor escorted the empress dowager back toward the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，授王恕福建巡撫，楊錫紱廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Wang Shu was made Fujian governor and Yang Xizhao Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Wang Shu took Fujian; Yang Xizhao Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，調陳宏謀為江西巡撫，黃廷桂為甘肅巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Chen Hongmou was transferred to Jiangxi governor and Huang Tinggui to Gansu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Chen Hongmou went to Jiangxi; Huang Tinggui to Gansu.

sentences.zh: 免江蘇、安徽乾隆三四年被災漕糧。

translations.literal: Grain transport taxes for Jiangsu and Anhui from Qianlong years 3-4 that had suffered disaster were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu and Anhui disaster-struck grain transport levies from years 3-4 were waived.

sentences.zh: 己卯，調韓光基為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Han Guangji was transferred to be Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Han Guangji became minister of works.

sentences.zh: 以劉吳龍為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Liu Wulong was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wulong became minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，原任江蘇巡撫徐士林卒。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, former Jiangsu governor Xu Shilin died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, former governor Xu Shilin died.

sentences.zh: 授陳大受江蘇巡撫，張楷安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Chen Dashou was made Jiangsu governor and Zhang Kai Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dashou took Jiangsu; Zhang Kai Anhui.

sentences.zh: 賑福建福清等八縣及長福等鎮營飢。

translations.literal: Famine relief was given for eight Fujian counties including Fuqing and for garrison posts of Changfu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian Fuqing and seven other counties plus Changfu garrisons received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以劉統勛為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Liu Tongxun was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Liu Tongxun became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，賑廣東瓊山等二十四州縣颶災。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengzi: typhoon disaster relief was given for twenty-four Guangdong prefectures and counties including Qiongshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, twenty-four Guangdong districts including Qiongshan received typhoon relief.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賑安徽宿州等三十一州縣衛水災，並免宿州等三州縣額賦漕糧。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, relief was given for floods in thirty-one Anhui prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Suzhou, and quota and grain-transport taxes were also remitted for three prefectures and counties including Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, thirty-one Anhui districts received flood relief; three including Suzhou also got tax and grain remissions.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賑甘肅靈州等處飢。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, famine relief was given for Lingzhou and other places in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Gansu Lingzhou and other places received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，賑熱河四旗丁水災。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, flood relief was given for the four Rehe banner households.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Rehe's four banners received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，賑兩淮灶戶飢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: famine relief was given for salt-workers' households on the Lianghuai coast.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Lianghuai salt-workers received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，南掌國王島孫遣使入貢。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the king of Nan Zhang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Nan Zhang paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賑甘肅平番等十四州縣雹水災。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, hail-flood relief was given for fourteen Gansu prefectures and counties including Pingfan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, fourteen Gansu districts including Pingfan received hail-flood relief.

sentences.zh: 己巳，御史李剗陳奏甘肅飢饉情形不實，部議革職。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Censor Li Gang's memorial on Gansu famine conditions was judged inaccurate and the ministry recommended dismissal from office.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Li Gang's Gansu famine report was found false and the ministry sought his dismissal.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「與其懲言官而開諱災之端，寧從寬假以廣耳目。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Rather than punish the censor and open the door to concealing calamities, it is better to be lenient and broaden our eyes and ears.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said leniency toward censors was better than encouraging disaster concealment.

sentences.zh: 」命革職留任。

translations.literal: " He ordered Li Gang dismissed from office yet retained in his post.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang was demoted but kept on duty.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，免江蘇山陽等十五州縣衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, quota taxes were remitted for fifteen Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Shanyang stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, fifteen Jiangsu districts including Shanyang received flood tax relief.

sentences.zh: 賑句容等三十四州縣衛飢。

translations.literal: Famine relief was given for thirty-four prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Jurong.
translations.idiomatic: Jurong and thirty-three other districts received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，皇太后五旬聖壽節，御慈寧宮，上率諸王大臣等行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, on the Empress Dowager's fiftieth birthday, the Emperor led princes and ministers in congratulations at the Cining Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the emperor led court congratulations at Cining for the empress dowager's fiftieth birthday.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，劉統勛請停張廷玉近屬升轉，減訥親所管事務，上嘉之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiwei: Liu Tongxun asked to halt promotions of Zhang Tingyu's close kin and reduce the duties managed by the Neqin clan; the Emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Liu Tongxun sought curbs on Zhang Tingyu's kin and Neqin offices and won praise.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大學士張廷玉請解部務，不許。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu asked to be relieved of ministry duties; it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Zhang Tingyu's request to quit ministry work was denied.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，免甘肅武威等二縣五年被水額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, five years of flood quota taxes were remitted for two Gansu counties, Wuwei and another.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, two Gansu counties including Wuwei received five years of flood tax relief.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇江浦等州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Drought relief was given for Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Jiangpu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu Jiangpu and other districts received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 免湖南湘鄉等二縣被水額賦。

translations.literal: Flood quota taxes were remitted for two Hunan counties including Xiangxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan Xiangxiang and another county received flood tax relief.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，免浙江仁和等十九州縣本年額賦。

translations.literal: On day yisi, this year's quota taxes were remitted for nineteen Zhejiang prefectures and counties including Renhe.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, nineteen Zhejiang districts including Renhe received this year's tax relief.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免山東歷城等十六州縣衛旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, drought quota taxes were remitted for sixteen Shandong prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, sixteen Shandong districts including Licheng received drought tax relief.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免甘肅永昌等三縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, drought quota taxes were remitted for three Gansu counties including Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, three Gansu counties including Yongchang received drought tax relief.

sentences.zh: 琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 調常安為浙江巡撫，顧琮為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Chang An was transferred to Zhejiang governor and Gu Cong to Grain Transport Director-General.
translations.idiomatic: Chang An took Zhejiang; Gu Cong the grain transport command.

sentences.zh: 命劉統勛往浙江會勘海塘。

translations.literal: Liu Tongxun was ordered to go to Zhejiang jointly to survey the seacoast dikes.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tongxun was sent to Zhejiang to inspect sea dikes.

sentences.zh: 賑浙江嵊縣等十七州縣、仁和等場水旱災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for flood and drought in seventeen Zhejiang prefectures and counties including Shengxian and salt pans of Renhe and others.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang Shengxian and sixteen other districts plus Renhe pans received flood-drought relief.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月壬戌，調史貽直為吏部尚書，任蘭枝為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, day renxu: Shi Yizhi was transferred to Minister of Personnel and Ren Lanzhi to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 7, Shi Yizhi took personnel; Ren Lanzhi war.

sentences.zh: 以趙國麟為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Zhao Guolin was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Guolin became minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 庚午，定綏遠城、右衛、歸化城土默特、察哈爾共挑兵四千名，內札薩克首隊兵四千五百名、二隊兵六千五百名，援應北路軍營，並於額爾德尼昭沿途置駝馬備用。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, it was fixed that four thousand troops would be levied jointly from Suiyuan, Youwei, Guihuacheng Tumed, and Chahar, with four thousand five hundred first-rank and six thousand five hundred second-rank banner troops of the Jasak princes to reinforce the Northern Route army camp, and camels and horses were provisioned all along the route to Erdeni Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, troops and camels were arranged to reinforce the northern camp along the Erdeni Zhao route.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以那克素三十九部番民備辦準噶爾進藏官兵駝馬，免本年額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the thirty-nine tribes of the Nakusu were exempted this year's quota taxes for preparing camels and horses for Zungar troops entering Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, thirty-nine Nakusu tribes were tax-exempt for supplying the Tibet campaign.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賑安徽鳳陽、潁州二府，泗州一州屬飢民。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, famine relief was given for the two Anhui prefectures of Fengyang and Yingzhou and Su Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Fengyang, Yingzhou, and Su Prefecture received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，準噶爾入貢。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Zungars presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Zungars sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯朔，上詣泰陵。

translations.literal: Second month, first day xinmao: the Emperor went to the Tailing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the emperor set out for Tailing.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor paid homage at Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the emperor worshipped at Tailing.

sentences.zh: 是日，回蹕。

translations.literal: That day the court returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The court returned that same day.

sentences.zh: 丙申，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Korea presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for a hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 己亥，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Ryukyu sent tribute again.

sentences.zh: 己酉，禮部尚書趙國麟乞休，不允。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Minister of Rites Zhao Guolin asked to retire; it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Zhao Guolin's retirement plea was denied.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以吉黨阿為歸化城都統。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Jidang'a was made commander at Guihuacheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Jidang'a became Guihuacheng commander.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申朔，上憂旱，申命求言，並飭九卿大臣體國盡職。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengshen, first of the month: worried about drought, the Emperor ordered a renewed call for memorials and admonished the Nine Ministers and great officials to fulfill state duties with their whole persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of gengshen, drought led the Emperor to solicit advice and urge ministers to their duties.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命大學士、九卿、督、撫舉如馬周、陽城者為言官。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Grand Secretaries, the Nine Ministers, governors, and governors-general were ordered to recommend men like Ma Zhou and Yang Cheng for remonstrance posts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, ministers were told to recommend outspoken officials like Ma Zhou and Yang Cheng.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以旱命刑部清理庶獄，各省如之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, because of drought the Ministry of Justice was ordered to clear ordinary prisons; all provinces were to do likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, drought led to orders to clear prisons nationwide.

sentences.zh: 以晏斯盛為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Yan Sisheng was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Sisheng became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零遣使吹納木喀等奉表貢方物，乞勿限年貿易。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Dzungar taiji Galdan Tseren sent envoys Chuinamuka and others with a memorial and tribute, asking that trade not be limited by year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Galdan Tseren sent Chuinamuka and others with tribute, seeking unrestricted annual trade.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以噶爾丹策零表奏狡詐，諭西北兩路軍營大臣加意防之。

translations.literal: On day renwu, because Galdan Tseren's memorial was crafty and deceitful, the northwestern two-route army grand ministers were instructed to guard against him carefully.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Galdan Tseren's deceitful memorial led to tighter frontier vigilance.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 以兩江總督那蘇圖辦賑遺漏，切責之。

translations.literal: Because Two-Jiangs governor-general Naxitu had omissions in relief administration, he was sharply rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: Naxitu was sharply rebuked for gaps in Two-Jiangs famine relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅朔，準噶爾貢使吹納木喀等入覲。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengyin, first of the month: Dzungar tribute envoys Chuinamuka and others were received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Dzungar envoys Chuinamuka and others were received.

sentences.zh: 裁八溝、獨石口副都統各一，增天津副都統一。

translations.literal: One vice commander at each of Bagou and Dushikou was cut; one vice commander at Tianjin was added.
translations.idiomatic: Vice commanders at Bagou and Dushikou were cut; Tianjin gained one.

sentences.zh: 以古北口提督管獨石口外臺站。

translations.literal: The Gubeikou commander was placed in charge of courier stations outside Dushikou.
translations.idiomatic: The Gubeikou commander took charge of stations beyond Dushikou.

sentences.zh: 免河南永城等三縣上年被水額賦。

translations.literal: Scheduled grain tax remitted for three Henan counties including Yongcheng for last year's flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's Yongcheng and two other counties were excused last year's flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賜金甡等三百二十三人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Jin Shen and three hundred twenty-three others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Jin Shen and 323 others received jinshi degrees with graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 調德沛為兩江總督，那蘇圖為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Depei was transferred to Two-Jiangs governor-general; Naxitu to Min-Zhe governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Depei became Two-Jiangs governor-general; Naxitu Min-Zhe governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙未，撥安徽賑銀三十萬兩有奇，並准採買湖廣米備糶。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, over three hundred thousand taels of Anhui relief silver were allocated, and purchase of Huguang rice for relief sale was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, over 300,000 taels of Anhui relief silver were issued and Huguang rice purchases approved.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賑安徽宿州等州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, relief was given for flood in Anhui's Suzhou and other prefectures, counties, and garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Anhui flood victims in Suzhou and elsewhere were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賜準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零敕書，申誡以追論舊事，屢違定約，並諭將此次奏請貿易、改道噶斯等事停止，仍賞賚如例。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, an imperial letter was granted to Dzungar taiji Galdan Tseren, admonishing him for repeatedly bringing up old grievances and violating fixed agreements, and instructing that this memorial's requests for trade and changing the Gas route be stopped; gifts were still granted as usual.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Galdan Tseren received an imperial letter rebuking broken agreements and refusing trade and route requests while keeping usual gifts.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，除河南洧川等十一縣水沖地賦。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, land tax was remitted for eleven Henan counties including Weichuan for flood-washed fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, eleven Henan counties including Weichuan were excused flood-washed land tax.

sentences.zh: 免福建福清等七縣颶災額賦。

translations.literal: Scheduled grain tax was remitted for seven Fujian counties including Fuqing for typhoon damage.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's Fuqing and six other counties were excused typhoon taxes.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，刑部尚書劉吳龍卒，以張照為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Minister of Justice Liu Wulong died; Zhang Zhao was made Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Liu Wulong died; Zhang Zhao became Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 五月己未朔，以順天、保定等八府，易州等五州缺雨，命停徵新舊錢糧。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiwei, first of the month: because eight prefectures including Shuntian and Baoding and five departments including Yizhou lacked rain, collection of old and new taxes was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, drought in Shuntian, Baoding, and other areas led to suspension of tax collection.

sentences.zh: 定移駐滿兵屯墾拉林、阿勒楚喀事宜，設副都統，以巴靈阿為之。

translations.literal: Regulations were fixed for relocating Manchu troops to farm at Lalin and Alechuka; a vice commander was established, with Baling'a appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Rules were set for Manchu farming colonies at Lalin and Alechuka; Baling'a became vice commander.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以御史胡定劾，寢趙弘恩補刑部侍郎之命。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, because censor Hu Ding impeached him, Zhao Hong'en's appointment as vice minister of Justice was set aside.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Hu Ding's impeachment blocked Zhao Hong'en's Justice vice ministership.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，定雩祭典禮，御制樂章。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, rain-prayer ritual regulations were fixed and imperial hymns composed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, rain-prayer rites were codified with new imperial hymns.

sentences.zh: 免江蘇沛縣昭陽湖水沈田畝額賦。

translations.literal: Grain tax was remitted for flooded fields in Jiangsu's Pei County at Zhaoyang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Pei County's Zhaoyang Lake flood fields were excused grain tax.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，禁奏章稱蒙古為「夷人」。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, memorials were forbidden to call Mongols "barbarians."
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, memorials could no longer call Mongols "barbarians."

sentences.zh: 以琉球國王資送江南遭風難民，嘉獎之。

translations.literal: The Ryukyu king was praised for supplying refugees from Jiangnan who had suffered shipwreck.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu was commended for aiding Jiangnan shipwreck survivors.

sentences.zh: 張允隨奏猛遮界外孟艮酋長召賀罕被逐，遁入緬甸。

translations.literal: Zhang Yunsui memorialized that Menggen chief Zhao Hehan beyond the Mengzhe boundary had been expelled and fled into Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yunsui reported Menggen chief Zhao Hehan driven out and fled to Burma.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，諭督撫董率州縣經畫地利。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiayin: governors and governors-general were instructed to lead prefectures and counties in planning local advantages.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, governors were told to guide counties in land planning.

sentences.zh: 戊申，訓飭地方官實心經理平糶。

translations.literal: On day wushen, local officials were admonished to manage relief grain sales in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, officials were urged to run fair-price grain sales conscientiously.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，命資送日本遭風難民歸國。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiwei: shipwrecked Japanese refugees were ordered sent home with support.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Japanese castaways were sent home with aid.

sentences.zh: 免廣西梧州等三府屬逋賦。

translations.literal: Arrears were remitted for three Guangxi prefectures including Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi's Wuzhou and two other prefectures were excused tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，除山西繁峙、廣西武緣荒地額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, grain tax was remitted for wasteland in Shanxi's Fanshi and Guangxi's Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, wasteland tax was cut in Fanshi and Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，禮部尚書趙國麟乞休，上責其矯飾，褫職。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Minister of Rites Zhao Guolin asked to retire; the Emperor charged him with affectation and stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Zhao Guolin's retirement plea brought rebuke and dismissal.

sentences.zh: 調任蘭枝為禮部尚書，陳德華為兵部尚書，徐本兼管戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Ren Lanzhi was transferred to Minister of Rites; Chen Dehua to Minister of War; Xu Ben given concurrent charge of Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Lanzhi, Chen Dehua, and Xu Ben received new ministerial posts.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命大學士鄂爾泰兼領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Grand Secretary Ortai was ordered to hold the concurrent post of interior palace guard commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Ortai was made interior palace guard commander as well.

sentences.zh: 命賑江蘇山陽等州縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was ordered for flood in Jiangsu's Shanyang and other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu flood victims in Shanyang and elsewhere were ordered relieved.

sentences.zh: 命撫恤江蘇阜寧等州縣水災。

translations.literal: Comfort was ordered for flood in Jiangsu's Funing and other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Funing and other Jiangsu flood areas were ordered comforted.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命高斌、周學健往江南查辦災賑、水利。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Gao Bin and Zhou Xuejian were sent to Jiangnan to investigate disaster relief and waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Gao Bin and Zhou Xuejian were sent to audit Jiangnan relief and rivers.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賑湖北漢川、襄陽等州縣衛水雹災，並停徵額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, relief was given for hail-flood in Hubei's Hanchuan, Xiangyang, and other prefectures, counties, and garrisons, and scheduled taxes were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Hubei hail-flood areas were relieved and taxes suspended.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賑江蘇江浦等十八州縣衛、安徽臨淮等州縣衛。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, relief was given for Jiangsu's Jiangpu and eighteen other prefectures, counties, and garrisons, and Anhui's Linhuai and other prefectures, counties, and garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Jiangsu and Anhui flood areas received relief.

sentences.zh: 撫恤江西興國等州縣、浙江淳安等州縣、湖南醴陵等八州縣、山東嶧縣等十州縣衛、甘肅狄道等四州縣廳災民。

translations.literal: Comfort was given to disaster victims in Jiangxi's Xingguo and other prefectures and counties, Zhejiang's Chun'an and other prefectures and counties, Hunan's Liling and eight other prefectures and counties, Shandong's Yi County and ten other prefectures, counties, and garrisons, and Gansu's Didao and four other prefectures, counties, and departments.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster victims in Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Hunan, Shandong, and Gansu were comforted.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，江南黃、淮交漲，命疆吏拯救災黎，毋拘常例。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuzi: the Huang and Huai rivers rose together in Jiangnan; frontier officials were ordered to save the afflicted without binding themselves to routine.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Jiangnan's Huang-Huai floods led to orders to save victims beyond routine rules.

sentences.zh: 訓飭慎重軍政。

translations.literal: Military administration was admonished to be carefully handled.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were admonished to handle military affairs carefully.

sentences.zh: 撥江蘇、安徽賑銀二百五十萬兩有奇。

translations.literal: Over two million five hundred thousand taels of Jiangsu and Anhui relief silver were allocated.
translations.idiomatic: Over 2.5 million taels of Jiangsu and Anhui relief silver were issued.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，免江蘇、安徽被水地方本年額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, scheduled grain tax for the year was remitted for flooded areas in Jiangsu and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, this year's grain tax was cut in flooded Jiangsu and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，定皇后親蠶典禮。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, regulations were fixed for the empress's personal silkworm rite.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the empress's silkworm ceremony was codified.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，免直隸、江蘇、安徽、福建、甘肅、廣東等省雍正十三年逋賦，並免江南、浙江未完雍正十三年漕項。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, arrears were remitted for Zhili, Jiangsu, Anhui, Fujian, Gansu, Guangdong, and other provinces for Yongzheng 13, and unpaid grain transport items for Jiangnan and Zhejiang for Yongzheng 13 were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Yongzheng 13 arrears were cut in several provinces and Jiangnan-Zhejiang transport dues.

sentences.zh: 庚子，諭河南等省撫恤江南流民。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Henan and other provinces were instructed to comfort Jiangnan refugees.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, provinces were told to aid Jiangnan refugees.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上奉皇太后幸南苑，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to the Southern Park; the Emperor conducted a hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to the Southern Park and hunted.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賑江西興國水災。

translations.literal: On day guimao, relief was given for Jiangxi's Xingguo flood.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Xingguo flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上奉皇太后幸晾鷹臺閱圍。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to Laying-Hawk Terrace to review the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Empress Dowager watched the hunt at Laying-Hawk Terrace.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳朔，撥江蘇運山東截留漕米十萬石，備淮、徐、鳳、潁各屬賑糶。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingsi, first of the month: one hundred thousand shi of grain transport rice detained in Shandong from Jiangsu was allocated for relief sale in Huai, Xu, Feng, and Ying districts.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, 100,000 shi of detained transport grain was set aside for Huai-Xu relief sales.

sentences.zh: 賑湖北潛江等十州縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for flood in ten Hubei prefectures and counties including Qianjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Hubei prefectures and counties including Qianjiang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，免廣東崖州等二州縣風災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, scheduled tax was remitted for two Guangdong prefectures and counties including Yazhou for wind damage.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Yazhou and one other Guangdong county were excused wind taxes.

sentences.zh: 免安徽鳳、潁、泗三府州本年水災地方漕賦，不成災者折征之。

translations.literal: Grain transport tax for Anhui's Feng, Ying, and Si three prefectures and departments was remitted for this year's flood areas; where disaster was partial, collection in commutation was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui transport tax was cut in flood zones; partial disaster areas paid in commutation.

sentences.zh: 賑湖南湘陰等九縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for flood in nine Hunan counties including Xiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Hunan counties including Xiangyin received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上詣東陵。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor went to the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor went to the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor paid respects at Zhaoxi Mausoleum, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, and Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Emperor visited Zhaoxi, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, and Jingling.

sentences.zh: 免江蘇山陽等二十一州縣本年被水漕賦。

translations.literal: Grain transport tax was remitted for twenty-one Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Shanyang flooded this year.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-one flooded Jiangsu counties including Shanyang were excused transport tax.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上幸盤山。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor went to Mount Pan.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor went to Mount Pan.

sentences.zh: 賑恤江蘇、安徽災銀二百九十萬兩、米穀二百二十萬石各有奇。

translations.literal: Disaster relief and comfort: over two million nine hundred thousand taels of silver and over two million two hundred thousand shi of grain for Jiangsu and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu and Anhui received over 2.9 million taels of silver and 2.2 million shi of grain in relief.

sentences.zh: 命再撥鄰省銀一百萬兩備明春接濟。

translations.literal: Orders were given to allocate another one million taels from neighboring provinces for relief next spring.
translations.idiomatic: Another million taels from neighboring provinces was ordered for spring relief.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上幸棽髻山。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor went to Fenji Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Emperor went to Fenji Mountain.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上回蹕。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor returned in procession.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，撥山東、河南明年運漕米各五萬石備江南賑，仍由直隸赴古北口外如數採買補運。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingxu: fifty thousand shi each of next year's transport grain from Shandong and Henan were allocated for Jiangnan relief; grain was still to be purchased beyond the Great Wall at Gubeikou in corresponding amounts to make up transport, per Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Shandong and Henan each gave 50,000 shi of next year's grain for Jiangnan relief, with Gubeikou purchases to replenish.

sentences.zh: 己丑，免山東歷城等十九州縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jichou, scheduled tax was remitted for nineteen Shandong prefectures and counties including Licheng for drought.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, nineteen drought-struck Shandong counties including Licheng were excused tax.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命江南截留癸亥年漕糧二十萬石，仍撥山東漕糧二十萬石，河南倉米二十萬石，運江南備賑。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, two hundred thousand shi of Qianlong guihai year grain transport detained in Jiangnan was ordered, and still two hundred thousand shi of Shandong transport grain and two hundred thousand shi of Henan warehouse grain were to be transported to Jiangnan for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, 200,000 shi of detained guihai transport grain plus Shandong and Henan grain were sent to Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，浙江提督裴鉽等以侵欺褫職鞫治。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Zhejiang commander Pei Yue and others were stripped of office and tried for extortion.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Pei Yue and others were dismissed and tried for graft.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賑江蘇山陽等二十八州縣衛飢。

translations.literal: On day renchen, relief was given for famine in twenty-eight Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, twenty-eight Jiangsu areas including Shanyang received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命清理滯獄。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, backlog of cases was ordered cleared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, delayed court cases were ordered cleared.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命撥山東沿河倉穀十萬石運江南備賑。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, one hundred thousand shi of grain along Shandong rivers was ordered transported to Jiangnan for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, 100,000 shi of Shandong river grain was sent to Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賑安徽鳳陽二十四州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, relief was given for flood in twenty-four Anhui prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, twenty-four Fengyang-area units received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，朝鮮國王李昑表謝國人金時宗等越境犯法，屢荷寬典。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Korean King Yeongjo memorialized thanks that his subject Kim Sijong and others had repeatedly violated the border yet received repeated clemency.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, King Yeongjo thanked the court for clemency toward border violators led by Kim Sijong.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「此朕柔遠之恩。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "This is My policy of gentle treatment toward the distant.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This is My gracious policy toward distant peoples.

sentences.zh: 若恃有寬典，犯法滋多，非朕保全外籓之本意。

translations.literal: If you rely on repeated clemency and offenses multiply, that is not My intent in preserving outer vassals.
translations.idiomatic: If you rely on repeated pardons and offenses multiply, that is not how I mean to protect vassal states.

sentences.zh: 王其嚴加約束，毋俾干紀。

translations.literal: Your Majesty must strictly restrain them and not let them violate discipline.
translations.idiomatic: You must strictly restrain them and not let them break the law.

sentences.zh: 」以塞楞額為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: " Saileng'e was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Saileng'e became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賑河南永城等十三州縣飢。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, relief was given for famine in thirteen Henan prefectures and counties including Yongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, thirteen Henan areas including Yongcheng received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上詣順懿密太妃宮問疾。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor went to Imperial Noble Consort Shunyi's palace to inquire after her illness.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor inquired after Imperial Noble Consort Shunyi's illness.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賑江蘇山陽等七州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day renyin, relief was given for flood in seven Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, seven Jiangsu flood areas including Shanyang were relieved.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰朔，大學士等奏纂輯明史體例。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen, first of the month: Grand Secretaries and others memorialized on compiling principles for the History of the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Grand Secretaries reported principles for compiling the Ming History.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「諸卿所見與朕意同。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "What you gentlemen see accords with My mind.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Your views accord with My mind.

sentences.zh: 繼春秋之翼道，昭來茲之鑒觀，我君臣其共勉之。

translations.literal: Carrying on the Spring and Autumn in aiding the Way, illuminating models for generations to come—let ruler and ministers together exert ourselves.
translations.idiomatic: Follow the Spring and Autumn in aiding the Way and set a mirror for posterity—let us strive together.

sentences.zh: 」賑湖北漢川等十二州縣水災飢。

translations.literal: " Relief was given for flood famine in twelve Hubei prefectures and counties including Hanchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was given for flood famine in twelve Hubei counties including Hanchuan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賑浙江瑞安等縣廳場、湖南湘陰等九縣水災。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, relief was given for flood in Zhejiang's Ruian and other counties and departments, and Hunan's Xiangyin and nine other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Zhejiang and Hunan flood areas including Ruian and Xiangyin were relieved.

sentences.zh: 庚申，福建漳浦縣會匪戕殺知縣，命嚴治之。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, in Zhangpu County, Fujian, a secret society slew the magistrate; severe punishment was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, after Zhangpu magistrates were killed by a secret society, harsh punishment was ordered.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賑山東膠州十州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day renxu, relief was given for flood in ten Shandong prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, ten Shandong flood areas including Jiaozhou were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賑甘肅狄道等州縣水雹災。

translations.literal: On day guihai, relief was given for hail flood in Gansu's Didao and other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Didao and other Gansu hail-flood areas were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命持法寬嚴，務歸平允。

translations.literal: On day yihai, law enforcement was ordered to balance severity and leniency and seek fairness.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, officials were told to apply law with balanced severity.

sentences.zh: 命陳世倌會同高斌查勘江南水利。

translations.literal: Chen Shiguan was ordered to join Gao Bin in surveying Jiangnan waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shiguan was ordered to survey Jiangnan rivers with Gao Bin.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，諭明春奉皇太后詣盛京謁陵。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, it was announced that in spring next year the Empress Dowager would be taken to Mukden to visit the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, a spring visit to Mukden tombs with the Empress Dowager was announced.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以初定齋宮禮，是日詣齋宮。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, because the fasting palace rite was newly established, on that day the Emperor went to the fasting palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, with the new fasting palace rite in place, the Emperor went there.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，賑山東濟寧等七州縣衛飢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingxu, first of the month: relief was given for famine in seven Shandong prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Jining.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, seven Shandong famine areas including Jining were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命考試薦舉科道人才。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, examination of talents recommended from the censorate and other tracks was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, recommended censorate and other talents were ordered examined.

sentences.zh: 周學健舉三人皆同鄉，諭飭之。

translations.literal: Zhou Xuejian recommended three men, all fellow-townsmen; he was admonished.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Xuejian was rebuked for recommending three fellow-townsmen.

sentences.zh: 命左副都御史仲永檀會同周學健查賑。

translations.literal: Left Vice Censor-in-chief Zhong Yongtan was ordered to join Zhou Xuejian in inspecting relief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Yongtan was ordered to inspect relief with Zhou Xuejian.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上奉皇太后幸瀛臺。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to Yingtai.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to Yingtai.

sentences.zh: 丙子，仲永檀、鄂容安以漏泄機密，逮交內務府慎刑司，命莊親王等鞫治。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Zhong Yongtan and E Rong'an, for leaking state secrets, were taken to the Imperial Household Department's Prudence and Punishment Office; Prince Zhuang and others were ordered to try them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Zhong Yongtan and E Rong'an were arrested for leaking secrets and tried under Prince Zhuang.

sentences.zh: 免福建尤溪等四縣荒田溢額銀。

translations.literal: Overflow tax was remitted for wasteland in four Fujian counties including Youxi.
translations.idiomatic: Youxi and three other Fujian counties were excused wasteland overflow tax.

sentences.zh: 己亥，召安徽巡撫張楷來京，調喀爾吉善代之。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Anhui Governor Zhang Kai was summoned to the capital; Karjishan was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Zhang Kai was recalled from Anhui and Karjishan took his place.

sentences.zh: 命寬鄂爾泰黨庇仲永檀罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered leniency toward Ortai's faction-shielding of Zhong Yongtan's crime.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai's party was granted leniency in shielding Zhong Yongtan.

sentences.zh: 免直隸薊州等三州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota land taxes were remitted for three prefectures and counties of Zhili including Jizhou on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: Flood taxes were remitted in three Zhili districts including Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，撥運吉林烏拉倉糧接濟齊齊哈爾等處旱災。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, grain from the Jilin Wula granary was allocated and transported to relieve drought in Qiqihar and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Jilin grain was sent to drought-stricken Qiqihar and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賑奉天承德等五州縣飢。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, famine relief was given in five prefectures and counties of Fengtian including Chengde.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, famine relief reached five Fengtian districts including Chengde.

sentences.zh: 免山東膠州等十州縣衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota land taxes were remitted for ten prefectures, counties, and guards of Shandong including Jiaozhou on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: Flood taxes were remitted in ten Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，調完顏偉為河東河道總督，白鍾山為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Wan Yan Wei was transferred to be Director-General of River Conservancy for Hedong; Bai Zhongshan for Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Wan Yan Wei took Hedong river conservancy and Bai Zhongshan Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，諭曰：「江南水災地畝涸出，耕種刻不容緩。

translations.literal: On day yimao, an edict said: "In Jiangnan's flood districts the fields have dried out; planting cannot brook delay.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, an edict urged urgent spring planting in Jiangnan's flood districts.

sentences.zh: 疆吏其勸災民愛護田牛，或給貲飼養，毋得以細事置之。

translations.literal: Frontier officials should urge disaster victims to care for draft oxen, or supply funds to feed them—none may set such matters aside as trifles.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were told to protect or subsidize oxen and not treat the matter lightly.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月丁巳，免鄂容安發軍臺，命仍在上書房行走。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, day dingsi: E Rong'an was exempted from exile to the military courier stations and ordered to continue service in the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year, E Rong'an was spared the courier-station exile and kept at the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 仲永檀死於獄。

translations.literal: Zhong Yongtan died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Yongtan died in jail.

sentences.zh: 召孫嘉淦來京。

translations.literal: Sun Jiagan was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jiagan was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以阿爾賽為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: A Erse was appointed governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: A Erse became Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 甲子，陳世倌等奏修江蘇淮、徐、揚、海，安徽鳳、潁、泗各屬河道水利，下大學士鄂爾泰等大臣議行之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Chen Shilu and others memorialized on repairing river works and water conservancy in Jiangsu's Huai, Xu, Yang, and Hai circuits and Anhui's Feng, Ying, and Si dependencies; the matter was referred to Grand Secretary Ortai and other ministers for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Chen Shilu and others proposed Huai-Xu-Yang-Hai and Feng-Ying-Si river repairs; Ortai and colleagues were to decide.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命軍機大臣徐本、班第、那彥泰隨往盛京。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Grand Councillors Xu Ben, Bandi, and Nayantai were ordered to accompany the court to Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Xu Ben, Bandi, and Nayantai were ordered to Mukden with the court.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，召參贊大臣阿岱、塔爾瑪回京，以拉布敦、烏爾登代之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Advising Ministers Adai and Ta'erma were recalled to the capital; Labudun and Wulden were put in their places.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Adai and Ta'erma returned to Beijing; Labudun and Wulden replaced them.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，內閣學士李紱致仕陛辭，以慎終如始對，賜詩嘉之。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Academician of the Grand Secretariat Li Fu, retiring and taking leave at court, answered "finish as carefully as you began"; the Emperor bestowed a poem in praise.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, retiring academician Li Fu answered "end as you began" and received an imperial poem.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以考選御史，杭世駿策言內滿外漢，忤旨褫職。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, in the examination for selection as censor, Hang Shijun's policy essay argued "Manchus inside, Han outside," offending the throne; he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Hang Shijun lost his post after a censor-selection essay urging Manchu priority.

sentences.zh: 調劉於義為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Liu Yuyi was transferred to be Shanxi Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuyi became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 命孫嘉淦署福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Sun Jiagan was ordered to act as Fujian Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jiagan was told to act as Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命尹繼善署兩江總督，協同白鍾山料理河務。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Yin Jishan was ordered to act as Governor-General of Liangjiang and, together with Bai Zhongshan, attend to river affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Yin Jishan acted as Liangjiang governor-general with Bai Zhongshan on river works.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命侍講鄧時敏、給事中倪國璉為鳳、潁、泗宣諭化導使，編修塗逢震、御史徐以升為淮、徐、揚、海宣諭化導使。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Hanlin expositor Deng Shimin and supervising secretary Ni Guolian were made pacification commissioners for Feng, Ying, and Si; compiler Tu Fengzhen and censor Xu Yisheng for Huai, Xu, Yang, and Hai.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Deng Shimin and Ni Guolian were named Feng-Ying-Si commissioners; Tu Fengzhen and Xu Yisheng Huai-Xu-Yang-Hai commissioners.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，免湖北漢川等十一州縣衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yisi, quota land taxes were remitted for eleven prefectures, counties, and guards of Hubei including Hanchuan on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, flood taxes were remitted in eleven Hubei prefectures, counties, and guards including Hanchuan.

sentences.zh: 准趙國麟回籍。

translations.literal: Zhao Guolin was permitted to return to his native place.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Guolin was allowed to go home.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣和親王弘晝代祀先農壇、用中和韶樂，與上親祭同，著為例。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Prince He Hongzhou was dispatched to offer sacrifice at the Altar of Agriculture in the Emperor's stead, using Zhonghe yayue music identical to the Emperor's personal rite; this was established as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Prince He offered the First Farmer sacrifice with full imperial music, setting a precedent.

sentences.zh: 賑山東滕縣等六州縣飢。

translations.literal: Famine relief was given in six prefectures and counties of Shandong including Tengxian.
translations.idiomatic: Six Shandong districts including Tengxian received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，調喀爾吉善為山東巡撫，晏斯盛為湖北巡撫，范璨為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Karjishan was transferred to Shandong Governor; Yan Sisheng to Hubei Governor; Fan Can to Anhui Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Karjishan took Shandong, Yan Sisheng Hubei, and Fan Can Anhui.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上詣壽祺皇太妃宮問疾。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor went to the Palace of Imperial Dowager Shouqi to inquire after her illness.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Emperor visited Dowager Shouqi to ask after her health.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申朔，壽祺皇太妃薨，輟朝十日。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day jiashen: Imperial Dowager Shouqi died; court mourning for ten days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Dowager Shouqi died and court sat in mourning ten days.

sentences.zh: 上欲持服，莊親王等祈免。

translations.literal: The Emperor wished to wear mourning; Prince Zhuang and others begged exemption.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wanted full mourning; Prince Zhuang and others begged him off.

sentences.zh: 訓飭九卿勤事。

translations.literal: The Nine Ministers were admonished to be diligent in office.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Ministers were warned to work diligently.

sentences.zh: 申命各督撫陳奏屬員賢否。
