translations.literal: Governors and governors-general were again ordered to report on subordinates' merit or demerit.
translations.idiomatic: Governors were again told to report on their subordinates.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上詣壽祺皇貴太妃宮致奠。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor went to offer libations at the palace of Imperial Noble Dowager Shouqi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the Emperor offered libations for Noble Dowager Shouqi.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命奉宸苑試行區田法。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Imperial Parks Department was ordered to trial the checkerboard-field method.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Imperial Parks were told to test checkerboard-field farming.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賑安徽鳳陽六府州屬水災飢。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, flood and famine relief was given in six prefectures under Fengyang, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, six Fengyang prefectures received flood and famine relief.

sentences.zh: 免湖北襄陽等三縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota land taxes were remitted for three counties of Hubei including Xiangyang on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: Flood taxes were remitted in three Hubei counties including Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，裁江蘇海防道，設淮徐海道，駐徐州府。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Jiangsu Coastal Defense Circuit was abolished; the Huai-Xu-Hai Circuit was established, stationed at Xuzhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Jiangsu coastal defense was abolished and Huai-Xu-Hai circuit set at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 以蘇松巡道兼管塘工。

translations.literal: The Su-Song surveillance circuit was given concurrent charge of embankment works.
translations.idiomatic: Su-Song surveillance also took charge of embankment works.

sentences.zh: 揚州府隸常鎮道。

translations.literal: Yangzhou Prefecture was placed under the Chang-Zhen circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou was placed under Chang-Zhen circuit.

sentences.zh: 原設淮徐、淮揚二道專管河工。

translations.literal: The formerly established Huai-Xu and Huai-Yang circuits had exclusively managed river works.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-Xu and Huai-Yang circuits had formerly handled river works alone.

sentences.zh: 閏四月甲寅朔，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, first day jiayin: Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，御試翰林、詹事等官，擢王會汾等三員為一等，餘各升黜有差。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor examined Hanlin and Household of the Heir officials; Wang Huifen and three others were placed in the first grade; the rest were promoted or demoted with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor tested Hanlin and Household officials; Wang Huifen and three others topped the list.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，免河南鄭州等十三州縣本年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, this year's quota land taxes were remitted for thirteen prefectures and counties of Henan including Zhengzhou on account of flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, this year's flood taxes were remitted in thirteen Henan districts including Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，除江蘇吳江等二縣坍沒田盪額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, quotas for submerged and lost fields and shoals in two counties of Jiangsu including Wujiang were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, taxes on lost Jiangsu fields and shoals including Wujiang were removed.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未朔，諭鑾輿巡幸，令扈從護軍等加意約束，不得踐踏田禾。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day guimao: an edict on the imperial progress ordered escort guards to restrain themselves strictly and not trample crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, an edict told escort guards on tour not to trample crops.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，御史沈懋華以進呈經史講義召見，已去，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Censor Shen Maohua had been summoned for presenting lectures on the Classics and History but had already left; the Ministries were ordered to deliberate punishment strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Shen Maohua, summoned for a classics lecture but gone, was referred for strict punishment.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命河南停徵上年被水地方錢糧。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Henan was ordered to suspend collection of grain and money levies from last year's flood-stricken areas.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Henan was told to stop collecting last year's levies from flood districts.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免江蘇山陽等十三州縣牙稅。

translations.literal: On day jihai, transit taxes were remitted for thirteen prefectures and counties of Jiangsu including Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, transit taxes were remitted in thirteen Jiangsu districts including Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 免臨清商民運徵米船料及銅補商補。

translations.literal: Transit charges on rice-shipping boats and copper compensation levies on merchants at Linqing were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Linqing boat charges and merchant copper levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賑山東歷城等十八州縣衛飢。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, famine relief was given in eighteen prefectures, counties, and guards of Shandong including Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, eighteen Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Licheng received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以碩色為河南巡撫，紀山為四川巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Suose was made Henan Governor; Jishan Sichuan Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Suose took Henan and Jishan Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，調慶復為川陝總督。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Qing Fu was transferred to be Governor-General of Sichuan-Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Qing Fu became Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以馬爾泰為兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Maertai was made Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: Maertai became Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 授張允隨為雲南總督，兼管巡撫事。

translations.literal: Zhang Yunshi was appointed Yunnan Governor-General with concurrent charge of governor affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yunshi was made Yunnan governor-general with governorship duties.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，蘇祿國王麻喊末阿稟漻寧表請三年一修職貢，命仍遵五年舊例。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the King of Sulu Mamahmodo presented through Liading a memorial asking triennial tribute missions; he was ordered still to follow the five-year precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Sulu's king asked for triennial tribute but was told to keep the five-year schedule.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子朔，御史陳仁請以經史考試翰詹，不宜用詩賦，上嘉之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, first day renzi: Censor Chen Ren asked that Hanlin and Household examinations use Classics and History rather than poetry; the Emperor praised this.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Chen Ren urged classics over poetry in Hanlin exams and was praised.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，改南掌為十年一貢。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Nanzhang tribute interval was changed to once in ten years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Nanzhang tribute was set at once in ten years.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，除江蘇沛縣水沈地賦。

translations.literal: On day yimao, land tax on submerged land in Peixian, Jiangsu was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, taxes on submerged Peixian land were removed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以旱求言。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, because of drought the Emperor sought memorials and advice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, drought prompted the Emperor to seek memorials.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命阿里袞暫署河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Arigge was ordered temporarily to act as Henan Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Arigge was told to act as Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以御史胡定劾湖南巡撫許容一案，究出督撫誣陷扶同，予敘。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, in the case of Censor Hu Ding's impeachment of Hunan Governor Xu Rong, it was found that governors had framed him in collusion; rewards and punishments were assigned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Hu Ding's case against Xu Rong exposed collusive framing by governors; punishments followed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，諭督撫率屬重農。

translations.literal: On day renshen, an edict told governors to lead subordinates in valuing agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, governors were told to lead their staffs in honoring farming.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，上詣順懿密太妃宮問疾。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yiyou: the Emperor went to Imperial Dowager Shunyi's palace to inquire after her illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Emperor visited Dowager Shunyi to ask after her health.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以安南不靖，擾及雲南開化都霙廠，命張允隨等嚴防之。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, because Annam was unsettled and disturbances reached Yunnan's Kaihua Duting silver mine, Zhang Yunshi and others were ordered to guard strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, unrest in Annam reaching Yunnan's Kaihua mine led Zhang Yunshi and others to tighten defenses.

sentences.zh: 開化鎮總兵賽都請討安南，不許。

translations.literal: Kaihua garrison commander Saidou asked to campaign against Annam; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Saidou's request to attack Annam was denied.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上奉皇太后由熱河詣盛京謁陵，免經過之直隸、奉天地方錢糧。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager from Rehe to Mukden to visit the tombs, remitted grain and money levies on districts passed through in Zhili and Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, traveling from Rehe to Mukden with the Empress Dowager, the Emperor remitted levies along the route in Zhili and Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 撥通倉米四十萬石賑直隸旱災。

translations.literal: Four hundred thousand shi of grain from the Tong granary were allocated to relieve drought in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Four hundred thousand shi from Tong granary were sent to drought-stricken Zhili.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免山東歷城等十六州縣衛旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renchen, quota land taxes were remitted for sixteen prefectures, counties, and guards of Shandong including Licheng on account of drought damage.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, drought taxes were remitted in sixteen Shandong districts including Licheng.

sentences.zh: 乙未，停今年勾決。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, this year's review executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, this year's judicial review executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: The Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, halted at the Mountain Villa to Escape the Heat.
translations.idiomatic: The court stopped at the Summer Resort with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 丙申，除福建連江等二縣水沖地賦。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, land tax on flood-washed land in two counties of Fujian including Lianjiang was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, taxes on flood-washed Fujian land including Lianjiang were removed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上奉皇太后詣盛京。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, proceeded to Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager went on to Mukden.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上行圍於永安莽喀。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor went hunting at Yong'anmangka.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor hunted at Yong'anmangka.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上行圍於愛里。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor went hunting at Aili.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Emperor hunted at Aili.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上行圍於錫拉諾海。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor went hunting at Xilanuohai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor hunted at Xilanuohai.

sentences.zh: 命嚴除州縣徵漕坐倉之弊。

translations.literal: Strict elimination of abuses in districts' grain-transport warehouse surcharges was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: District abuses in grain-transport warehouse surcharges were ordered ended.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免直隸滄州被雹灶戶額賦。

translations.literal: On day wushen, quota levies on saltern households in Cangzhou, Zhili, struck by hail, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, hail-struck Cangzhou saltern quotas were remitted.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后駐蹕嗎嗎塔喇。

translations.literal: The Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, halted at Mamatala.
translations.idiomatic: The court halted at Mamatala with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上行圍，至己卯皆如之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor went hunting; through jimao day it was the same.
translations.idiomatic: From jiyou through jimao the Emperor hunted each day.

sentences.zh: 嚴督撫等漏泄密奏之禁。

translations.literal: Strict prohibition on governors leaking confidential memorials was enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Governors were strictly forbidden to leak confidential memorials.

sentences.zh: 賑湖北興國等三州縣水災，並免額賦。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given in three prefectures and counties of Hubei including Xingguo, and land-tax quotas were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Three Hubei districts including Xingguo received flood relief and tax remission.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，萬壽節，上詣皇太后行幄行禮。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Longevity Festival; the Emperor went to the Empress Dowager's traveling tent to perform rites.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Longevity Festival, the Emperor performed rites at the Empress Dowager's tent.

sentences.zh: 御行幄，扈從諸王以下大臣官員暨蒙古王以下各官慶賀。

translations.literal: At the traveling tent, accompanying princes, ministers, officials, and Mongol princes offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: At the tent, princes, ministers, and Mongol nobles offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王、大臣、蒙古王等宴。

translations.literal: Banquets were granted to princes, ministers, and Mongol princes.
translations.idiomatic: Banquets were given to princes, ministers, and Mongol nobles.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上駐蹕巴雅爾圖塔剌。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor halted at Bayarettatala.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the court halted at Bayarettatala.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Emperor went hunting.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Emperor hunted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor went hunting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor hunted.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上駐蹕伊克淖爾，上行圍，至丙子如之。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor halted at Yikenuo'er and went hunting; through bingzi day it was the same.
translations.idiomatic: From renshen through bingzi the Emperor halted at Yikenuo'er and hunted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賑四川西昌水災。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, flood relief was given in Xichang, Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Xichang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 定直隸被旱州縣賑恤事宜。

translations.literal: Regulations were fixed for relief of drought-stricken prefectures and counties in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili drought relief rules were set.

sentences.zh: 賑廣東始興等十六州縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given in sixteen prefectures and counties of Guangdong including Shixing.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen Guangdong districts including Shixing received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上行圍於巴彥，親射殪虎。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor hunted at Bayan and personally shot and killed a tiger.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor killed a tiger with his own bow at Bayan.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰朔，上行圍於伍什杭阿，親射殪虎。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day gengchen: the Emperor hunted at Wushihenga and personally shot and killed a tiger.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Emperor killed a tiger at Wushihenga.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上行圍威准。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor hunted at Weizhun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor hunted at Weizhun.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上行圍黃科。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor hunted at Huangke.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor hunted at Huangke.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上行圍阿蘭。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Emperor hunted at Alan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the Emperor hunted at Alan.

sentences.zh: 以哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖未奏往額爾德尼招禮拜，土謝圖汗敦丹多爾濟均下理籓院議處。

translations.literal: Because the Jebzundamba Khutukhtu had not reported going to worship at Erdene Juu, and the Tusheet Khan Dundendorji, both were referred to the Court of Colonial Affairs for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: The Jebzundamba Khutukhtu and Tusheet Khan Dundendorji were sent to the Court of Colonial Affairs for failing to report a pilgrimage to Erdene Juu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賑陝西商州水災飢。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, flood and famine relief was given in Shangzhou, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Shangzhou received flood and famine relief.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上行圍舍里。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor hunted at Sheli.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the Emperor hunted at Sheli.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上行圍善顏倭赫。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement at Shanyanwohe.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor hunted at Shanyanwohe.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上行圍巴彥。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement at Bayan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor hunted at Bayan.

sentences.zh: 鄂彌達改荊州將軍。

translations.literal: E'mida was transferred to be general at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: E'mida became Jingzhou general.

sentences.zh: 調博第為吉林將軍，富森為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Bodi was transferred to be Jilin general; Fusen was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: Bodi went to Jilin and Fusen to Heilongjiang as generals.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上行圍尼雅滿珠。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement at Niyamanzhu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor hunted at Niyamanzhu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上行圍珠敦。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement at Zhudun.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Emperor hunted at Zhudun.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上行圍英額邊門外。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement outside Ying'e Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor hunted outside Ying'e Pass.

sentences.zh: 是日，駐蹕烏蘇河。

translations.literal: That day, the imperial progress halted at the Usu River.
translations.idiomatic: The court halted that day at the Usu River.

sentences.zh: 甲午，許容以劾謝濟世貪縱各款皆虛，孫嘉淦以扶同定案，均褫職。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Xu Rong was stripped of office because all counts in his impeachment of Xie Jishi for greed and license proved false; Sun Jiagan was also dismissed for colluding in the verdict.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Rong and Sun Jiagan were dismissed over the false impeachment of Xie Jishi.

sentences.zh: 署糧道倉德以通揭鞫實，予敘。

translations.literal: Acting grain intendant Cang De was found guilty on public denunciation and given a merit record.
translations.idiomatic: Cang De was rewarded after a public denunciation proved true.

sentences.zh: 上駐蹕穆奇村。

translations.literal: The Emperor halted the progress at Muqi Village.
translations.idiomatic: The court halted at Muqi Village.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上奉皇太后謁永陵。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, visited Yong Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor with the Empress Dowager visited Yong Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 丙申，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the great feast ritual was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the great feast offering was made.

sentences.zh: 命停顧琮議限民田。

translations.literal: An order halted Gu Cong's proposal to limit private farmland.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong's plan to cap private land was stopped.

sentences.zh: 賑河南祥符等二十一州縣、山東齊東等十八州縣衛旱災，並免額賦有差。

translations.literal: Drought in Xiangfu and twenty other districts of Henan, and in Qidong and eighteen other districts and guards of Shandong, was relieved; land-tax quotas were remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Henan and Shandong drought districts were relieved and taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，謁福陵。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Fuling Mausoleum was visited.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor visited Fuling.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the great feast ritual was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the great feast offering was made.

sentences.zh: 謁昭陵。

translations.literal: Zhaoling Mausoleum was visited.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor visited Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the great feast ritual was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the great feast offering was made.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后駐蹕盛京。

translations.literal: The Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, halted the progress at Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: The court with the Empress Dowager halted at Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮國王李昑遣陪臣至盛京貢方物。

translations.literal: The King of Korea, Li Yin, sent an attendant minister to Shengjing with tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Korean King Li Yin sent tribute to Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上率群臣詣皇太后宮行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Emperor led the civil and military officials to the Empress Dowager's palace to perform congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, officials congratulated the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 御崇政殿受賀。

translations.literal: At Chongzheng Hall the Emperor received congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Congratulations were received at Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 賜群臣及朝鮮使臣宴。

translations.literal: Banquets were granted to the civil and military officials and the Korean envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and the Korean envoy were banqueted.

sentences.zh: 御大政殿賜酺。

translations.literal: At Dazheng Hall the Emperor granted a court libation.
translations.idiomatic: A court libation was granted at Dazheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: An edict of grace was promulgated with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted grace in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上詣文廟釋奠。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor offered sacrifice at the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor sacrificed at the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 幸講武臺大閱。

translations.literal: He visited the Parade Ground for a grand review.
translations.idiomatic: A grand martial review was held at the Parade Ground.

sentences.zh: 諭王公宗室大臣等潔蠲禮典，訓導兵民，毋忘淳樸舊俗。

translations.literal: An edict ordered princes, imperial clansmen, and great ministers to keep rites pure, instruct soldiers and people, and not forget the old simple customs.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and ministers were urged to preserve simple Manchu customs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上親奠克勤郡王岳託及武勛王揚古利墓。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor personally offered libation at the tombs of Prince Keqin Yuetuo and Merit King Yangguli.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor sacrificed at Yuetuo's and Yangguli's tombs.

sentences.zh: 遣官望祭長白山、北鎮醫巫閭山及遼太祖陵。

translations.literal: Officials were sent to offer distant sacrifice at Changbai Mountain, Beizhen Yiwulü Mountain, and the tomb of Emperor Taizu of Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys offered distant sacrifice at Changbai, Yiwulü, and the Liao founder's tomb.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上親奠弘毅公額宜都、直義公費英東墓。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor personally offered libation at the tombs of Duke Hongyi E'iyetu and Duke Zhiyi Fei Yingdong.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor sacrificed at E'iyetu's and Fei Yingdong's tombs.

sentences.zh: 免河南帶徵乾隆七年以前民欠。

translations.literal: Henan was exempted from arrears of supplementary levies before Qianlong year 7.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's supplementary levy arrears before year 7 were remitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌朔，上御大政殿，賜扈從王大臣宴於鳳凰樓前。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengxu, first day of the month: the Emperor presided at Dazheng Hall and granted a banquet to the accompanying princes and great ministers before Fenghuang Tower.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the tenth month, the Emperor banqueted the entourage at Dazheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 諭王公宗室等革除陋習，恪守舊章。

translations.literal: An edict ordered princes and imperial clansmen to abolish corrupt practices and keep to the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Princes were told to end bad habits and follow old rules.

sentences.zh: 免盛京、興京等十五處旗地本年額賦及乾隆七年逋賦。

translations.literal: Banner lands at Shengjing, Xingjing, and fourteen other places were exempted from this year's quotas and from arrears of Qianlong year 7.
translations.idiomatic: Shengjing-area banner land tax for the year and year-7 arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 御制盛京賦。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed the "Rhapsody on Shengjing."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wrote the Rhapsody on Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上奉皇太后回蹕。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, turned the progress homeward.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the court with the Empress Dowager set out for home.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賑廣東南海等七縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yichou, flood in Nanhai and six other districts of Guangdong was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Guangdong flood districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 是日，上登望海樓，駐文殊菴。

translations.literal: That day, the Emperor ascended Wanghai Tower and halted at Wenshu Nunnery.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor climbed Wanghai Tower and halted at Wenshu Nunnery.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命直隸被災各屬減價平糶。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, disaster districts in Zhili were ordered to sell grain at reduced prices.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Zhili disaster areas got subsidized grain sales.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命部院大臣京察各舉賢自代。

translations.literal: On day jisi, ministers of the boards and courts in the capital evaluation were ordered each to recommend a worthy man to succeed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, capital ministers were to nominate successors in their evaluations.

sentences.zh: 以劉於義為戶部尚書，阿里袞為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Liu Yuyi was made Minister of Revenue; Aligun was made governor of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuyi became Revenue minister and Aligun Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 命徐本仍兼管戶部。

translations.literal: Xu Ben was ordered to continue concurrent charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Ben kept concurrent charge of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 調陳宏謀為陝西巡撫，塞楞額為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Chen Hongmou was transferred to be governor of Shaanxi; Saileng'e was made governor of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hongmou went to Shaanxi and Saileng'e to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賑河南祥符等十四州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, drought in Xiangfu and fourteen other districts of Henan was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Henan drought areas were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the court with the Empress Dowager reached Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上以謁陵禮成，率群臣詣皇太后宮行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, because the tomb-visit rites were complete, the Emperor led the civil and military officials to the Empress Dowager's palace to perform congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, officials congratulated the Empress Dowager after the tomb tour.

sentences.zh: 御太和殿，王大臣各官進表朝賀。

translations.literal: At the Hall of Supreme Harmony the princes, great ministers, and various officials presented memorials of felicitation in court audience.
translations.idiomatic: Felicitation was held at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 十一月，賑安徽無為水災，並免額賦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: flood in Wuwei, Anhui, was relieved, and land-tax quotas were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Wuwei flood victims were relieved and taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賑甘肅狄道等二十四州縣水蟲風雹災。

translations.literal: On day renwu, flood, insect, wind, and hail disasters in Didao and twenty-four other districts of Gansu were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, twenty-four Gansu districts got disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，安南國王黎維禕表謝賜祭及襲封恩，進貢方物。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the King of Annam, Le Duy Yi, memorialized thanks for sacrificial grants and enfeoffment favor and presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Annam's Le Duy Yi thanked the court and sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賑廣東萬州等十四州縣水災，福建臺灣等三縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, flood in Wanzhou and fourteen other districts of Guangdong, and drought in three districts of Taiwan, Fujian, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Guangdong floods and Fujian Taiwan drought were relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，貸黑龍江被旱被霜兵丁等倉糧。

translations.literal: On day renyin, granary grain was lent to banner soldiers and others in Heilongjiang stricken by drought and frost.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Heilongjiang troops got lent grain after drought and frost.

sentences.zh: 賑山西曲沃等十一州旱災。

translations.literal: Drought in Quwo and ten other prefectures of Shanxi was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi drought districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賑直隸天津等二縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day guimao, drought in Tianjin and two other districts of Zhili was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Tianjin-area drought was relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賑安徽壽州等九州縣衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, drought in Shouzhou and nine other districts and guards of Anhui was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Anhui drought areas were relieved.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免謁陵經過額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, one-tenth of land tax along the tomb-visit route was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, one-tenth of transit land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌朔，賑廣東吳川縣旱災。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu, first day of the month: drought in Wuchuan District, Guangdong, was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the twelfth month, Wuchuan drought was relieved.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命史貽直協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Shi Yizhi was ordered to assist as Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Shi Yizhi was made assisting Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賑山東陵縣等十二州縣衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day yimao, drought in Lingxian and twelve other districts and guards of Shandong was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Shandong drought districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 葬端慧皇太子於朱華山寢園。

translations.literal: The Duanhui Crown Prince was buried in the garden mausoleum on Zhuhua Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Duanhui was buried at Zhuhua Mountain.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大學士福敏乞退。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Grand Secretary Fumin asked to retire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Grand Secretary Fumin sought retirement.

sentences.zh: 溫諭慰留。

translations.literal: A warm edict urged him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: A warm edict kept him at post.

sentences.zh: 甲子，準噶爾遣貢使圖爾都等至京，謝進藏人由噶斯路行走，賜助牲畜恩，並貢方物。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Dzungar tribute envoys including Tudou arrived at the capital, thanking the favor of livestock aid for people entering Tibet by the Gas route; tribute goods were also presented.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Dzungar envoys thanked aid for the Tibet route and brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以陳德華隱匿其弟陝西按察使陳德正申辨參案密奏，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day yichou, because Chen Dehua had secretly memorialized in the case of his younger brother Shaanxi surveillance commissioner Chen Dezheng's petition, the Ministry was ordered to deliberate severely.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Chen Dehua was severely investigated for hiding his brother's petition.

sentences.zh: 德正褫職鞫治。

translations.literal: Dezheng was stripped of office and put on trial.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dezheng was dismissed and tried.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以星變示儆，詔修省。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, because of a stellar omen as warning, an edict ordered self-examination and austerity.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, a stellar omen prompted an austerity edict.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月辛巳，以徐本病，命史貽直為大學士。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, day xinsi: because Xu Ben was ill, Shi Yizhi was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 9, Shi Yizhi became Grand Secretary as Xu Ben fell ill.

sentences.zh: 以劉於義為吏部尚書、協辦大學士，張楷為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Liu Yuyi was made Minister of Personnel and assisting Grand Secretary; Zhang Kai was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuyi became Personnel minister and assisting secretary; Zhang Kai, Revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 陳德華罷，以王安國為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Chen Dehua was dismissed; Wang Anguo was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dehua was removed; Wang Anguo became War minister.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸瀛臺。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor visited Yingtai.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor visited Yingtai.

sentences.zh: 御大幄次，賜準噶爾使圖爾都宴，命立首班大臣末。

translations.literal: In the great tent enclosure, a banquet was granted to the Dzungar envoy Tudou; he was ordered to take the last place among the first-rank ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Tudou was banqueted and seated last among first-rank ministers.

sentences.zh: 以噶爾丹策零恭順，圖爾都誠敬可嘉，召圖爾都近前，賜飲三爵，錫賚有加。

translations.literal: Because Galdan Tseren was submissive and Tudou was sincere and respectful, Tudou was summoned forward, granted three cups of wine, and richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Tudou was summoned, given three cups, and richly rewarded for Dzungar sincerity.

sentences.zh: 訓飭各省州縣教養兼施。

translations.literal: Provincial, prefectural, and district officials were admonished to nurture and teach together.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were told to combine nurture and instruction.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賑直隸天津等十一州縣災。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, disaster in Tianjin and eleven other districts of Zhili was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Tianjin-area disasters were relieved.

sentences.zh: 庚子，王安國憂免，以彭維新為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Wang Anguo was excused for mourning; Peng Weixin was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Wang Anguo left for mourning and Peng Weixin became War minister.

sentences.zh: 以許容署湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Xu Rong was appointed acting governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Rong became acting Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 授史貽直文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: Shi Yizhi was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depth.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yizhi became Wenyuan Hall Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 給訥親欽差大臣關防。

translations.literal: Neqin was given the seal of Imperial Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Neqin received an imperial commissioner seal.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上奉皇太后詣泰陵。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, proceeded to Tai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor with the Empress Dowager went to Tai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上詣泰陵。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor proceeded to Tai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor visited Tai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 是日，奉皇太后回蹕。

translations.literal: That day, accompanying the Empress Dowager, the progress turned homeward.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager returned with the court that day.

sentences.zh: 二月，上奉皇太后幸南苑。

translations.literal: Second month: the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the court with the Empress Dowager went to the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以給事中陳大玠等奏，寢許容署湖北巡撫之命，留晏斯盛任，仍申誡言官扶同糾論。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, because supervising secretary Chen Daqi and others memorialized, the order appointing Xu Rong acting governor of Hubei was suspended; Yan Sisheng was kept in post, and censors were again warned against colluding in impeachments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Xu Rong's Hubei appointment was halted and censors warned anew.

sentences.zh: 免安徽桐城等九州縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Land-tax quotas for last year's flood in Tongcheng and eight other districts of Anhui were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui flood districts' last-year tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 免福建臺灣等三縣旱災額賦，並賑之。

translations.literal: Land-tax quotas for drought in three districts of Taiwan, Fujian, were remitted, and relief was also granted.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian Taiwan drought tax was remitted and victims relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲子，陳德華降調。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Chen Dehua was demoted and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Chen Dehua was demoted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賑雲南霑、益二州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, flood in Zhan and Yi, two districts of Yunnan, was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Yunnan flood districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，戶部尚書張楷卒，以阿爾賽代之，鄂彌達為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Minister of Revenue Zhang Kai died; A'ersai replaced him; E'mida was made governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Zhang Kai died; A'ersai succeeded him and E'mida became Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，以汪由敦為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Third month, day guawei: Wang Youdun was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guawei day, Wang Youdun became Works minister.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，免江蘇沛縣、河南中牟等六縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, land-tax quotas for drought in Peixian, Jiangsu, and Zhongmou and five other districts of Henan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Jiangsu and Henan drought tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，調博第為西安將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Bodi was transferred to be Xi'an general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Bodi became Xi'an general.

sentences.zh: 以巴靈阿為寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: Baling'a was made general at Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: Baling'a became Ningguta general.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賑山東德州等五州縣衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, drought in Dezhou and five other districts and guards of Shandong was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Shandong drought areas were relieved.

sentences.zh: 以訥親奏查閱河南、江南營伍廢弛，上曰：「可見外省大吏無一不欺朕者，不可不懲一儆百。

translations.literal: Because Neqin memorialized that garrisons in Henan and Jiangnan were neglected on inspection, the Emperor said: "It is clear that not one provincial grandee fails to deceive Us; We must punish one to warn a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: When Neqin reported Henan and Jiangnan troops neglected, the Emperor demanded punishing one grandee to warn the rest.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued.

sentences.zh: 四月戊申朔，始建先蠶壇成。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wushen, first day of the month: the Altar of the First Silkworm was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the fourth month, the First Silkworm altar was completed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上詣圜丘行大雩禮，特詔貶損儀節，以示虔禱。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor proceeded to the Circular Mound for the great rain-prayer ritual; a special edict ordered ritual abridged to show sincere supplication.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Circular Mound with simplified rites.

sentences.zh: 以旱命省刑寬禁。

translations.literal: Because of drought, punishments were ordered reduced and prohibitions relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: Drought prompted orders to lighten penalties and relax bans.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賑山東德平等八州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, drought relief was given to eight prefectures and counties including Deping in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Shandong's Deping and seven other counties received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 己卯，諭曰：「一春以來，雨澤稀少。

translations.literal: On day jimao, an edict said: "Since spring, rain has been scarce.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, an edict said spring rains had been scarce.

sentences.zh: 皇太后以天時久旱，憂形於色，今日從寢宮步行至園內龍神廟虔禱。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager, anxious over the long drought, walked today from her sleeping palace to the Dragon God Temple in the garden to pray devoutly.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager, troubled by prolonged drought, walked from her palace to the garden Dragon God Temple to pray.

sentences.zh: 朕惶恐戰慄，即刻前往請安，諄懇謝罪，特諭內外臣工知之。

translations.literal: I was filled with fear and trembling, went at once to pay my respects, earnestly begged forgiveness, and specially informed all officials inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor went at once to pay respects, apologized earnestly, and instructed all officials.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，祭地於方澤，不乘輦，不設鹵簿。

translations.literal: " On day wuzi, the earth was sacrificed to at Fangze, without riding the palanquin and without setting out the guard of honor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, earth sacrifice at Fangze was performed without palanquin or guard of honor.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，雨。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大學士、九卿議覆御史柴潮生請修直隸水利，命協辦大學士劉於義往保定會同高斌籌畫。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Grand Secretaries and the Nine Ministers replied to Censor Chai Chaosheng's memorial requesting Zhili water works; Associate Grand Secretary Liu Yuyi was ordered to Baoding to plan with Gao Bin.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, officials replied on Zhili water works; Liu Yuyi was sent to Baoding with Gao Bin to plan.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，大學士徐本以病乞休，允之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: Grand Secretary Xu Ben begged leave on illness; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Xu Ben retired ill and was allowed to leave.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賑山東歷城等三十二州縣旱災，蘭山等六州縣雹災。

translations.literal: On day guichou, drought relief was given to thirty-two prefectures and counties including Licheng in Shandong, and hail disaster relief to six prefectures and counties including Lanshan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Shandong drought and hail disasters in Lanshan and elsewhere were relieved.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子朔，諭直隸災重之天津等十六州縣，本年停徵新舊錢糧。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day bingzi: edict to Tianjin and fifteen other hard-hit Zhili prefectures and counties to halt collection of old and new taxes and grain for the year.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, sixteen hard-hit Zhili districts were told to stop tax and grain levies for the year.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，免江蘇、安徽雍正十三年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, arrears of the Yongzheng thirteenth year in Jiangsu and Anhui were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Jiangsu and Anhui's Yongzheng-era tax arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，額爾圖以不職免，以達勒黨阿為奉天將軍。

translations.literal: On day renchen, E'ertu was dismissed for incompetence; Daledang'a was made Fengtian general.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, E'ertu was dismissed and Daledang'a became Fengtian general.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，撫恤安徽歙縣等二十州縣水災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: consolation and relief for flood in Shexian and nineteen other prefectures and counties in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, flood victims in twenty Anhui districts were consoled.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免江蘇淮安、安徽鳳陽二府雍正十三年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day wushen, arrears of Yongzheng thirteenth year in Huai'an prefecture, Jiangsu, and Fengyang prefecture, Anhui, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Huai'an and Fengyang's Yongzheng tax arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賑四川成都等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day guichou, flood relief was given to Chengdu and other prefectures and counties in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Sichuan flood districts including Chengdu were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，予告大學士徐本回籍，上賜詩寵行，賞賚有加，並諭行幸南苑之日，親臨慰問。

translations.literal: On day yichou, retired Grand Secretary Xu Ben returned home; the Emperor bestowed a poem to honor his departure, added generous gifts, and ordered that when touring the Southern Park he would visit in person to console him.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Xu Ben went home with imperial poetry and gifts; the Emperor would visit him when touring the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，免直隸天津等三十一州縣上年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, last year's tax arrears in Tianjin and thirty other Zhili prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, tax arrears were remitted in thirty-one Zhili districts including Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上奉皇太后幸南苑，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to the Southern Park and went on a hunting encampment tour.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to the Southern Park and hunted.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥朔，以翰林院編修黃體明進呈講章，牽及搜檢太嚴，隱含諷刺，下部嚴議褫職。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day jihai: Hanlin Compiler Huang Timing's submitted lecture chapter, touching on excessively strict searches, implicitly satirized; the ministry was ordered to investigate strictly and strip office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Huang Timing was dismissed after a lecture chapter satirized strict searches.

sentences.zh: 乙未，免山西清水河本年雹災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, this year's assessed tax for hail disaster in Qingshui River, Shanxi, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Shanxi hail-damaged districts' taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賑山東博興等縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day guimao, drought relief was given to Boxing and other counties in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Shandong drought counties including Boxing were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁未，改明年會試於三月舉行。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, next year's metropolitan examination was moved to the third month.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the next metropolitan exam was set for the third month.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以陳世倌假滿，命入閣辦事。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Chen Shiguan's leave expired; he was ordered to enter the Grand Secretariat to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Chen Shiguan returned from leave to serve in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 賑山西文水等縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given to Wenshui and other counties in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi flood districts including Wenshui were relieved.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以四川學政蔣蔚實心教士，命留任。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Sichuan Education Intendant Jiang Wei was kept in office for conscientious instruction of scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Jiang Wei was kept as Sichuan education intendant for devoted teaching.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上奉皇太后幸湯山。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to Tangshan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to Tangshan.

sentences.zh: 江南、河南、山東蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts in Jiangnan, Henan, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts plagued Jiangnan, Henan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上幸盤山。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor visited Panshan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor visited Panshan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，重修翰林院工竣。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, reconstruction of the Hanlin Academy was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Hanlin Academy reconstruction was finished.

sentences.zh: 上幸翰林院賜宴，分韻賦詩，復御制柏梁體詩首句，群臣以次賡續。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited the Hanlin Academy, bestowed a banquet, and assigned rhymes for poetry; he also composed the opening line of a Bo Liang-style poem for ministers to continue in turn.
translations.idiomatic: At the Hanlin banquet the Emperor set rhymes and the opening Bo Liang verse for ministers to continue.

sentences.zh: 賜掌院大學士鄂爾泰、張廷玉御書扁額，及翰林、詹事諸臣書幣有差。

translations.literal: Plaques with imperial calligraphy were bestowed on Chancellor Grand Secretaries Ortai and Zhang Tingyu, and books and silk to Hanlin and Daroga officials in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai and Zhang Tingyu received imperial inscribed plaques; other officials received graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 是日，幸貢院，賜御書聯額。

translations.literal: That day he visited the examination compound and bestowed paired scrolls with imperial writing.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Emperor visited the exam compound and gave inscribed scrolls.

sentences.zh: 復幸紫微殿、觀象臺。

translations.literal: He also visited Ziwei Hall and the Observatory.
translations.idiomatic: He also visited Ziwei Hall and the Observatory.

sentences.zh: 賑直隸保定等十八州縣水蟲雹等災。

translations.literal: Relief for flood, insect, and hail disasters in Baoding and seventeen other Zhili prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen Zhili districts including Baoding received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇靖江等十二州縣衛潮災，安徽歙縣二十一州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: Relief for tidal disaster in twelve Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Jingjiang, and flood in twenty-one Anhui districts including Shexian.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu tidal and Anhui flood districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，起孫嘉淦為宗人府府丞。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Sun Jiagan was recalled as vice director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Sun Jiagan became Imperial Clan Court vice director.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，除直隸涿州等三州縣水沖地賦。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, land tax on flood-washed land in Zhuozhou and two other Zhili prefectures and counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, tax on flood-washed Zhili land was remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，山東登州鎮總兵馬世龍以科派兵丁，鞫實論絞。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Shandong Dengzhou garrison Commander Ma Shilong, for extorting levies from soldiers, was tried, facts established, and sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Ma Shilong was sentenced to death for extorting his troops.

sentences.zh: 賑甘肅河州等三十五州縣衛雹水各災。

translations.literal: Relief for hail and flood in thirty-five Gansu prefectures, counties, and guards including Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-five Gansu districts received hail and flood relief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以江西學政金德瑛取士公明，命留任。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Jiangxi Education Intendant Jin Deying was kept for fair selection of scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Jin Deying was kept for fair Jiangxi examinations.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以貴州學政佟保守潔士服，命留任。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Guizhou Education Intendant Tong Bao was kept for integrity in scholarly attire.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Tong Bao was kept for upright conduct as Guizhou education intendant.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鄂爾泰議覆劉於義奏勘直隸水利，命撥銀五十萬兩興修。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Ortai replied on Liu Yuyi's memorial surveying Zhili water works; five hundred thousand taels of silver were ordered allocated for construction.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, five hundred thousand taels were allocated for Zhili water works.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免浙江仁和等三十一州縣所旱災額賦，並賑之。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, assessed tax for drought in thirty-one Zhejiang prefectures and districts including Renhe was remitted and relief given.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Zhejiang drought taxes were remitted and relief distributed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賑成都等三十州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, flood relief for Chengdu and thirty prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, thirty Sichuan districts including Chengdu received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，允準噶爾貢使哈柳等隨帶牛羊等物在肅州貿易。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Dzungar tribute envoys Haliu and others were permitted to trade cattle and sheep they brought at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Dzungar envoys were allowed to trade livestock at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，免山東歷城等三十二州縣衛本年旱雹等災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, this year's assessed tax for drought, hail, and other disasters in thirty-two Shandong districts including Licheng was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Shandong disaster taxes in thirty-two districts were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，免直隸保定等十一州縣廳本年水旱蟲雹災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yichou, this year's disaster taxes in eleven Zhili districts including Baoding were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, eleven Zhili districts' disaster taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賞雷鋐額外諭德，食俸。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Lei Chuo was given additional rank as Exhortation Tutor with salary.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Lei Chuo received Exhortation Tutor rank and salary.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，張照丁憂，調汪由敦為刑部尚書，以趙弘恩為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Zhang Zhao entered mourning; Wang Youdun was transferred to Minister of Justice, and Zhao Hong'en made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Zhang Zhao mourned; Wang Youdun and Zhao Hong'en received ministerial posts.

sentences.zh: 免安徽歙縣等二十一州縣衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: Water disaster taxes in twenty-one Anhui districts including Shexian were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui flood taxes in twenty-one districts were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以福建閩縣等縣火災，諭責疆吏不嚴火備。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, because of fire in Minxian and other Fujian counties, frontier officials were rebuked for lax fire precautions.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Fujian officials were rebuked over fire in Minxian and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹怎就獲。

translations.literal: Luobuzangdanjin was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Luobuzangdanjin was taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月丙子，召大學士、內廷翰林於重華宮聯句。

translations.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, day bingzi: Grand Secretaries and inner-court Hanlin were summoned to coupled verses at the Palace of Double Glory.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, first month, Grand Secretaries and Hanlin composed coupled verses at Chonghua Palace.

sentences.zh: 改會試於三月，著為令。

translations.literal: The metropolitan examination was moved to the third month and made a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: The metropolitan exam was permanently set for the third month.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大學士鄂爾泰以病乞解任，溫諭慰留。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Grand Secretary Ortai begged to resign on illness; a warm edict comforted and kept him.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Ortai's resignation for illness was refused with comforting words.

sentences.zh: 己亥，準噶爾遣使哈柳貢方物。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Dzungars sent envoy Haliu with tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Dzungar envoy Haliu brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚子，召高斌來京，以劉於義署直隸總督。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Gao Bin was summoned to the capital; Liu Yuyi acted as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Gao Bin was recalled and Liu Yuyi acted Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賑浙江淳安等四縣上年水災。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, last year's flood in four Zhejiang counties including Chun'an was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, four Zhejiang counties received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上幸內右門直廬視鄂爾泰疾。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor visited Ortai's illness at his lodge inside the Right Inner Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor visited the ailing Ortai.

sentences.zh: 己未，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor paid respects at Zhaoxi, Xiao, Xiaodong, and Jing Mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor visited the imperial mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 庚申，免廣東海陽等二縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, last year's flood taxes in Haiyang and one other Guangdong county were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Guangdong flood taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲子，免江蘇丹徒等十州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, last year's flood taxes in ten Jiangsu districts including Dantu were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Jiangsu flood taxes in ten districts were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己巳，免山東博興等二縣乾隆九年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jisi, drought taxes of Qianlong ninth year in Boxing and one other Shandong county were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Shandong drought taxes from the ninth year were remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚午，高斌回直隸總督。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Gao Bin resumed as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Gao Bin returned as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉朔，日食。

translations.literal: Third month, first day guiyou: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，改殿試於四月，著為令。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the palace examination was moved to the fourth month and made a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the palace exam was permanently set for the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 賑雲南白鹽井水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief for Baiyanjing, Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan's Baiyanjing received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上幸鄂爾泰第視疾。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor visited Ortai at his residence to see his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor called on the ailing Ortai at home.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，加鄂爾泰太傅。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Ortai was given the added title Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Ortai was made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 己丑，協辦大學士、禮部尚書三泰乞休，允之。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Associate Grand Secretary and Minister of Rites San Tai begged retirement; granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, San Tai retired and was allowed to leave.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命訥親協辦大學士，調來保為禮部尚書，以盛安為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Prince Neqin was ordered to assist as Grand Secretary; Laibao was transferred to Minister of Rites, and Sheng'an made Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Neqin assisted the Grand Secretariat; Laibao and Sheng'an received posts.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，免浙江仁和等三十州縣上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guisi, last year's drought taxes in thirty Zhejiang districts including Renhe were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Zhejiang drought taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以安南莫康武作亂，攻陷太原、高平等處，命那蘇圖等嚴防邊隘。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, because Annam's Mo Kangwu rebelled and seized Taiyuan, Gaoping, and other places, Nasutu and others were ordered to guard the frontier strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, officials were ordered to guard the border after Mo Kangwu seized Annamese towns.

sentences.zh: 乙未，加史貽直、陳世倌、來保、高斌太子太保，劉於義、張允隨、張廣泗太子少保。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Shi Yizhi, Chen Shiguan, Laibao, and Gao Bin were made Junior Grand Mentors of the Heir Apparent; Liu Yuyi, Zhang Yunsui, and Zhang Guangsi Junior Grand Preceptors.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, several ministers received heir-apparent tutor ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯朔，發江南帑銀五十六萬兩濬河道。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day guimao: five hundred sixty thousand taels from Jiangnan treasury were issued to dredge river channels.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, 560,000 taels were sent from Jiangnan to dredge rivers.

sentences.zh: 己巳，免山東海豐等二縣被旱額徵灶課。

translations.literal: On day jisi, assessed salt-works tax for drought in Haifeng and one other Shandong county was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Shandong salt-field drought taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大學士鄂爾泰卒，上臨奠，輟朝二日，命遵世宗遺詔，配饗太廟。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Grand Secretary Ortai died; the Emperor attended the mourning, halted court two days, and ordered according to the Yongzheng emperor's testament that he share sacrifice in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Ortai died; the Emperor mourned, halted court, and ordered him enshrined in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 召那蘇圖來京，以策楞為兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Nasutu was summoned to the capital; Celeng was made governor-general of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: Nasutu was recalled; Celeng became Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 調準泰為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhuntai was transferred to Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuntai became Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 以魏定國為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Wei Dingguo was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Dingguo became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 庚申，召蔣溥來京，以楊錫紱為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Jiang Pu was summoned to the capital; Yang Xifu was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Jiang Pu was recalled and Yang Xifu became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，飭沿海各省訓練水師。

translations.literal: On day renxu, coastal provinces were ordered to train naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, coastal provinces were told to train their fleets.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以旱命刑部清理庶獄。

translations.literal: On day guihai, because of drought the Ministry of Justice was ordered to clear routine prisons.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, drought prompted orders to clear routine cases in prison.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，策試貢士，詔能深悉時政直言極諫者聽。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, palace examination was held for presented scholars; those able to understand current policy and remonstrate frankly were heard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, presented scholars were examined; frank remonstrance on policy was welcomed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，慶復、紀山奏進剿瞻對番。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Qing Fu and Ji Shan memorialized advancing against the Dondup tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Qing Fu and Ji Shan reported advancing against Dondup tribes.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申朔，賜錢維城等三百三十三人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day renshen: Qian Weicheng and three hundred thirty-two others were granted metropolitan doctoral ranks in graded order.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, 333 graduates including Qian Weicheng received doctoral degrees.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，除江蘇蘇州等九府坍沒蘆課。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, reed-tax on collapsed land in nine Jiangsu prefectures including Suzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Jiangsu reed taxes on lost land were remitted.

sentences.zh: 頒御制太學訓飭士子文於各省學宮，同世祖臥碑文、聖祖聖諭廣訓、世宗朋黨論朔望宣講。

translations.literal: The Emperor's essay admonishing scholars at the Imperial Academy was promulgated to provincial academies, to be lectured on new and full moons together with the Taizu stone inscription, Kangxi Sacred Edict, and Yongzheng Factionalism essay.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial essay on scholars was sent to provincial schools for monthly lectures with earlier dynastic texts.

sentences.zh: 命訥親為保和殿大學士。

translations.literal: Neqin was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Preserving Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Neqin became Grand Secretary of the Hall of Preserving Harmony.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，戶部尚書阿爾賽為家奴所害，磔家奴於市。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Minister of Revenue Arsai was killed by a household slave; the slave was dismembered in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Revenue Minister Arsai was killed by a slave who was executed by dismemberment.

sentences.zh: 以高斌為吏部尚書，那蘇圖為直隸總督。

translations.literal: Gao Bin was made Minister of Personnel; Nasutu was made Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin became Personnel Minister and Nasutu Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 命高斌、劉於義仍辦直隸水利河道。

translations.literal: Gao Bin and Liu Yuyi were still ordered to manage Zhili water works and river channels.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin and Liu Yuyi remained in charge of Zhili waterways.

sentences.zh: 以梁詩正為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Liang Shizheng was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Shizheng became Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命劉於義兼管戶部事務。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Liu Yuyi was ordered concurrently to manage Ministry of Revenue affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Liu Yuyi was also placed over Revenue Ministry business.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，普免全國錢糧。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingwei: taxes and grain were universally remitted throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, taxes and grain were remitted empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「朕臨御天下，十年於茲。

translations.literal: An edict said: "I have ruled the empire for ten years now.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said the Emperor had ruled ten years.

sentences.zh: 撫育蒸黎，躬行儉約，薄賦輕徭，孜孜保治，不敢稍有暇逸。

translations.literal: I nurture the common people, practice frugality in person, keep taxes light and corvée light, tirelessly preserve good government, and dare not slacken in the slightest.
translations.idiomatic: I cherish the people, live frugally, keep taxes and labor light, and govern diligently without rest.

sentences.zh: 今寰宇敉寧，左藏有餘，持盈保泰，莫先足民。

translations.literal: Now the realm is pacified and the left treasury has surplus; to hold fullness and preserve peace, nothing comes before enriching the people.
translations.idiomatic: The empire is at peace and the treasury full; enriching the people is the first duty of lasting rule.

sentences.zh: 天下之財，止有此數，不聚於上，即散於下。

translations.literal: The wealth under Heaven has only this fixed measure; if it is not gathered above, it disperses below.
translations.idiomatic: The empire's wealth is finite: what is not kept at court flows to the people.

sentences.zh: 我皇祖在位六十一年，蠲租賜復之詔，史不絕書，普免天下錢糧一次。

translations.literal: My imperial grandfather reigned sixty-one years; edicts remitting rent and granting relief fill the histories without break, and once he wholly remitted the empire's land-tax grain.
translations.idiomatic: My grandfather's sixty-one-year reign was filled with rent remissions and relief; once he remitted all land-tax grain empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 我皇考無日不下減賦寬征之令，如甘肅一省，正賦全行豁免者十有餘年。

translations.literal: My imperial father never let a day pass without issuing orders to reduce levies and ease collection; in Gansu province alone, main taxes were wholly exempt for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: My father issued tax-relief orders daily; Gansu's main levies were fully exempt for over ten years.

sentences.zh: 朕以繼志述事之心，際重熙累洽之後，欲使海澨山陬，俱沾大澤，為是特頒諭旨，丙寅年直省應徵錢糧，其通蠲之。

translations.literal: I, with a heart of continuing the aim and fulfilling the work, at a time after repeated prosperity and concord, wishing coast and remote mountain hamlet alike to share great bounty, for this purpose especially issued an edict that for the bingyin year the land-tax grain due from metropolitan provinces be wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Wishing every shore and valley to share bounty after long peace, I ordered all land-tax grain due from the provinces in the bingyin year wholly remitted.

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，免安徽鳳陽等州府連年被災地方耗羨。

translations.literal: "" (closing quotation mark in the source.) On day gengxu, surcharges were remitted for Fengyang and other prefectures in Anhui long afflicted by disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed. On gengxu day, disaster surcharges were remitted in Fengyang and other Anhui prefectures.

sentences.zh: 命戶部侍郎傅恆在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: Fu Heng, Vice Minister of Revenue, was ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng was assigned to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，御史赫泰請收回普免錢糧成命。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Censor He Tai asked to withdraw the edict wholly remitting land-tax grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Censor He Tai asked to revoke the universal tax remission.

sentences.zh: 上斥其悖謬，褫職。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked him as perverse and stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor called him perverse and dismissed him.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未朔，免甘肅寧夏等三縣逋賦。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinwei (first of month): arrears in land tax were remitted for three counties including Ningxia in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinwei new moon: Gansu arrears were remitted for Ningxia and two other counties.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以順直宛平等六十四廳州縣缺雨，命停徵錢糧。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, because sixty-four departments, prefectures, and counties including Wanping in Zhili Direct lacked rain, collection of land-tax grain was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, tax collection was halted in sixty-four rain-starved Zhili districts including Wanping.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命高斌仍兼直隸河道總督。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Gao Bin was again ordered to hold concurrently the post of Zhili River Director-General.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Gao Bin again held the Zhili river director-generalship.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賑安徽壽州等十八州縣衛水災雹災。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, relief was given for flood and hail disaster in eighteen prefectures, counties, and guards including Shouzhou in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, flood and hail relief went to eighteen Anhui jurisdictions including Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上奉皇太后幸多倫諾爾，免經過州縣額賦十分之四。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, visited Duolun Nuo'er and remitted four-tenths of quota land tax for counties passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, traveling with the Empress Dowager to Duolun, the Emperor cut passing counties' quota tax by four-tenths.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上奉皇太后駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the court halted at the Summer Mountain Resort.

sentences.zh: 賑安徽宿州等州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for flood disaster in Suzhou and other prefectures, counties, and guards in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief was sent to Suzhou and other Anhui prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，賑兩淮莞瀆等三場水災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao: relief was given for flood at three salt-fields including Guandu in the Two Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guimao day: flood relief went to three Liang-Huai salt-fields including Guandu.

sentences.zh: 停徵湖北漢川等十七州縣水災、光化等二縣雹災額賦，並賑之。

translations.literal: Collection of quota tax was halted and relief given for flood in seventeen prefectures and counties including Hanchuan in Hubei and hail in two counties including Guanghua.
translations.idiomatic: Quota tax was halted and relief given for Hubei floods and hail in Guanghua and one other county.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: The Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, went to the Mulan hunting park.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to the Mulan hunt.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上駐波羅河屯。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Emperor halted at Boluohetun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Emperor halted at Boluohetun.

sentences.zh: 賜青海蒙古王公宴，並賚之。

translations.literal: Banquets were given to Mongol princes of Qinghai and gifts were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai Mongol princes were feasted and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上行圍永安莽喀。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Yong'an Mangka.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor hunted at Yong'an Mangka.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上行圍畢雅喀拉。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Biya Kala.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor hunted at Biya Kala.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上行圍溫都里華。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Wenduli Hua.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the Emperor hunted at Wenduli Hua.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上行圍額爾袞郭。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at E'ergun Guo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor hunted at E'ergun Guo.

sentences.zh: 賜蒙古王、額駙、台吉等宴。

translations.literal: Banquets were given to Mongol kings, imperial sons-in-law, and taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol kings, imperial sons-in-law, and taiji were feasted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上行圍布爾噶蘇台。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Bu'erge Su Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor hunted at Bu'erge Su Tai.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上行圍巴彥溝。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Bayan Gou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor hunted at Bayan Gou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上行圍烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Wuliyasutai.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Emperor hunted at Wuliyasutai.

sentences.zh: 賜王、大臣、蒙古王、額駙、台吉等宴。

translations.literal: Banquets were given to princes, grand ministers, Mongol kings, sons-in-law, and taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, ministers, Mongol kings, sons-in-law, and taiji were feasted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上行圍畢圖舍爾。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Bitushe'er.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Emperor hunted at Bitushe'er.

sentences.zh: 賑直隸宣化府屬旱災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for drought in districts under Xuanhua prefecture, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Drought relief went to Xuanhua prefecture districts in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上行圍阿濟格鳩和洛。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Aji Geju Heluo.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor hunted at Aji Geju Heluo.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上行圍僧機圖。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Sengji Tu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Emperor hunted at Sengji Tu.

sentences.zh: 己未，上行圍永安湃。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Yong'an Pai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor hunted at Yong'an Pai.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上行圍英圖和洛。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Yingtu Heluo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor hunted at Yingtu Heluo.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上行圍薩達克圖口。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Sadaketu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the Emperor hunted at Sadaketu Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賑湖北宜城等三州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day renxu, flood relief was given for three prefectures, counties, and guards including Yicheng in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, flood relief went to Yicheng and two other Hubei jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上行圍老圖博勒齊爾。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Laotu Bo'erqi'er.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor hunted at Laotu Bo'erqi'er.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上行圍庫爾奇勒。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Ku'erqi'le.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Emperor hunted at Ku'erqi'le.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賑甘肅安定等三縣、廣東電白等二縣旱災，海豐蟲災，南澳風災。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, drought relief was given for three counties including Anding in Gansu and two counties including Dianbai in Guangdong; insect disaster relief at Haifeng; wind disaster relief at Nan'ao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, drought relief went to Gansu and Guangdong counties; Haifeng received insect relief and Nan'ao wind relief.

sentences.zh: 上駐多倫諾爾。

translations.literal: The Emperor halted at Duolun Nuo'er.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor halted at Duolun.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賜王、大臣、蒙古王、額駙、台吉等宴。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, banquets were given to princes, ministers, Mongol kings, sons-in-law, and taiji.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, princes, ministers, and Mongol nobles were feasted.

sentences.zh: 賑山西曲沃等十二州縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given for twelve prefectures and counties including Quwo in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to Quwo and eleven other Shanxi counties.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午朔，上行圍額爾托昂色欽。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengwu (first of month): the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at E'ertuoang Seqin.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengwu new moon: the Emperor hunted at E'ertuoang Seqin.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上行圍多倫鄂博圖。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Duolun Ebo Tu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Emperor hunted at Duolun Ebo Tu.

sentences.zh: 壬申，遣祭明陵。

translations.literal: On day renshen, envoys were sent to sacrifice at the Ming tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, envoys sacrificed at the Ming tombs.

sentences.zh: 上行圍古哲諾爾。

translations.literal: The Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Guzhe Nuo'er.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor hunted at Guzhe Nuo'er.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，張允隨以猛緬土司奉廷徵等通緬莽，請改土歸流，命詳議。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Zhang Yunrui reported that Meng-Burma native chiefs Feng Tingzheng and others had contacted Burmese rebels; he asked to replace native rule with direct administration, and detailed deliberation was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Zhang Yunrui reported Burmese collusion by native chiefs and sought direct rule; the court ordered review.

sentences.zh: 上行圍塔奔陀羅海。

translations.literal: The Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Tabengtuoluo Hai.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor hunted at Tabengtuoluo Hai.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賑河南永城等五縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yihai, flood relief was given for five counties including Yongcheng in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, flood relief went to five Henan counties including Yongcheng.

sentences.zh: 上行圍札瑪克圖。

translations.literal: The Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Zhamake Tu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor hunted at Zhamake Tu.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上行圍峞爾呼。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Wei'erhu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Emperor hunted at Wei'erhu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賑直隸故城等十五州縣衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, drought relief was given for fifteen prefectures, counties, and guards including Gucheng in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, drought relief went to fifteen Zhili jurisdictions including Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上駐宣化府。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Emperor halted at Xuanhua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the Emperor halted at Xuanhua.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上閱宣化鎮兵。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor reviewed troops at Xuanhua garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor reviewed Xuanhua troops.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賑山東濟寧等六州縣衛水災，海豐旱災。
