translations.literal: On day dinghai, flood relief was given for six prefectures, counties, and guards including Jining in Shandong; drought relief at Haifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Shandong flood relief and Haifeng drought relief were ordered.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲午，授鄂彌達湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Eminida was made Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Eminida became Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 賑兩淮廟灣場水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given at the Miaowan salt-field in the Two Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to the Miaowan salt-field.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以普免錢糧，命查各省歷年存餘銀，以抵歲需。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, because land-tax grain had been wholly remitted, each province was ordered to audit surplus silver accumulated over the years to offset annual needs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, provinces were told to use accumulated surpluses to cover needs after the universal remission.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，授尹繼善兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Yin Jishan was made Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Yin Jishan became Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 命修明愍帝陵。

translations.literal: Repair was ordered for Emperor Min of Ming's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered repairs to the tomb of the Ming Min Emperor.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇淮、徐、海被災州縣。

translations.literal: Relief was given for disaster-hit prefectures and counties in Huai, Xu, and Hai, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu's Huai, Xu, and Hai districts received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 慶復奏收撫上瞻對，進剿下瞻對班滾，克加社丫等卡及南路各寨。

translations.literal: Qing Fu memorialized that upper Zhangdui had been pacified and brought in, that he was advancing against lower Zhangdui at Banben, and that he had taken Kasheya Pass and stockades on the southern route.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Fu reported pacifying upper Zhangdui, attacking Banben in lower Zhangdui, and capturing Kasheya and southern stockades.

sentences.zh: 賑陝西長安等六縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given for six counties including Chang'an in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to six Shaanxi counties including Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，以甘肅甘山道歸併肅州道。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingwei: the Ganshan circuit in Gansu was merged into the Suzhou circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dingwei day: Gansu's Ganshan circuit was merged into Suzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賑河南商丘等五縣水災。

translations.literal: On day wushen, flood relief was given for five counties including Shangqiu in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, flood relief went to five Henan counties including Shangqiu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，裁通政使司漢右通政一。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, one Han Right Vice Transmission Commissioner in the Transmission Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, one Han vice transmission commissioner post was cut.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命塞陳家浦決口。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, orders were issued to block the breach at Chenjiapu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Chenjiapu breach was ordered closed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命四川嚴查嘓匪。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Sichuan was ordered to strictly investigate local bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Sichuan was ordered to suppress bandits rigorously.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書任蘭枝乞休，允之。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Ren Lanzhi asked to retire; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Lanzhi, Minister of Rites, retired on request.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，免江蘇海州等七州縣漕糧。

translations.literal: On day guihai, tribute grain was remitted for seven prefectures and counties including Haizhou in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, tribute grain was remitted in seven Jiangsu prefectures including Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，給江南災民葺屋銀。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, silver was given to Jiangnan disaster victims to repair houses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Jiangnan victims received silver to rebuild houses.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇江浦等二十一州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given for twenty-one prefectures, counties, and guards including Jiangpu in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to twenty-one Jiangsu jurisdictions including Jiangpu.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賑湖南湘陰等三縣、湖北漢川等二十一州縣衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day yichou, drought relief was given for three counties including Xiangyin in Hunan and twenty-one prefectures, counties, and guards including Hanchuan in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, drought relief went to Hunan and Hubei counties including Xiangyin and Hanchuan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，除湖北當陽等二縣衛水沖地賦。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, land tax on land washed away by flood in two counties and guards including Dangyang in Hubei was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, tax on flood-washed land was cancelled in Dangyang and one other Hubei jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，賑順直香河等四十八州廳縣旱災，陝西興平等六縣水災。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengwu: drought relief was given for forty-eight prefectures, departments, and counties including Xianghe in Zhili; flood relief for six counties including Xingping in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengwu day: Zhili drought and Shaanxi flood relief were ordered.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賑山東滕縣等七州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, flood relief was given for seven prefectures, counties, and guards including Tengzhou in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, flood relief went to seven Shandong jurisdictions including Tengzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以王安國為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Wang Anguo was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Wang Anguo became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賑兩淮廟灣等場水災。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, flood relief was given at salt-fields including Miaowan in the Two Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Liang-Huai salt-fields including Miaowan received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，傅清奏準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零與阿卜都爾噶里木汗構兵。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Fu Qing memorialized that Dzungar taiji Galdan Tseren and Khan Abudurgami were at war with each other.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Fu Qing reported war between Galdan Tseren and Khan Abudurgami.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賑山西大同等十八州縣旱霜雹災。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, drought, frost, and hail relief was given for eighteen prefectures and counties including Datong in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, drought, frost, and hail relief went to eighteen Shanxi jurisdictions including Datong.

sentences.zh: 湖北巡撫晏斯盛乞養，以開泰代之。

translations.literal: Hubei governor Yan Sisheng asked leave to care for his parents; Kai Tai replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Sisheng left Hubei to nurse his parents; Kai Tai succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賑廣西思恩等縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, drought relief was given for counties including Si'en in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, drought relief went to Si'en and other Guangxi counties.

sentences.zh: 壬午，準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零卒。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Dzungar taiji Galdan Tseren died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Galdan Tseren died.

sentences.zh: 命西北兩路籌備邊防。

translations.literal: Both northwest routes were ordered to prepare frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: The northwestern routes were told to ready frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑廣東海矬等四場風災。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, wind disaster relief was given at four salt-fields including Haichuo in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, four Guangdong salt-fields including Haichuo received wind relief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免安徽宿州等五州縣水災地方漕糧。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, tribute grain was remitted for five prefectures and counties including Suzhou in Anhui in flood districts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, tribute grain was remitted in five flooded Anhui prefectures including Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，陳家浦決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Chenjiapu breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Chenjiapu breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賑直隸宣化府屬及慶雲縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day guisi, drought relief was given for districts under Xuanhua prefecture and Qingyun county in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, drought relief went to Xuanhua districts and Qingyun in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，大學士福敏乞休，優詔允之，加太傅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: Grand Secretary Fu Min asked to retire; a gracious edict approved it and added the title Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinhai day: Fu Min retired with honors as Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命慶復為文華殿大學士，留川陝總督任。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Qing Fu was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory, retaining his post as Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Qing Fu became Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall while keeping the Sichuan-Shaanxi post.

sentences.zh: 命高斌協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Gao Bin was ordered to serve as Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin was made Associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 賑陝西隴西等州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Drought relief was given for prefectures and counties including Longxi in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Drought relief went to Longxi and other Shaanxi counties.

sentences.zh: 賑淮北板浦等場水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given at salt-fields including Banpu north of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to Banpu and other north-Huai salt-fields.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命協辦大學士高斌、侍郎蔣溥均在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Associate Grand Secretary Gao Bin and Vice Minister Jiang Pu were both ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Gao Bin and Jiang Pu joined the Grand Council.
